5063.description: When Psijic monks (or their favored allies) call up a Psijic Spectral Steed, they're really summoning the spirit of a Psijic Horse Exemplar, brought back to the world of the living and made tangible by a supreme act of Conjuration.
5063.name: Psijic Spectral Steed

5064.description: This magical mount was created to provide Psijic Monks with a reliable conjured ride when going to and from the courts of rulers in northern Tamriel. Psijics have little use for such a creature on Artaeum, but summon them out of admiration and affection.
5064.name: Phantom Ice Wolf

5065.description: The Psijic monk who created the spell for conjuring the spirit of a Psijic Senche Exemplar back into the world of the living as a tangible Ghost Cat was a Wood Elfâwhich probably explains why it manifests as an Y'frren spirit of the Green.
5065.name: Green-Graht Ghost Cat

5066.description: When one of Meridia's Auroran Knights manifests in Tamriel, and needs a mount, the knight has the ability to instantly summon a Daedric Warhorse from the Colored Rooms. Curiously, if the knight is banished to Oblivion, the mount sometimes stays behind.
5066.name: Auroran Warhorse

5067.description: These magical creatures have a special relationship to Y'ffre the nature god, and seem to draw strength from the very bones of the earth beneath their hooves. It's a privilege for a mortal rider to be borne by such an enchanted beast.
5067.name: Dawnwood Indrik
5067.hint: Obtained by combining four different Dawnwood Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Dawnwood Indrik.

5068.description: The Luminous Indrik seems to radiate the same soft aetherial glow as the stars in the heavens, but steady and nearby rather than flickering and remote. It's reassuring, somehow.
5068.name: Luminous Indrik
5068.hint: Obtained by combining four different Luminous Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Luminous Indrik.

5071.description: An Exemplar mount is a mystical manifestation of its form's ideal concept, It is also extraordinarily sensitive to the emotional valences of its rider. If the rider engages in too much bloodthirsty killing, their Exemplar may become a Bloodshadow Wraith.
5071.name: Bloodshadow Wraith Steed

5072.description: The Badger Bears of southern Blackwood were nearly extinct in the wild when they were saved by the intervention from an unlikely source, an Imperial noble, when Viscount Glorion of Leyawiin rescued the species by breeding them as mounts.
5072.name: Badger Bear

5073.description: The cliffs and escarpments of east central Elsweyr are the home of the nimble and sure-footed senche-cougars, who prowl the rocks hunting goats and marmots. Inevitably, they've been domesticated by their feline cousins the Khajiit.
5073.name: Senche-Cougar
5073.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

5075.description: In the rugged badlands of central Hammerfell, even camels struggle to maneuver across the broken terrain. But wolves can go where even camels cannot, so the roving Redguards of the canyon lands have bred the local Painted Wolves into sure-footed mounts.
5075.name: Painted Wolf

5076.description: The thief-god Rajhin is said to have stolen these enchanted purple steeds from somewhere in Oblivion, but when his worshipers are asked where he got them, they just laugh and say, "Noweyr!"
5076.name: Noweyr Steed

5077.description: This ominous companion, conjured by Psijic magic in the shape of a glowing senche mount, represents for the monks of Artaeum all of the painful choices they regret having made, but which they nonetheless must ride upon into the future.
5077.name: Senche of Scarlet Regret

5078.description: "Sweet young things like to give this one kittens as keepsakes," says Eye of the Queen Razum-dar, "but raising a pet is not consistent with Raz's romantic but itinerant life of intrigue. Perhaps you could give cute Ja'khajiit a good home, yes?"
5078.name: Ja'khajiit Raz

5079.description: In the Clockwork City, mechanical Firepot Spiders can be programmed to follow chefs around like little walking barbecues. Someone has devised a secret method for exporting them from Sotha Sil's hidden worldâbut how? Better get one while you still can.
5079.name: Firepet Spider

5080.description: "Cute little thing, isn't it? 'Course, what I care about is that a Ringtail, properly trained, can get into places no one else can, and carry out small items in their cheek pouches. Lost goods, as it were, or misplaced valuables. Right?" âFenaanaral
5080.name: Alinor Ringtail

5081.description: The Great Daenians are gigantic hounds bred as protectors and companions by the Beldama Wyrd coven. Despite their size and strength, they are surprisingly gentle except when roused to the defense of their masters.
5081.name: Great Daenian Hound

5082.description: The young of most creatures are cute, even adorable. That's â¦ not really true of the Larval Yaghra. If you have one of these following you, you're either telling the world you don't give a Daedric damn what they think, or you're a Sea Sload in disguise.
5082.name: Larval Yaghra

5083.description: Prong-Eared Grimalkins are widely regarded as having supernatural powers thanks to their ability to appear almost instantly when a container of cat food is opened, and to fit themselves into boxes that seem entirely too small for them.
5083.name: Prong-Eared Grimalkin

5084.description: Native to Summerset Isle, the gaudy Coral Mudcrab has elaborate coral growths on its back, as well as a claw that looks comically over-sized, but which is surprisingly functional. Count fingers after petting.
5084.name: Coral Mudcrab

5085.description: For mortals good in heart and soul, being in the presence of a Springtide Indrik induces serenity and makes anger almost impossibleâthough paradoxically it also inspires a righteous determination to fight injustice.
5085.name: Springtide Indrik

5086.description: As savage as Welwas are, history indicates that every pastoral society in Craglorn's long historyâNedes, Yokudans, Goblins, and Orcsâhas domesticated them at some point. They may be ugly, but they sure are loyal.
5086.name: Longhair Welwa

5087.description: No one can look at the glistening plumage of the Shimmering Indrik and doubt its enchanted nature, for it sparkles with Magicka and virtue. Here is a creature untainted by aggression, though it will ably defend itself at need.
5087.name: Shimmering Indrik

5088.description: The giant crimson beetles that scuttle through the gloom of Mephala's Spiral Skein are said to use their pointed probosces to drink the blood of whatever they catch. True or not, it's a fine gruesome story for cultists to tell about their Daedric pets.
5088.name: Skein Shalk

5089.description: It should surprise no one familiar with Mephala, the Webspinner, that spiders are among the most common denizens of the Spiral Skein, the Daedric Prince's Oblivion realm. They're not exactly affectionate pets, but they are fiercely loyal.
5089.name: Skein Spider

5090.description: Knights of the Spider Cult, known as Deathweavers, often disdain the cultists' usual Daedric Spider companions, preferring Skein Scorpions to present a more warlike attitude.
5090.name: Skein Scorpion

5091.description: When Mephala populated the Spiral Skein with "improved" versions of Tamrielic invertebrates, she outdid herself with the Skein Wasp, a giant menacing insect guaranteed to give any mortal the shivers!
5091.name: Skein Wasp

5092.description: When spring comes to the sun-dappled forests of southern Wrothgar, Echatere babies are sometimes born with temporary spotted camouflage that fades as the Echalette matures. It's pretty while it lasts.
5092.name: Fawn Echalette

5093.description: The handsome breed of Masked Bears are native to the Pale Pass region of the Jerall Mountains, which has given rise to the legend that they came in the First Era with the invaders from Akavir who ended up there. Bears from Akavir? Really?
5093.name: Masked Bear Cub

5094.description: This perky but enigmatic equine glows with Magicka through the mystic runes that embellish its possibly-illusory epidermis. Enchanting!
5094.name: Psijic Mascot Pony

5095.description: Are the Psijic Mascot pets real animals with an enchanted appearance, or illusory beast companions created from Magicka? The Psijic monks know which it is, but ask one, and all you get in reply is a smile.
5095.name: Psijic Mascot Wolf Pup

5096.description: The first Guar came to Artaeum when a Psijic advisor to the Tribunal returned from Mournhold with a Pony Guar in the middle of the First Era, and they've been favorites of the Psijics ever since. There's even a glowing Psijic Mascot Guar!
5096.name: Psijic Mascot Guar Calf

5097.description: By tradition, the Psijic Mascot of the order's Ritemaster is always a Bear Cubâbut since there's been only one Ritemaster, Iachesis, for over 3,000 years, the tradition hasn't had much opportunity to change. Fortunately, others can befriend them as well!
5097.name: Psijic Mascot Bear Cub

5098.description: "Some say that Psijic Mascot creatures aren't true animals at all, but illusory constructs created by Psijic monks as portable storage batteries of Magicka," says Sapiarch Soraturil. "What nonsense!"
5098.name: Psijic Mascot Senche Cub

5099.description: "I don't know, something about being followed around by a tame miniature giant elemental amphibian just seems right to me, you know? Expresses my inner newt." âDinuviel Darkwater of Rellenthil
5099.name: Pocket Salamander

5101.description: The thief-god Rajhin is said to have stolen these enchanted purple Ponies from somewhere in Oblivion, but when his worshipers are asked where he got them, they just laugh and say, "Noweyr!"
5101.name: Noweyr Pony

5102.description: This ominous yet playful pet, conjured by Psijic magic in shape of a glowing senche cub, represents an Artaeum monk's regrettable choices that may yet be reversed by proper adherence to the Old Ways.
5102.name: Senche Cub of Scarlet Regret

5105.description: Though eventually it will grow into a massive beast with a vast wingspan, a Fledgling Gryphon is just the right size for a companion creature, and its juvenile antics are hilarious!
5105.name: Fledgling Gryphon

5172.description: When a cub, the young Atmoran Snow Bear is a lap-clambering cuddle bug, a friendly fuzzball whose demeanor is completely at odds with the fierce reputation of adult Snow Bears. Enjoy them while they're still small!
5172.name: Atmoran Snow Bear Cub

5173.description: These fiercely noble Snow Bears are said to have been brought from the legendary frozen continent of Atmora by mighty Ysgramor himself, who deemed them the only worthy avatars of the ancient Nord Bear totem.
5173.name: Atmoran Snow Bear

5176.description: The hissing and twitching farmer who sells these claims they're just ordinary black roosters. And probably they are. You must have just imagined that this Cockerel's eyes glow after dark. You must have!
5176.name: Daemon Cockerel

5179.description: Though Dwarven Metal was usually employed in building Spider constructs, for reasons unknown some rare variants were built with a darker Ebon Steel alloy. When found in working order, these automata are prized by collectors.
5179.name: Ebon Steel Dwarven Spider

5180.description: This extremely rare Dwarven Spider model is surmounted with a double golden crescent, interpreted by scholars of the Dwemer as a "Solar Arc," or tribute to the sunâan iconography otherwise completely unknown among the handiworks of the Deep Elves.
5180.name: Solar Arc Dwarven Spider

5188.description: Craglorn Companions of Belkarth had no luck at all exporting Fellrunners for the High Rock and Hammerfell pet marketsâuntil they sold a flock of the Teal-Faced variety to Fahara'jad's menagerie in Sentinel. Suddenly they were all the rage!
5188.name: Teal-Faced Fellrunner

5190.description: The werewolf hunters of the Silver Dawn rely on the courage and keen noses of these great High Rock hounds to help them track Tamriel's lycanthropes to their lairs.
5190.name: Silver Daenian Werewolf Tracker

5196.description: The Gryphons that nest on the highest pinnacles of Eton Nir, the tallest mountain on Summerset, have a distinctive bluish tint to their plumage. Some sapiarchs call this sky-blue camouflage, but the Priests of Auri-El see in it a touch of the Divine.
5196.name: Azure Fledgling Gryphon

5213.description: Lord of the Nightmare Pack, this night-black Wolf mount has burning paws and flames hissing from its face and tail; can anyone doubt that its origin must be Mehrunes Dagon's plane of the Deadlands?
5213.name: Packlord Nightmare Wolf

5214.description: "Be scaredâbe very scared!" say this pup's big fiery eyes. "Please?" But no matter how much it tries to frighten like a grown-up Nightmare Wolf, this flaming fuzzball is still completely adorable.
5214.name: Nightmare Wolf Pup

5219.description: Summerset's Salamanders are amphibians that, when threatened, defend themselves with an impressive array of elemental powers. The bright orange Lava Line on this breed is an indicator of its reliance on natural Flame magic.
5219.name: Lava Line Salamander

5222.description: If you're looking for a warm and fuzzy companion animal to cuddle with, don't start with the Crested Reef Viper. But if what you want is an intimidating reptilian monster that says "Don't mess with me, city boy," this is the ophidian follower for you.
5222.name: Crested Reef Viper

5223.description: Even as cubs, the litter-mates of the noble Riverhold senche-lion prides exhibit the breed's hallmark attributes of courage and loyalty, bravely defending their masters against encroaching beetles and butterflies!
5223.name: Noble Riverhold Senche-Lion Cub

5224.description: The pastoral tribes of northern Anequina need reliable mounts upon which to follow their herds of livestock, and none are more dependable than the prides of senche-lions bred near Riverhold, feline steeds so brave and loyal they're called "Noble."
5224.name: Noble Riverhold Senche-Lion
5224.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

5225.description: Most inhabitants of Skyrim hate and loathe necromancy, but those Nords who do stoop to raising the dead tend to go all in, wallowing in death and its symbols. It was no doubt such Nord necromancers who bred the skull-faced Death Mask Sabre Cats as mounts.
5225.name: Death Mask Sabre Cat

5226.description: It's no surprise that in the Alik'r Desert, where blooming flowers are rare and prized, that Shorn Camels tattooed with Floral designs are well loved and popular. Covering them with flower designs is even said to make them less ornery!
5226.name: Floral Tattoo Shorn Camel

5236.description: Werewolf hunting is a dirty and largely thankless business, but when a Silver Dawn member mounts their resplendent Argent Charger, they feel like the hero they really are. Sure, it's showy, but as a defender of society against the vicious, you deserve it.
5236.name: Silver Dawn Argent Charger

5244.description: For most people, giant spiders are just loathsome monsters to be destroyed by fire and steel, but Mephala Cultists know that they're highly intelligent (for, you know, arthropods) and surprisingly trainable. The Goldenbacks are by far the friendliest.
5244.name: Goldenback Spider Lackey

5245.description: Every Witches Festival, the haunted legend of a hidden Rivenspire hollow once more comes to lifeâif you can call it thatâand horse riders across Tamriel are cursed to gallop headless through the night on dark and frantic steeds.
5245.name: Hollowjack Rider Horse
5245.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5246.description: Even in the wastes of the Alik'r, far from Rivenspire, when the sun sets on a moonless Witches Festival night riders may find themselves headless, galloping across the darkling dunes on shadowy camels and clutching glimmering Hollowjacks.
5246.name: Hollowjack Rider Camel
5246.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5247.description:
Night winds whisper through the Hollow
And the darknight wolf-pack prowls
Then your wolf-mount turns to follow
And you ride headless as it howls
5247.name: Hollowjack Rider Wolf
5247.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5248.description: The legend of Jaque o' the Hollow has spread even to the misty realms of eastern Tamriel where the Guar roam the woods and marshes, and during the dark nights of the Witches Festival reptile-riders may also find themselves haunted and headless!
5248.name: Hollowjack Rider Guar
5248.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5249.description: When the moons rise over the Witches Festival, Jaque o' the Hollow haunts the mounts of mortals, cursing their riders to gallop headless through the night. Even the doughty bear mounts of the Nords are susceptible.
5249.name: Hollowjack Rider Bear
5249.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5250.description: Jaque o' the Hollow haunts Rivenspire during dark Witches Festival nights, and even those who ride senche-tiger mounts may find themselves padding headless through the moonless dark while waving a glowing gourd.
5250.name: Hollowjack Rider Senche
5250.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5251.description: Conventional wisdom holds that these bizarre and eerie Skull mounts are just horses imbued with a haunting illusory appearanceâbut some whisper that they aren't from Tamriel at all, but summoned from the Hollowjack half-world or demiplane.
5251.name: Hollowjack Wraith-Lantern Steed
5251.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5252.description: Conventional wisdom holds that these bizarre and eerie Skull mounts are just  senche-panthers imbued with a haunting illusory appearanceâbut some whisper that they aren't from Tamriel at all, but summoned from the Hollowjack half-world or demiplane.
5252.name: Hollowjack Flame-Skull Senche
5252.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5253.description: Conventional wisdom holds that these bizarre and eerie Skull mounts are just riding wolves imbued with a haunting illusory appearanceâbut some whisper that they aren't from Tamriel at all, but summoned from the Hollowjack half-world or demiplane.
5253.name: Hollowjack Daedra-Skull Wolf
5253.hint: |cFFFFFFHead removal not supported for companions or players with a Polymorph applied.|r

5458.description: Trophy taken from Z'Maja in honor of an Undaunted victory in Cloudrest.
5458.name: Trophy: Z'Maja

5459.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Cloudrest.
5459.name: Bust: Z'Maja

5460.description: This fan allows its bearer to steal another's face; though at the cost of slowly losing themselves.
5460.name: Fan of False-Face
5460.hint: Acquired by completing the "Relics of Summerset" achievement.

5470.description: It's said that when Meridia's Aurorans need mounts in Tamriel they conjure these shining Warhorses out of pure light. Perhaps so, but they're certainly solid enough to support a heavily armed warrior at the charge!
5470.name: Auroran Zenith Warhorse

5471.description: Like their mistress, the Daedric Prince Meridia, Aurorans have magical control over color and hue, so when they need a mount in Tamriel after dark it's no surprise that they conjure Warhorses that are as dark as night itself.
5471.name: Auroran Twilight Warhorse

5539.description: This headstrong crystal skull ignored your decision to give it away and elected to stay with you instead. It could tell you all about the sublime mysteries of creation, but would much rather rant, joke, and complain.
5539.name: Augur of the Obscure
5539.hint: Acquired by completing the "Psijic Sage" achievement.

5547.description: While it's unclear whether this little netch understands the nuances behind the Witches Festival's many traditions, its joyous tootling is reason enough to let it join in the celebrations.
5547.name: Witches Festival Ghost Netch

5548.description: Less common than the usual variety, the Pale-Plume Gryphons are found only along the seacoast cliffs near the Tower of Dusk in southeast Summerset. Their Fledglings make engaging pets that can be trained to follow their masters even into danger.
5548.name: Pale-Plume Fledgling Gryphon

5549.description: It's believed by some of the Sapiarchs of the High Elves that an Onyx Indrik comes about when a Nascent Indrik is exposed to certain berries imbued with geological Earthbones essences.
5549.name: Onyx Indrik
5549.hint: Obtained by combining four different Onyx Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Onyx Indrik.

5550.description: Some find it strange that the Pure-Snow Indrik should exist in Summerset, where winter never comes, but as the Sapiarch of Elemental Arcana points out, "Frost magic works everywhere."
5550.name: Pure-Snow Indrik
5550.hint: Obtained by combining four different Pure-Snow Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Pure-Snow Indrik.

5551.description: Calamity and mischance seem to follow in the hoofprints of this dark chargerâbut not for its rider! Gallop into battle on the back of this Soot Stallion and curse your opponents with all the ill luck of Black Fredas!
5551.name: Black Fredas Soot Stallion

5552.description: When the dro-m'Athra ride from the Dark Behind the World, they go mounted on these dread steeds: the Rahd-m'Athra! Are they spirits from the Dark Moons, or tangible creatures of evil?
5552.name: Rahd-m'Athra

5553.description: "Almost every stablemaster of the Marsh has fine, scaly lizard mounts available for purchase in various forms, all familiar to dryskins but specifically adapted to deep swamp conditions. So convenient, our lizard-steeds, so scaly and personable!" âUkaspa
5553.name: Wolf-Lizard Steed

5554.description: "More than once I have been asked, 'Ukaspa, why are your lizard-steeds shaped like mounts from other parts of Tamriel? Why aren't your so-very-handsome mounts shaped like, well, lizards?' These are good questions!" âUkaspa of Lilmoth
5554.name: Senche-Lizard Steed

5555.description: "Some dryskins ask, 'Since a Guar is already a swamp reptile mount, why create Lizard-Steeds shaped like Guar? Isn't that somewhat redundant?' These dryskins are unusually perceptive!" âUkaspa of Lilmoth
5555.name: Guar-Lizard Steed

5556.description: "Maybe the Camel-Lizard was created so we heroic Argonian adventurers could travel in arid climes like Anequinaâor maybe it was so heroic Khajiiti adventurers could have something to ride in Black Marsh. I don't know, I just want one." âHeem-Jas
5556.name: Camel-Lizard Steed

5557.description: "So, it's a Bear. Only it's a Lizard. And you can ride it? Shor's bones! That's all I need to know. I'll take it!" âCelebrated Nord Envoy Rigurt the Brash
5557.name: Bear-Lizard Steed

5558.description: "Sometimes Argonians want to travel a long way for a long time, and how do people do that? On mounts! And so useful lizards become Lizard Steeds of proven shapes, and then Argonians can ride, tall in the saddle and proud!" âUkaspa of Lilmoth
5558.name: Horse-Lizard Steed

5559.description: A Frost Mage of Clan Direnni spent her entire life perfecting a spell to permanently summon a Frost Atronach in the shape of a Sabre Cat. (Why? Who knows? Balfiera Island is a strange place.)
5559.name: Sabre Cat Frost Atronach

5560.description: Argonian heavy troops are informally known as Shellbacksâso inevitably, their heavy cavalry mounts are called Shellback Warhorses. They are among the strongest breeds known.
5560.name: Shellback Warhorse

5561.description: "These Glowgill Guar mounts come from a coastal tribe over near Archon. Handsome, are they not? I've been told they can breathe underwater through those gills, though personally, I have never tested this." âUkaspa, Stablemaster of Lilmoth
5561.name: Glowgill Guar

5562.description: There is some debate among naturalists as to whether the Ice Nixad is a separate breed that is mainly seen in the winter because it hibernates during the warm months, or whether it's just a winter phase of ordinary Nixads that sometimes stays year-round.
5562.name: Ice Nixad

5563.description: Though Argonians do relish the elastic flesh of the Black Marsh Swamp Jellies, the whimsical names they give them refer more to their appearance than to their flavor.
5563.name: Cantaloupe Swamp Jelly

5564.description: Though the Argonians claim that they name each breed of Black Marsh Swamp Jelly for its hue rather than its taste, there's no denying that the Mint Jelly does have a gratifyingly refreshing flavor.
5564.name: Mint Swamp Jelly

5565.description: The Plum Swamp Jelly is the rarest of the so-called "Flavor" Jellies, and seeing one is considered by many Argonians to be a sign of good fortune. It's not at all unusual for an Argonian to wear a Plum Jelly's feeler as a "Good Luck Tentacle."
5565.name: Plum Swamp Jelly

5600.description: The Witches Festival, which celebrates horror and death, also has a regrettable tradition of wanton vandalism associated with it, especially among Tamriel's callow youth. The so-called "Hollowjack Netch" appears to be a victim of this practice.
5600.name: Hollowjack Netch

5601.description: On the highest pinnacles of Eton Nir, where the snow never melts, live the pale Snowcap Gryphons. Perfectly camouflaged for a life in the clouds, for most of the First Era they were considered to be a myth.
5601.name: Snowcap Fledgling Gryphon

5602.description: Trophy taken from Vykosa the Ascendant in honor of an Undaunted victory in Moon Hunter Keep.
5602.name: Trophy: Vykosa the Ascendant
5602.hint: Awarded for completing Moon Hunter Keep.

5603.description: Trophy taken from Balorgh in honor of an Undaunted victory in March of Sacrifices.
5603.name: Trophy: Balorgh
5603.hint: Awarded for completing March of Sacrifices.

5604.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Moon Hunter Keep.
5604.name: Bust: Vykosa the Ascendant
5604.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Moon Hunter Keep.

5605.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in March of Sacrifices.
5605.name: Bust: Balorgh
5605.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran March of Sacrifices.

5619.description: Is this just a dark fowl, mere poultry of sinister visageâor does it hail from realms beyond Nirn, mayhap from the Deadlands of Mehrunes Dagon or the Ashpit of Malacath? Dare you ask yourself the dread question: Which came first?
5619.name: Daemon Chicken

5620.description: A hardy domestic chicken found all along Skyrim's White River, said to have been originally bred in the old town of Riverwood. Owners grow extremely attached to them, and become outraged if they're harmed.
5620.name: Riverwood White Hen

5639.description: The Psijic Order has bred these senches for centuries, selecting only the brightest among the litters to sire the next generation. Psijics who choose them as companions often form telepathic bonds and claim they are wonderful conversationalists.
5639.name: Sagacious Psijic Senche

5640.description: Though the Psijics are not a combat order, the monks do concede a need for protection when venturing beyond Artaeum, and when their fighting escorts need to be mounted, they conjure up these impressive warhorses for them.
5640.name: Psijic Escort Charger

5642.description: As a sign of the blessing of Mara, Goddess of Fertility, in spring certain breeds of Tamriel's hens lay eggs with shells in a variety of colors.
5642.name: Mara's Spring Chicken

5652.description: Hardy and good-natured, the faithful Skyrim Paint Pony wants to be near its master regardless of the weather, leaning into the wind even in a tundra blizzard.
5652.name: Scruffy Skyrim Paint Pony

5656.description: Though obviously related to the netches of northeast Tamriel, the swamp jellies of southern Black Marsh also have a disquieting resemblance to aquatic jellyfish. Natural philosophers have no adequate explanation for this.
5656.name: Swamp Jelly
5656.hint: Acquired by finding its seven Runebox Fragments in Cyrodilic Collections Daily Contract Recompense containers and combining them.

5657.description: This little critter's bright, beautiful colors are actually a warning to predators that it's a potent mouthful of poison. Fortunately for Tamriel's humanoid mortals, its venom affects them as no more than a mild hallucinogen.
5657.name: Kaleidotropic Dragon Frog

5658.description: "The Butterscotch Dragon Frog presumably got its name from the Argonian practice of naming creatures after flavors, whether those things taste like that or not. This one has no intention of finding out whether it does." âM'aiq the Liar
5658.name: Butterscotch Dragon Frog

5659.description: All the large Salamanders of southern Tamriel have elemental powers, but some specialize in particular forces; the Flame Skin breed, for example, almost ripples with fire.
5659.name: Flame Skin Salamander

5660.description: The large, lumbering Salamanders of southern Tamriel are known for defending themselves with various elemental burstsâall but one, the Toxin Skin variety, which relies on venom instead. Not even the Sapiarchs of the Crystal Tower can account for it.
5660.name: Toxin Skin Salamander

5661.description: The lumbering great Salamanders of southern Tamriel all defend themselves with bursts of elemental power, but the Shock Skin variety specializes in electrical discharges. Fortunately, they can be trained not to zap their masters!
5661.name: Shock Skin Salamander

5662.description: "Cats with odd-colored eyes see into the depths of those around them. Those with white fur? They see into time itself." âZamarak
5662.name: Prong-Eared Odd-Eyed Cat

5697.description: "It is hard to start a campfire in the damps of the deep marsh, yes? Not when you have a Scorching Horse-Lizard! With one of these as your mount, you will never again have to eat cold eel stew!" âUkaspa, Stablemaster of Lilmoth
5697.name: Scorching Horse-Lizard

5698.description: "The Dwarven Spider Mounts from the Infernium Forge are unusual and distinctive, indicating to this Dwemer scholar that they all come from the hand of a single Deep Elf artisan." âGuylaine Marilie
5698.name: Infernium Dwarven Spider

5699.description: "The Dwarven Spiderlings from the Infernium Forge are unusual and distinctive, indicating to this Dwemer scholar that they all come from the hand of a single Deep Elf artisan." âGuylaine Marilie
5699.name: Infernium Dwarven Spiderling

5705.description: "This Chilling Senche-Lizard is quite rare; it comes from very deep in the swamp, from a tribe said to be dedicated to Frost spells as a means of living longer by living slower. Their Hist tree even drips with icicles (whatever they are)!" âUkaspa
5705.name: Chilling Senche-Lizard

5706.description: "Nothing says 'Back off!' like riding into town on a mount so seething with poison that it glows in the dark. When one comes from a place as bizarre as Black Marsh, one really has to go over the top to be impressive." âUkaspa of Lilmoth
5706.name: Venomous Wolf-Lizard

5707.description: When Imperials of Akaviri descent settled in and around Rimmen toward the end of the Potentate, something about these local Ringtailed Wolves found favor with them, and they domesticated and bred them into distinctive mounts.
5707.name: Rimmen Ringtailed Wolf

5708.description: Largest of all the furstocks, or "breeds" of Khajiit, the Senche-raht is fully intelligent, and in combat often serves simultaneously as warrior and mount.
5708.name: Senche-Raht

5709.description: "As the Sub-Sapiarch of Domestic Livestock, I was assigned by Larnatille to breed an appropriate mount for our sages to ride upon when working in the field. I proudly present my result: the loyal and majestic senche-serval!" âCorderil of Sunhold
5709.name: Sapiarchic Senche-Serval
5709.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

5710.description: As an incarnate nature spirit, an Indrik first appears in its comparatively drab Nascent form before somehow differentiating into one of their more splendid variations.
5710.name: Nascent Indrik

5712.description: This smaller breed of haj mota lurks in the brackish estuaries of Black Marsh's southern coast, camouflaged by the gray color of the murky tidewater. When hand-raised from hatching, they make surprisingly pleasant pets.
5712.name: Slateback Haj Mota

5713.description: A haj mota is an ambush predator, waiting patiently in concealment until its prey should come into attack range. The Verdigris breed tends to hide in algae-covered pools where its color acts as camouflage.
5713.name: Verdigris Haj Mota
5713.hint: Acquired by traveling to Lilmoth in Murkmire for the first time.

5714.description: Though the adult Bear-Lizards can be quite intimidating, even fearsome, the roly-poly lizard cubs are disarmingly cute. (For reptiles, that is.)
5714.name: Bear-Lizard Cub

5715.description: When young Argonian egg-siblings tell their creche-parents they want a pony, this is what they mean. And now that you've seen it, don't you want one, too?
5715.name: Pony-Lizard

5716.description: True, it does hiss rather than meow, and has shiny scales rather than soft fur, but otherwise the Senche-Lizard Cub is just as adorable as any other kitten.
5716.name: Senche-Lizard Cub

5717.description: The Wolf-Lizard Pup is simply adorable when it tries to howl, just hisses instead, and looks ever so confused.
5717.name: Wolf-Lizard Pup

5718.description: Though you know it's just going to grow up and become big, dumb, scaly livestock, how can you resist those lizard-calf eyes?
5718.name: Guar-Lizard Calf

5719.description: Most Echalettes are docile and fawn-like, but not the Badger Ruff breed, which are strangely fierce and irritable. They're so ornery they've been known to chase away inquisitive Sabre Cats.
5719.name: Badger Ruff Echalette

5720.description: The migratory Monarch Butterfly is a common sight across all of southern Tamriel, and it's seen in the northern provinces during summer. The Monarch is said to represent the souls of the present, in contrast to the Ancestor Moth that represents the past.
5720.name: Monarch Butterfly

5721.description: "Ha ha! Fooled you, didn't it? Looks just like a Baby Dragon, doesn't it? Well, there are no such things, and you should know better. It's just an Illusion Imp with a rather Peryite look to it. Baby Dragon, really!" âAbnur Tharn
5721.name: Green Dragon Imp

5722.description: "The Jerboas, you say? Ah, yes, the little jumping skeevers with the so-big ears. There are many in the Ashen Scar, and if you catch one when it's small, it makes for a pleasant, fuzzy friend. I had one when I was a kitten!" âShuzirri of Riverhold
5722.name: Ashen Scar Jerboa

5723.description: The legend among the underworld explorers of the Undaunted is that these little incendiary sprites are responsible for lighting all the candles, torches, and lanterns found burning underground, flying ahead of adventurers to ignite them in the dark.
5723.name: Brimstone Nixad

5765.description: The rare and colorful Shock Nixad looks rather like a tiny, winged Storm Atronach, though without the whirling electric rocks. They make loyal companionsâthough they may also make your hair stand on end!
5765.name: Blue Shock Nixad

5846.description: The Hot Pepper Bantam Guar breed is native to the "spice island" of Esroniet, the source of much of Tamriel's nutmeg, cloves, mace, and hot peppers. And the Pepper Guar has a spicy little personality to go with its name!
5846.name: Hot Pepper Bantam Guar

5847.description: "The recesses of our nightmares contain horrors that we often cannot look at. Yet we must, lest these pockets of terror fester and grow. To light your path, I present this bantam guar. Please do not squeal." â Overheard in a dark alley
5847.name: Eerie Violet Bantam Guar

5848.description: When asked about the rumor that the Hot-Blooded Bantam Guar had been bred as a vampiric sub-species by the disgraced mage Darvasen before he was exiled from Shad Astula, Arch-Mage Valeyn replied, "What nonsense! They just like to eat tomatoes. Trust me."
5848.name: Hot-Blooded Bantam Guar

5849.description: Start with a dollop of wiggly cuteness, add a dash of the Coldharbour glow, and you get a bantam guar that causes "oohs!" and "ahhhs!" wherever you go, plus helps you avoid stubbing your toe at night when you leave your bed. Genius!
5849.name: Coldharbour Bantam Guar

5850.description: "A fur-less, cold-blooded reptile with icy blue eyes that comes from the frozen, far-north, and in-all-likelihood legendary continent of Atmora? Bah. I refuse to believe it." âPhrastus of Elinhir
5850.name: Atmoran Bantam Guar

5851.description: It may look cute, but this volcanic little pest comes from Mehrunes Dagon's Oblivion plane of the Deadlands: it's got lava in its blood and fire in its eyes, so keep it away from the curtains.
5851.name: Deadlands Bantam Guar

5852.description: A donkey might not be the most glamorous pack animal, but it's certainly the hardiest and most sure-footed, toting heavy loads through desert, mountains, and tundra without complaint â¦ though it will give you a dirty look, and might nip if you turn away!
5852.name: Explorer's Pack Donkey
5852.hint: |cffffffPurchasing this pet increases your inventory capacity by 5 slots on all characters account wide.|r

5853.description: According to Nord legend, in its native land of Atmora this Chub Loon is much larger, as tall as two warriors and with a squawk that starts avalanches. It took mighty Ysgramor a day and a night to wrestle one down from Shivering Glacier. What, you doubt?
5853.name: Atmoran Chub Loon

5854.description: Stolid, careful, sturdy, and long-suffering, the Treasure Hunter's Horse is resigned to a life of being ridden into crumbling ruins by a reckless master who's searching for wealth but often finds only danger.
5854.name: Treasure Hunter's Horse

5855.description: North of Windhelm in Skyrim, where the snow on the heights never melts, the Nords' great Wolfhounds have lighter and fluffier fur coats. In addition to barking, they even howl a bit like the wolves they pursue.
5855.name: Winterhold Wolfhound

5856.description: One might think that being frozen in a glacier for several thousand years would damage a delicate mechanism like a Dwarven Spider, but in the case of the Icebound units it seems instead to have preserved them in perfect working order.
5856.name: Icebound Dwarven Spider
5856.hint: Awarded for completing the "Frostvault Conqueror" Achievement.

5857.description: "The forces of Nocturnal's attempted invasion of the Colored Rooms were inadvertently accompanied by some Evergloam Daedrats, which afterward were rounded up, Lustrated for purification, and then banished to Nirn." âSapiarch Galaadil
5857.name: Lustrated Daedrat

5858.description: According to the notebooks of Corvus Direnni, the frost senche-panther may actually be a form of atronach summoned from a plane known as the Fourth Sinus of Takubar. Why it remains in Tamriel where it willingly submits to the orders of mortals is unknown.
5858.name: Dragonscale Frost Senche

5859.description: "I have been fortunate enough to have personally glimpsed a Solar Horse on an Anequine morning, and I say with conviction that it must be a creature of Magrus, the Cat's Eye, and no other." âMoon-Bishop Hunal
5859.name: Dragonscale Solar Horse

5861.description: "Our Lady of the Infinite Energies, Strict but Fair Arbiter of Inner Luminance, grant unto thy most devoted worshiper a sign of thy radiant favor, mayhap a loveable, glowing Sabre Cat cub." âSayings of Valasha
5861.name: Meridian Sabre Cub

5862.description: Tired of pets that follow you everywhere? Fed up with feeding them? Step up to Pebble Pal, the pet that's a â¦ rock.
5862.name: Pebble Pal
5862.hint: |cff0000This pet cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r

5863.description: Pining for a perfect pet? Perhaps you're a person who'd prefer a pleasantly playful piglet, pearly-white, pretty, and partial to paladins and protectors!
5863.name: Pink Pearl Pig

5864.description: The Dwarven Theodolite was a sort of automated measuring device designed to explore and survey subterranean areas; this version is notable for its distinctive red "eye."
5864.name: Carnelian Theodolite

5865.description: "I would speculate that the Storm Wolf is the result of an experiment by a powerful Destruction mage in which a wild canine was subjected to prolonged exposure to a Meip Glyph of Shock." âGabrielle Benele, Wizard
5865.name: Dragonscale Storm Wolf

5866.description: The rare Sweetroll Grizzly Bears prowl the golden forests of the Rift on the northern slopes of the Jerall Mountains. They're big strong cuddly hug machinesâexcept when they're angry.
5866.name: Sweetroll Grizzly

5867.description: Deep in the shadows of the Tenmar Forest, hidden by its camouflaged coat and stealthy stalking, the Senche-Tiger is a nearly invisible jungle predator. Even as a mount, it retains something of the air of mystery it wears in the wild.
5867.name: Tenmar Senche-Tiger

5868.description: Though in coloration the Glenumbra Border Wolf resembles certain Breton dog breeds, this sturdy and stoic mount is no dog, and will carry a High Rock courier for leagues through dark night and heavy weather.
5868.name: Glenumbra Border Wolf

5869.description: "Some accounts of Meridia's plane of the Colored Rooms describe a menagerie of light-imbued spectral beasts elevated from Nirn and 'purified' by the Lady's holy light." âSayings of Valasha
5869.name: Meridian Sabre Cat

5870.description: During the Jester's Festival even the lowliest of commoners can pretend to be a mounted knight with a whimsical Novelty Stick steed. Horses are popular in the Daggerfall Covenant.
5870.name: Novelty Stick Horse
5870.hint: |cff0000This mount doesn't increase your movement speed. Riding Lessons don't affect its appearance. This mount cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r

5871.description: Shorn Camels are desert mounts with elaborate Tattoos on their hide where once there were wiry bristles. The "Verdant," with its repeating floral designs, may be the most beautiful of them all.
5871.name: Verdant Tattoo Shorn Camel

5872.description: Frankly, compared to war horses, bear mounts, and even saddle guars, it's hard for Camels to look magnificentâuntil you dress them in Dragonscale Bard. Then look out!
5872.name: Dragonscale Barded Camel

5873.description: "This one doesn't sell many Guars here at the Riverhold Stables because Khajiit are folk who value their natural dignity and prefer not to ride so silly a beast. But a Guar in Dragonscale Bard is a thing of beauty!" â Master Groom Zarbi'dahuz
5873.name: Dragonscale Barded Guar

5874.description: "Our distant cousins, the senche-mounts, look so majestic in Dragonscale Bard, like creatures who've just stepped out of an ancient wall-frieze in Dune. Perhaps these pesky Dragons have a use after all, yes?" â Master Groom Zarbi'dahuz
5874.name: Dragonscale Barded Senche

5875.description: "I had always thought the Helkarn Wolf to be Elsweyr's finest Wolf mount, but that was before I saw a cavalry Wolf in Dragonscale Bard. Could a mount look any more martial?" â Master Groom Zarbi'dahuz
5875.name: Dragonscale Barded Wolf

5876.description: Dragonscale bard is just about the heaviest armor one can put on a mount, but bears bred as mounts are so strong they scarcely seem to notice it.
5876.name: Dragonscale Barded Bear

5877.description: "Dragons are a pain in the tailbones, yes? But their scales make such superb steed armor! The Dragonscale Barded War-Horse may be the sharpest mount this one has ever seen!" â Master Groom Zarbi'dahuz
5877.name: Dragonscale Barded War-Horse

5878.description: The Daggerfall Dapple is a hardy horse breed that comes from the Farwatch region of Glenumbra between Daggerfall and Camlorn. Known for its endurance, it's a favorite of long-distance riders.
5878.name: Daggerfall Dapple Horse

5879.description: During the Jester's Festival even the lowliest of commoners can pretend to be a mounted knight with a whimsical Novelty Stick steed. Guars are popular in the Aldmeri Dominion.
5879.name: Novelty Stick Guar
5879.hint: |cff0000This mount doesn't increase your movement speed. Riding Lessons don't affect its appearance. This mount cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r

5880.description: During the Jester's Festival even the lowliest of commoners can pretend to be a mounted knight with a whimsical Novelty Stick steed. Dragons are popular in the Ebonheart Pact.
5880.name: Novelty Stick Dragon
5880.hint: |cff0000This mount doesn't increase your movement speed. Riding Lessons don't affect its appearance. This mount cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r

5930.description: This meticulous reproduction of the ancient Argonian calendar may not have the storied history of the original, but is a masterpiece of stonework in its own right.
5930.name: Replica of the Xinchei-Konu
5930.hint: Awarded for bringing all twelve tablets of the Xinchei-Konu to Jekka-Wass Vozei at the Xinchei-Konu Monument northeast of Lilmoth.

6013.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Blackrose Prison.
6013.name: Bust: Drakeeh the Unchained
6013.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Blackrose Prison.

6014.description: Trophy taken from Drakeeh the Unchained in honor of an Undaunted victory in Blackrose Prison.
6014.name: Trophy: Drakeeh the Unchained

6018.description: The Coffee Scorpion gets its name from the way they like their kaveh in Rihad: strong, dark, and sweet. (Well, I guess two out of three isn't bad.)
6018.name: Rihad Coffee Scorpion

6032.description: The uncanny Gloam Wolf hails from the Oblivion plane of the Daedric Prince Nocturnal. Sometimes, the Night Mistress will reward a loyal Tamrielic worshiper with a Gloam Wolf Mount sent permanently to Nirn.
6032.name: Gloam Wolf

6033.description: The many multicolored eggs of Tamriel are valuable for their differing alchemical properties, and this makes the Egg Hunter's job a profitable one, especially in the spring.
6033.name: Egg Hunter's Horse

6034.description: Hailing from Nocturnal's Oblivion realm of Evergloam, the Gloam Wolf Cub seems to oscillate like an optical illusion between adorable and sinister.
6034.name: Gloam Wolf Cub

6035.description: According to Nibenese legend, a house where its owner was murdered will be haunted by the shade of their cat, sent from beyond by Lord Hollowjack to torment the killer with eternal shame and guilt.
6035.name: Ghostly Housecat

6036.description: Is this ghostly Elk an antlered mount from the spirit world, or is it a sending from Lord Hircine's Oblivion plane of the Hunting Grounds? It seems solid enough, and doesn't disappear in broad daylight, so it must be more than just a haunt!
6036.name: Eerie Elk of Dread

6037.description: Unlike most Gryphons, which catch live prey, the Vulture Gryphons subsist primarily on carrion. But they're still majestic, and their young Fledglings still make adorable pets!
6037.name: Fledgling Vulture Gryphon

6053.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Azura, bearing Moon and Star sigils.
6053.name: Statuette: Azura, Moon and Star

6054.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Hircine, the Huntsman.
6054.name: Statuette: Hircine, the Huntsman

6055.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Molag Bal, Lord of Brutality.
6055.name: Statuette: Molag Bal, the Brutal

6056.description: A miniature statue of the living god Lord Vivec, Warrior-Poet.
6056.name: Statuette: Vivec, Warrior-Poet

6057.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Clavicus Vile, holding aloft his Masque.
6057.name: Statuette: Clavicus Vile, Masque

6058.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Sheogorath, the Mad God.
6058.name: Statuette: Sheogorath, the Mad

6059.description: "A 'Baby Dragon,' you say? No such thing. What you have there is a clever Illusion Imp that's found a way to get free handouts and a warm place to sleep. Young folk these days: so gullible." âDivayth Fyr
6059.name: Blue Dragon Imp

6060.description: Trophy taken from King Narilmor in honor of an Undaunted victory in Depths of Malatar.
6060.name: Trophy: King Narilmor
6060.hint: Awarded for completing Depths of Malatar.

6061.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Depths of Malatar.
6061.name: Bust: King Narilmor
6061.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Depths of Malatar.

6062.description: Trophy taken from The Stonekeeper in honor of an Undaunted victory in Frostvault.
6062.name: Trophy: The Stonekeeper

6063.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Frostvault.
6063.name: Bust: The Stonekeeper

6064.description: Arena Lions are trained to absolute obedience, whether as sturdy and savage Craglorn companions or as pit-fighting beasts taught to drag out a kill for the entertainment of an audience.
6064.name: Elinhir Arena Lion
6064.hint: Acquired by combining 40 Arena Gladiator's Proofs, available by completing Conquest Missions in Cyrodiil, with an Arena Gladiator's Roar, available for purchase from War Researchers in Cyrodiil.

6181.description: With the Baandari Pedlar Camel as your mount, you can go farther between water breaks, plus enjoy the sight of camel spit distressing those unlucky enough to be in range.
6181.name: Baandari Pedlar Camel

6182.description: The well-traveled Baandari Pedlars lend their style to this horse's tack, creating a look any lover of rich hues would die for. Today it can be yoursâwith no need to die!
6182.name: Baandari Pedlar Steed

6183.description: The Baandari Pedlars find the keen sense of smell that their wolf mounts possess to be a useful source of extra profit. They sometimes offer their services as trackers, but only if other profit is not at hand!
6183.name: Baandari Pedlar Brindle Wolf

6184.description: For years, the Baandari Pedlars have traveled hither and yon, requiring them to train and equip mounts for both comfort and utility. Now you too can ride a colorful guar mount that has that Baandari style!
6184.name: Baandari Pedlar Guar

6185.description: Prone to rumbles and purrs, the Baandari Pedlar Senche-Lion serves as both a mount and a source of warmth on cold evenings around the campfire. Just watch out for that rasping tongue.
6185.name: Baandari Pedlar Senche-Lion

6186.description: The colors exhibited by the Cerulean Scorpion make it a creature sought after by artists and by those who prefer their companions to have a bit of a sting to them.
6186.name: Cerulean Scorpion

6187.description: In their travels, the Baandari Pedlars have shown off their pack ponies to the delight of children everywhere. Recently they began selling them, and now children put even more pressure on parents to acquire them.
6187.name: Pedlar Pack Pony

6188.description: Even the pups receive the full Baandari Pedlar tack treatment! These wolf cubs are often seen chasing each other around those seeking wares from the Pedlars, sometimes tripping up customers until they're trained to know better.
6188.name: Pedlar Pack Wolf Cub

6189.description: The Baandari Pedlars first used these repurposed mechanized spiders to help retrieve things that got lost in crevices and the like. For the right price, they may sell you one.
6189.name: Pedlar Pack Spider

6190.description: To prepare their Senche-Lion mounts, the Baandari Pedlars train them with full gear as cubs. Despite the tack, these cubs pounce and play as kittens do.
6190.name: Pedlar Pack Senche-Lion Cub

6191.description: Need some happiness in your day? The Alabaster Jerboa is your answer. Its hopping and air-dancing acrobatics can bring a smile to even the grumpiest Dark Elf.
6191.name: Alabaster Jerboa

6192.description: Before ice-fire senche-lions become mounts, they start as adorable cubs. But be careful! These cute creatures still require careful handling due to their mix of cold and flame.
6192.name: Sunspire Ice-Fire Senche-Cub

6193.description: A traditional gift to successful Dragon Hunters, this pup exhibits the same courage that these hunters must have, and also reminds them of the lives they're protecting with their ongoing work.
6193.name: Elder Dragon Hunter Wolf Pup

6194.description: Originally bred to find and kill rats on the docks of the Iliac Bay, the Breton Terrier has found a place in the hearts and minds of many Tamrielics due to its joyful and wriggly behavior.
6194.name: Breton Terrier

6195.description: "While carrying out an assignment from Larnatille in my role as Sub-Sapiarch of Domestic Livestock, I created a mount both loyal and majestic. Though the kitten stage is â¦ a bit trying." âCorderil of Sunhold
6195.name: Senche-Serval Kitten

6196.description: The discovery of this "lynx" created waves in noble circles when certain of their number realized they could have a feline around without succumbing to fur-based allergies. Now you see them everywhere.
6196.name: Sphynx Lynx

6198.description: Originally bred for a reclusive family in Rivenspire, the Indigo Senche-Panther possesses a distinctive black fur that has a purple sheen. Rumors claim that when left to its own devices, it stalks werewolves for amusement.
6198.name: Indigo Senche-Panther

6199.description: Bred for speed and battle, the White Spotted Courser holds a special place in the hearts of war historians due to their prominence as cavalry mounts in the Battle of Dragon Wall.
6199.name: White Spotted Courser

6200.description: When summoned, this warrior mount of the deathless Anka-Ra mystically amalgamates, drawing sand and strength from the distant Alik'r.
6200.name: Anka-Ra Sandcamel

6201.description: Not only is this vamidium crafted from an Ebony and Ebon Steel alloy, but it also has the form of a Dwarven Spider, making it a must-have for those who prefer dark clothes and darker lives.
6201.name: Ebony Dwarven Spider

6202.description: A combination of feline agility with the power of a sandstorm makes this mount both a favored and feared battle companion of the eternally loyal Anka-Ra warriors.
6202.name: Anka-Ra Senche-Lion

6203.description: Ready to rule the arena? With the Arena Gladiator Horse as your steed, you'll do so in flashy style. Each one has received special training from former gladiatorial champions that makes it a practical and dashing choice.
6203.name: Arena Gladiator Horse

6204.description: The long-lost Dwemer never spread as far as Elsweyr, but the Baandari Pedlars go everywhere, and will adapt even ancient technology to their uses.
6204.name: Baandari Dwarven Spider

6205.description: Ride like the Bringer of Disease and Pestilence that you want to be! This mount features a saddle with the Peryite cult symbol upon it, giving those who spot you a chance to fear their imminent and loathsome doom.
6205.name: Steed of the Afflicted

6206.description: Born in flame, this senche-lion's temperament matches its fiery appearance. Those who earn its respect, however, gain a mount that can blaze a path through the darkest shadows.
6206.name: Blazeborn Senche-Lion

6207.description: Dragon Hunters, take heed! This mount has received elite training that enables it to fearlessly stand fast even in Dragon breath. Some claim that the final, secret test of these mounts is what imbues their eyes with a blue glow.
6207.name: Skyterror Dragonslayer Horse

6208.description: With Dragons on the loose in Elsweyr, a modern cadre of Dragon Hunters have sprung up to hunt them down. Their mounts are sturdy and fearless.
6208.name: Elder Dragon Hunter Horse

6246.description: This sleek and light-hued mount hails from Verkarth, where some warriors drill both night and day to earn the right to train a young one as a battle mount. Now more widely available, you too can add one to your stable.
6246.name: Verkarth Senche-Lioness

6294.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Malacath, the Orc-Father.
6294.name: Statuette: Malacath, Orc-Father

6376.description:
This Alfiq banker stands ready to fulfill your personal banking needsâexcept in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, which make her nervous.

When summoned, her services can be used by you and your groupmates.
6376.name: Ezabi the Banker

6378.description:
This Alfiq merchant buys your non-stolen wares as often as you need him toâbut not in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, which Fezez avoids due to "considerations of extreme danger."

When summoned, his services can be used by you and your groupmates.
6378.name: Fezez the Merchant

6381.description: The reason behind the creation of this tabby was simple: Cats kill rodents. Mummified and mobile cats will kill rodents indefinitely. Thus this bandage-bound pet was â¦ born?
6381.name: Grisly Mummy Tabby
6381.hint: Acquired by finding and using ten Mummified Alfiq Parts from the Rimmen Necropolis Public Dungeon.

6382.description: "Sometimes pups hear the call. To defend against claws. To rend wings. When they show up, we train them."âJavinda, Dragonslayer
6382.name: Skyterror Dragonslayer Pup

6401.description: "Dark as a starless night, Cult of the New Moon bears move through shadows silently to attack their prey. Never anger one of these." âJonnet of the Sunwalkers
6401.name: New Moon Bear

6402.description: "I would ride this steed with great care. Its barding? The stuff of nightmares. Perhaps I intend that pun. Perhaps not."âJonnet of the Sunwalkers
6402.name: New Moon Horse

6403.description: "The eyes of this guar feel like they're reaching into my soul. As it turns out, that was a warning. It bit my hand soon after."âJonnet of the Sunwalkers
6403.name: New Moon Guar

6404.description: "Those seeking their way on dark sands should consider the New Moon Camel. Some say it feeds off the night itself. I say maybe so."âJonnet of the Sunwalkers
6404.name: New Moon Camel

6405.description: "Of all the wolves one could ride through gloom, this one is the best. Of course, if you're not the one riding it, watch out. You might be its prey."âJonnet of the Sunwalkers
6405.name: New Moon Wolf

6406.description: "Senche steeds are already quiet. This one? It  moves as if it is the avatar of silence."âJonnet of the Sunwalkers
6406.name: New Moon Senche

6434.description: "Do not ask me how this creature came to be. Or not be. It just is. But, perhaps do not kill chickens in already-haunted places."âGeem-Sai, Butcher
6434.name: Spectral Chicken

6435.description: "Gah! Netches! Mine kept getting stuck behind closed doors. So my friend and I made this ghostly netch. Yours for a song, five-claw! Not at all necromantic. Promise!"âLanjo, merchant
6435.name: Haunting Netch

6436.description: "A daedrat I killed ended up following me home â¦ as a ghost. Now I use it to keep my relatives from staying with me."âTheldyn Faden, Explorer
6436.name: Ghostly Daedrat

6437.description: Though mystery shrouds this mount's origin, it currently serves as the preferred steed of several known Vampires. Ride these mounts with pride (and no small measure of caution).
6437.name: Sanguivorian Howler

6439.description: Add this cute bat to your menagerie. Not only does it eat pesky bugs, but it'll keep you company on your adventures!
6439.name: Long-Winged Bat

6440.description: Riders of these senche-panthers often find their welcomes worn out while in town, but their journeys across wilderness can be strangely trouble-free.
6440.name: Plagueborn Senche-Panther

6441.description: This steed's blue markings glow, indicating its exposure to the energies of the Planemeld. Its glimmering eyes possess a frightening intelligence that seems unnatural for a horse.
6441.name: Planemeld Courser

6442.description: As the Dragon threat spreads, the need for veteran Dragon Hunters increases. These gold-barded horses can help you reach your prey quickly.
6442.name: Ancient Dragon Hunter Horse

6443.description: "Occasionally one grows tired of the crush of humanity. To that end, I bought this Death Hound. Now I cannot enter most taverns, but I also don't have people crowding my space."âTheldyn Faden, Explorer
6443.name: Death Hound

6444.description: This imp, after being caged by Vampires, freed itself and can now join you in your journeys. Easily spooked, it often changes into a Vampiric Dragon form, hoping to seem fiercer than it is.
6444.name: Vampiric Dragon Imp

6445.description: Cult of the New Moon pups haven't quite grown out of their youthful exuberance, which make them fun travel companions. They often stalk shadows, seeking to destroy them.
6445.name: New Moon Wolf Pup

6446.description: Though this cub wears the signature barding of the Cult of the New Moon, it acts just like a kitten. Which is to say, you might need to train it to avoid rubbing its head and scratchy barding against your cheek.
6446.name: New Moon Senche Cub

6447.description: A handful of daring merchants stole some pack animals from the Cult of the New Moon, and they claim these ponies are as nimble as goats to the point of even climbing trees. Apple orchard farmers beware!
6447.name: New Moon Pony

6448.description: The Cult of the New Moon keeps a number of different creatures around, including guars. Due to a peculiarity in its breeding, this guar tries to sing along whenever it hears someone singing. Only dogs can hear it do so, however.
6448.name: New Moon Guar Calf

6449.description: This cub from the Cult of the New Moon will happily trundle along behind you as long as you keep it well-fed.
6449.name: New Moon Bear Cub

6450.description: Young durzogs acquired from the Coldsnap Goblin tribe are temperamental and require a firm hand. After you've established firm boundaries with this creature, though, its loyalty is boundless.
6450.name: Coldsnap Durzog Pup

6451.description: "Some keep so-called Pocket Watchers as pets, playing off the name of those Pocket Mammoths seen in Wrothgar. Even at their smaller size? Still not the wisest move. Small Daedra are still Daedra, after all, and thus beyond our ken. "âWarlock Aldaale
6451.name: Pocket Watcher

6452.description: Complete with wrappings and a creepy mask, the Grisly Banekin Mummy will accompany you on all your journeys, causing boundless horror among all who see it!
6452.name: Grisly Banekin Mummy

6453.description: "This pup has lived through a Dragon attack, proving itself in front of all the Dragonslayers present. Its steadfastness should help keep you alive."âJavinda, Dragonslayer
6453.name: Dread-Aurelian Dragonslayer Wolf

6454.description: "The Mind-Shriven Scamp is an unusual specimen. Generally you find them among other mind-shriven creatures, but some addled folk have started including them in their entourage. Peculiar, at best."âWarlock Aldaale
6454.name: Mind-Shriven Scamp

6455.description: Equipped with a hat, this black cat makes its way in the world at your side, leaving little fiery pawprints behind as it goes.
6455.name: Witch's Infernal Familiar

6456.description: This wolf senses the impending arrival of Dragons, making it an excellent pet for veteran Dragon Hunters.
6456.name: Ancient Dragon Hunter Wolf

6458.description: "Ah, yes, the Undaunted. That they have decided to train Scamps to wear a pack is, shall we say, a prodigious undertaking. I look forward to seeing how much gear goes missing."âWarlock Aldaale
6458.name: Undaunted Porter Scamp
6458.hint: Acquired by completing the "Moongrave Fane Conqueror" Achievement

6459.description: A young blacksmith raised a foundling wolf decades ago, thus training the first of the Oak-Ember Forge Wolves as a steed. With its unusual fur pattern, you're sure to make an impression on those around you.
6459.name: Oak-Ember Forge Wolf

6460.description: In honor of a fallen Warden, a Wayrest blacksmith continues to breed and sell these bears as mounts today. If you happen to notice a Warden watching you as you ride this steed, consider thanking her. She may be the fallen Warden's shade!
6460.name: Graysmoke Forge Bear

6461.description: Originally bred by a family of Breton blacksmiths, the Coalsmoke Forge Horse's strength allows them to work for long hours. Just make sure you provide them with a salt lickâthey love them.
6461.name: Coalsmoke Forge Horse

6462.description: "You might think Mind-Shriven Wolves are fragile beasts, but their environment has instilled within them a hidden strength. "âWarlock Aldaale
6462.name: Mind-Shriven Wolf

6463.description: Make an entrance with this mummified mount! With its ancient wrappings and hallowed barding, this ghastly horse adds the perfect touch of eeriness to any spooky procession or gathering.
6463.name: Grisly Horse Mummy

6464.description: Known as steeds of the Dremora, Kynbound Senche-Panthers have found their way into service as mounts for those who have some ties to the Dremora. Perhaps that's you?
6464.name: Kynbound Senche-Panther

6465.description: Like the holds and keeps that prevent enemies from vanquishing them, this warhorse is fortified to prevent foes from taking it down quickly. Join forces with this prodigious mount to besiege opposing forces and take over their holdings!
6465.name: Siegemaster's Warhorse

6466.description: Those skilled enough to overcome Sunspire can earn a special variant of the Sunspire Ice-Fire Senche-Lion. With golden armor and gear, this mount shines, reflecting your own adventuring glory.
6466.name: Sunspire Champion Senche-Lion
6466.hint: Acquired by completing the "Sunspire Dragonbreak" Achievement.

6489.description: Feanirr witnessed the demise of her proud adeptorium, not to war, but to a sickness faster and stealthier than all but her. Since then, she lives only in the moment, knowing that at any moment something deadlier than her could catch her by the tail.
6489.name: Whispering-Claw Senche-Raht

6490.description: A scholar studying Mnemoli the Blue Star as well as a Whispering Claw warrior, this Senche-raht serves Queen Khamira with both brain and brawn. He volunteered to travel with you, lending you speed and steady companionship.
6490.name: Queen's Claw Senche-Raht

6491.description: After spending many years in a Vrin-Thak adeptorium, this powerful Senche-raht decided it was time to work with someone who regularly goes toward danger. She prefers to learn by watching, however.
6491.name: Goutfang Senche-Raht

6492.description: This gentle giant embodies kindness and loyalty, and her loving spirit will run alongside you forever.
6492.name: Belle

6508.description: With their glowing yellow eyes and flashy golden barding, these veteran steeds serve their Dragon-slaying riders with nobility and style. Be sure to keep some sugar cubes handyâthey have a taste for sweets that rivals the Khajiit!
6508.name: Dread-Aurelian Charger

6573.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Meridia, the Bright Lady.
6573.name: Statuette: Meridia, Bright Lady

6574.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Peryite, the Taskmaster.
6574.name: Statuette: Peryite, Taskmaster

6575.description: A miniature statue of a Suthay furstock Moon-Bishop.
6575.name: Statuette: Suthay, Nimble Bishop

6596.description: A perfect replica of the Rithana-di-Renada, complete with the ancient Song of Kingdoms.
6596.name: Replica Rithana-Di-Renada
6596.hint: Awarded for bringing all sixteen fragments of the Rithana-di-Renada, an ancient Khajiiti mural, to the House of Histories in Riverhold.

6609.description: Place on the Jonelight Altar in the Hall of the Lunar Champion to awaken the lunar reflector.
6609.name: Behold the Lunar Champion
6609.hint: Awarded for completing the "Two Queens" quest in Elsweyr.

6610.description: Trophy taken from Nahviintaas in honor of an Undaunted victory in Sunspire.
6610.name: Trophy: Nahviintaas

6611.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Sunspire.
6611.name: Bust: Nahviintaas

6613.description: Place on the Altar of Betrayal in the Hall of the Lunar Champion to unlock an overlook of the Halls of Colossus.
6613.name: Behold Khunzar-ri's Betrayal
6613.hint: Awarded for completing the "The Heir of Anequina" quest in Elsweyr.

6616.description: Though many associate darkness with evil, those looking at the Ebon-Glow Indrik come to understand that darkness is simply the absence of lightâneither good nor bad in itself. A soothing thought that calms fears, much like this magical indrik does.
6616.name: Ebon-Glow Indrik

6617.description: Some claim that this indrik comes into being when the first rays of the sun hit pristine snow. Whether that's true or not, it can help you make an impression as you wander the streets of Alinor or venture beyond that.
6617.name: Frost-Light Indrik

6618.description: Those who have watched this particular imp's mimicry wonder how it survived seeing the Dragon that inspired its antics. Regardless, awe others by making this imp your companion.
6618.name: Regal Dragon Imp
6618.hint: Acquired by completing the "The Dragon's Wrath" Achievement.

6619.description: Though they originally hail from Senchal, these mousers have recently started showing up in other locales. Having one at your side not only exhibits your charity toward street cats, but also helps ensure you sleep free of pesky mice!
6619.name: Silver-Gray Mouser Cat

6620.description: Covered in golden fur and possessing a sharp sense of smell, this mutt becomes loyal to any who feed it and treat it with kindness. Are you the benefactor who will take this dog away from its life scrounging on the docks of Senchal?
6620.name: Senchal Harbor-Mutt

6622.description: Nimble and fleet, this fawn sticks to your side like you're its mother. Cute? Oh yes. Those eyes! That nose! Those spots!
6622.name: Fawn

6623.description: This pup isn't one for simple games of fetch, but it will follow you loyally through your adventures. That and its ability to chill your water simply by curling around it? Practical and cute, in its own frosty way.
6623.name: Frost Atronach Wolf Pup

6624.description: Some would choose to pass on a senche cub that has sharp edges and no fur. But not you! In fact, you can look forward to its cooling nudges for attention while trudging through deserts.
6624.name: Frost Atronach Senche Cub

6625.description: Are ponies too adorable for you? Fear not! This pony takes adorable, freezes it, and adds a hefty helping of "don't even think about petting my nose." A welcome companion to those who hate the heat, as well!
6625.name: Frost Atronach Pony

6626.description: A frost atronach in kagouti calf form, this companion embodies the essence of Vvardenfell's wilds in an icy way, making it an interesting choice for heroes seeking to stop threats in that region. Native Dark Elves might look askance at you, however.
6626.name: Frost Atronach Kagouti Calf

6628.description: "As the fiercest of the Dragonslayer wolves, this one's eyes glow a steady green, and it remains by her owner's side even against the most majestic of Dragons."âJavinda, Dragonslayer
6628.name: Jade-Crown Dragonslayer Wolf

6629.description: With this loyal dog at your side, you have a companion who can help you make it through even the most treacherous of avalanches in Pale Pass and other mountainous areas â¦ even if it has to pull you out from under a pile of fallen snow and detritus.
6629.name: Anthorbred Avalanche Dog

6630.description: You needn't know Conjuration magic to have an atronach companionâClan Direnni mages have gifted bear cubs of that provenance to those they deem worthy. They can be oddly heart-warming despite their frosty form.
6630.name: Frost Atronach Bear Cub

6631.description: This wolf's experiences with Dragons surpasses that of many Dragon Hunters. And it has chosen to be at your side! An excellent match, indeed.
6631.name: Legendary Dragon Wolf

6672.description: Few can withstand the scorching heat and relentless desolation of the Deadlands. Those unlucky few who find themselves trapped there may encounter one of these scuttling horrorsâa hideous reminder of their grim and eternal fate.
6672.name: Mudcrab of Eternal Doom

6673.description: The epitome of Dragonslaying mounts, this steed has not only braved dangers that would make lesser heroes cringe but serves as a worthy mount for one of your stature and experience. The fact that it has green glowing eyes makes it even more noteworthy.
6673.name: Jade-Crown Dragonslayer Horse

6674.description: Only the Wasseek-haleel would breed such a colorful and sweet-natured horse-lizard. Ideal for those times when you're wandering through Murkmire, looking for trouble to quash.
6674.name: Wasseek Horse-Lizard

6675.description: By forcing their steeds to consume the Blood of Coldharbour, the traitorous soldiers of Legion Zero created a war horse unlike any other. Adorned with fearsome barding and their sullen red colors, this is truly a mount to be feared.
6675.name: Legion Zero Destrier

6676.description: In times past, honored visitors and brave heroes joined Windhelm's annual ceremonial ride on the festively decorated steeds of the Winterbloom Warmblood herd. Now that they're more freely available, perhaps you can recapture the spirit of this tradition.
6676.name: Winterbloom Warmblood

6677.description: The corrupting presence of Dark Aeon can twist the local wildlife, such as this wolf, into crystalline creatures. Green tendrils accompany you as you race on its back, providing you both with an otherworldly presence.
6677.name: Dark Aeon Wolf

6678.description: This molten mount radiates heat and reeks of brimstone. Some Dark Elves swear that it emerged from the heart of Red Mountain itself, but they speak of this only in whispers. Those who seek such a blasphemous steed will find none better!
6678.name: Volcanic Senche-Panther

6679.description: The result of a boastful Khajiiti mage's bizarre transmutation ritual, the Dark Opaline Steed shimmers with blues and purples, and waves of colorful light trail behind it. Course through any environment while looking stylish and almost ephemeral!
6679.name: Dark Opaline Steed

6680.description: This kagouti-shaped frost atronach might just be the last thing an unfortunate apprentice warlock crafted before becoming its first victim. Perhaps you can tame this mount? If not, best have extra healing potions on hand for the inevitable bites.
6680.name: Frost Atronach Kagouti

6681.description: Two mages crafted this mount, then had a deadly falling out over whether to share their research. Now you can ride it into the frozen peaks of Skyrim with no problems â¦ or enjoy its coolness in the blistering heat of the Alik'r.
6681.name: Frost Atronach Wolf

6682.description: Most sorcerers scoff at the idea of imbuing the lumbering frost atronach with feline grace, but when summoned correctly, this frigid senche more than matches its warm-blooded peers in quiet and cunning. Perfect for a hero of your stature!
6682.name: Frost Atronach Senche

6683.description: All the strength of a standard frost atronach, with all the nobility and grace of the equine form! Create a spectacle by riding into your favorite town on this mighty steed.
6683.name: Frost Atronach Horse

6684.description: Few mages possess the power to press a frost atronach into serviceâbut twisting its form into that of a Dwarven spider? That takes a rare gift. And with the sun glinting off it as you ride it, you'll cut quite an imposing figure!
6684.name: Frost Atronach Dwarven Spider

6685.description: Orcish spellwrights rarely call for boons from Daedric realms beyond Malacath's Ashpit. Even so, the lure of a raging bear wrought from rock-hard ice is difficult to pass up.
6685.name: Frost Atronach Bear

6686.description: Many masters of the art of necromancy find this horse suits their taste exceedingly well, especially since it possesses no fear of the undead that often surround necromancers. It calls to you, does it not?
6686.name: Khaj Necromancer's Steed

6687.description: Taken from the crime-ridden back streets of Senchal and raised by scavengers, this mount lost an eye while defending its rider from pursuing guards. Now wearing a patch, the Howler is an ideal mount for doers of deadly deeds.
6687.name: Scorched Alley Howler

6688.description: Hunters riding these valiant steeds are often the first on the scene of a Dragon attack. With its ornate, jade-accented barding, and its fierce loyalty to its rider, this steed is a must-have for any veteran Dragon Hunter.
6688.name: Legendary Dragon Horse

6689.description: "A mage from Lilmoth found a way to, ahem, 'tame' these green slimes. Yes, it will follow you around, leaving a disgusting trail of slime, but it's hardly docile. My apprentice's so-called 'pet' woke me by trying to engulf my face."âAleri Andalor
6689.name: Voriplasm

6719.description:
"Oh, yes! I've seen legionaries stand their ground against a battle-bonded Khajiit pair. Never seen one survive the experience, but you've got to respect anyone who faces a Senche-raht and their chosen battlemate."
âNallangaer, Vinedusk Ranger
6719.name: Senche-Raht Statue, Battle-Bound

6720.description: Khajiit claim these torchbugs are the light of Jode given form, which allows them to dance amid the moon-sugar cane and bless the crops. Now you can have one flitting about you! After all, having Jode's blessing is never a bad thing, right?
6720.name: Crimson Torchbug

6810.description: A miniature statue of the Divine Dibella, the Lady of Love, Beauty, Art, and Music.
6810.name: Statuette: Dibella, Blessed Lady

6811.description: A miniature statue of Mephala, the Daedric Prince of Secrets and Murder.
6811.name: Statuette: Mephala, Webspinner

6812.description: A miniature statue of Sotha Sil, the Clockwork God.
6812.name: Statuette: Sotha Sil, Tinkerer

6813.description: You have claimed a share of the Dragon's Treasure Trove. Place it in your home, and show off your hard-earned riches.
6813.name: Dragon's Treasure Trove

6914.description: Trophy taken from Grundwulf in honor of an Undaunted victory in Moongrave Fane.
6914.name: Trophy: Grundwulf

6915.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Moongrave Fane.
6915.name: Bust: Grundwulf
6915.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Moongrave Fane.

6916.description: Trophy taken from Maarselok in honor of an Undaunted victory in Lair of Maarselok.
6916.name: Trophy: Maarselok
6916.hint: Awarded for completing Lair of Maarselok.

6917.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Lair of Maarselok.
6917.name: Bust: Maarselok
6917.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Lair of Maarselok.

6919.description: Place on the Altar of Guile in the Hall of the Lunar Champion to unlock a long-forgotten corner of Moongrave Fane.
6919.name: Behold Khunzar-ri's Guile
6919.hint: Awarded for earning the "Scalebreaker Scout" achievement by completing Moongrave Fane and Lair of Maarselok.
