6928.description: A miniature statue of Auri-El and Xarxes, based on the statues in the Monastery of Serene Harmony in Shimmerene.
6928.name: Statuette: Auri-El and Xarxes

6929.description: Originally bred by Tenmar Khajiit, these wily strays made their way to Senchal and now roam several port cities. Captains love having them on board ships to sniff out and kill vermin, plus help keep the crew warm on cold nights at sea.
6929.name: Sable Tenmar Stray

6930.description: "Some say that dogs of this breed don't have a mean bone in their bodies, but if you set them up to guard horses or other creatures, you'll see one fierce guardian. Also great at rounding up livestock."âPiet
6930.name: Merle Paddock Hound

6942.description: Rare indriks don't die but instead live on as haunting apparitions. Though they walk between two worlds, these ghostly steeds serve their chosen companions well as mounts. Some Summerset High Elves claim this is a true sign of a rider's worthiness.
6942.name: Spectral Indrik
6942.hint: Obtained by combining four different Spectral Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Spectral Indrik.

6950.description: Though some scholars in Alinor have hypotheses about why an indrik would linger after death, none have as yet proven them. Perhaps these indriks have simply picked someone worthy to follow for all time?
6950.name: Haunting Indrik

6972.description: "Clearly the Dwarves liked to travel in pairs now and again, so they built this two-seated animunculi for that purpose. My partner and I adore using it on market day!"âDelyna Ulvel
6972.name: Duo-Dynamo Dwarven Spider

6974.description: A miniature statue of a Senche-raht Khajiit and its chosen battlemate.
6974.name: Statuette: Senche-Raht

6975.description: A miniature statue depicting one of the Manes, the spiritual leaders of the Khajiit.
6975.name: Statuette: Mane, Moons-Blessed

6976.description: A miniature statue of a hero of the Pride of Alkosh, standing triumphantly over her foe.
6976.name: Statuette: Pride of Alkosh Hero

7076.description: An iniquitous blend of magic created this unhallowed mount. From its baleful glow to the corrupt lanterns that drift about it, this steed serves liches, necromancers, and other wicked beings with undying loyalty.
7076.name: Cursebound Lichsteed

7077.description: This creature is dominated by the oppressive energies of Coldharbour, bound to its master by a vile pledge to Molag Bal. Though it lacks the ability to act without command, the simmering rage bottled inside the beast grows with every passing day.
7077.name: Cursebound Sabre Cat Prowler

7078.description: Zarnor, seeking to quench his insatiable curiosity, took part in experimental rituals that twisted and marked him. Though he still seeks to satiate his ceaseless desire for knowledge, he does so to free himself from servitude to loathsome masters.
7078.name: Cursebound Senche-Raht Darkfang

7079.description: "A fellow named Rigurt requested a 'fortuitudinous' bear mount that 'shines up the face' of a friend. My glowing Gloomspore Bears, with their mora tapinella infusion, barrel through enemies to get a rider to safety. 'Fortuitudinous' galore."âMage Naleldi
7079.name: Gloomspore Bear

7080.description: "A scholar sought a mount that would assume her burdens, so I gave her a Gloomspore Camel. Using scaly pholiota in its creation makes it less likely to complain at any weight it bears, plus gives it a bounce to its step."âMage Naleldil
7080.name: Gloomspore Camel

7081.description: "A Dunmer mage came by, shaking with rage, and tersely asked for my toughest mount. Though my Gloomspore Guars are a bit nippy, probably due to the extra bleeding crown I used to make them, they have thick fungal hide."âMage Naleldil
7081.name: Gloomspore Guar

7082.description: "Using giant lichen while creating Gloomspore Horses caused unexpected results. Dauntingly beautiful, these mounts often twitch with nervous caution. So you'll never have to worry about an ambush. Just hold on tight!"âMage Naleldil
7082.name: Gloomspore Horse

7083.description: "When developing my Gloomspore Senche, I utilized thunder fungiâa remarkable mushroom that erupts into spores with a deafening boom! I thought it only fitting to mix one roar with another." â Mage Naleldil
7083.name: Gloomspore Senche

7084.description: "Using hypha facia while creating my Gloomspore Wolves made for some eerie fungal mountsâperfect for anyone who wants to keep others at a distance. Their howls make my own skin prickle."âMage Naleldil
7084.name: Gloomspore Wolf

7105.description: Though the arcane markings on this gray pocket mammoth indicate its status as a sacrificial offering, these creatures often end up trundling along after soft-hearted souls like yourself.
7105.name: Sacrificial Pocket Mammoth

7110.description: Bred for their wicked intelligence, the Emberthroat Durzog might just outwit the Netch Gouger Goblins that raised them. Only those with nimbler minds keep their loyaltyâand that might just be you!
7110.name: Emberthroat Durzog

7111.description: Teeth. Lots of sharp teeth. Jutting from gums pulled back in a mirthless, rictus grin. Eager to devour anyone in its path. Yet if you're brave enough to ride it, those frightful teeth will eagerly snap at your foes.
7111.name: Cursebound Wolf

7217.description: Enterprising siegemasters need to move quickly when working to overthrow a fortification. Whether you plan to conquer Castle Alessia, take over Fort Warden, or overwhelm Chalman Keep, the Holdbreaker Horse is a valuable addition to your stable!
7217.name: Holdbreaker Warhorse

7219.description: When the winter air grows quiet and heavy just before snowfall, woodsmoke touched by Magicka swirls into the form of an Icebreath Indrik. Summerset scholars believe these mounts allow those with insight and wisdom to understand their deepest wish.
7219.name: Icebreath Indrik
7219.hint: Obtained by combining four different Icebreath Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Icebreath Indrik.

7220.description: The Laughing Lion has taken a liking to you! Place this ancient sarcophagus in your home and his carefree wisdom will always be close to hand.
7220.name: Khunzar-ri's Rest
7220.hint: Awarded for completing the "A Hero's Song" achievement in Southern Elsweyr.

7221.description: After arriving on Firemoth Island, the slavers found and trained a flame-hued variant of the nix-ox steed. Its vibrant colors belie its fiery temperament, making it a suitable match for those seeking to ride into the midst of combat.
7221.name: Firemoth Nix-Ox

7269.description: "The cold blue glowing eyes and markings of the Slate-Skinned Daedrat stem from their diet: corpses touched by Molag Bal. Those brave enough to research or even thwart the Lord of Brutality often study these creatures for insight."âPhrastus of Elinhir
7269.name: Slate-Skinned Daedrat

7270.description: Freed at last from her terrible captivity, and rightfully wedded to Jester King Jorunn, the Sovereign Sow can trundle along at your side to share in your adventures. Who would not want a companion of such royal blood and stately countenance?
7270.name: Sovereign Sow
7270.hint: Acquired by finding and combining all seven Sovereign Sow collectible fragments found in Stupendous Jester's Festival Boxes during the Jester's Festival.

7271.description: After news of the Seventh Legion's presence near Hallin's Stand spread, several Evermore citizens moved quickly to protect some at-risk fauna, among them a breed of easily domesticated jackals. Now one of these fierce companions can roam at your side.
7271.name: Hallin's Jackal

7272.description: "Witches refused to share the grisly secrets of the Wickerfright summoning ritual â¦ until now. Upon appearing, its wooden countenance twists into an eerie smileâa frightful expression, indeed!"âWarlock Aldaale
7272.name: Wickerfright Banekin

7273.description: "No better companion exists than my devoted Gloomspore Guar Calf. I used spores known for their calming properties to modify the guar's temperament. Regrettably, it makes the creature gassy, but unmatched loyalty is worth opening windows."âMage Naleldil
7273.name: Gloomspore Guar Calf

7274.description: "Integrating research left behind by Ahzidal the Enchanter, I crafted a bear cub from spores acquired from a well-traveled merchant. This creature bumbles around a bit more than its animal counterpart, but it glows! Perfection!"âMage Naleldil
7274.name: Gloomspore Bear Cub

7275.description: "To the surprise of none but the most hard-hearted, I made a tumbling ball of fungal-fur in the form of a senche cub. How could I not? And shame on any who pass this adorable bundle of spores without smiling."âMage Naleldil
7275.name: Gloomspore Senche Cub

7276.description: "Challenged by a colleague, I created a pony-fungus creature. The first few stood as still as statues, so I added manic morels from Dementia. That livened things up considerably. If you adopt one, I suggest keeping it out of your parlor."âMage Naleldil
7276.name: Gloomspore Pony

7277.description: "I designed some adorable wolf pups, adding oxblood fungus spores to see if that instills fierce guardianship in them. It workedâthey now guard my feet from things like boots and stockings. Consider garbing yourself out of their sight!"âMage Naleldil
7277.name: Gloomspore Wolf Pup

7278.description: The sound of wind gusting through dusklit, ice-laden trees heralds a Rimedust Indrik's birth. These indriks emanate a sense of deep calm wherever they go.
7278.name: Rimedusk Indrik

7279.description: Dark Elves of House Hlaalu, knowing that Vvardenfell isn't the only place with deadly flora, fauna, and folk, bred a nix-hound that can thrive in different environments. Even with its gorgeous blue-purple shading, it still possesses a menacing air.
7279.name: Coldspring Nix-Hound

7280.description: While studying arcane husbandry, Mage Naleldil discovered a long-forgotten Ayleid ritual capable of granting luminescent qualities to common salamanders. Now, due to an unexpected population explosion, she gives them to those who impress her.
7280.name: Ice-Glow Salamander

7281.description: The night before Waking Day, Iliac Bay Bretons share stories about the Terrible Torchbug of Molag Bal. While the story varies, all agree on one thing: those followed by a cobalt-hued torchbug possess a savagery in battle that haunts any who survive.
7281.name: Blue Torchbug

7282.description: Madness follows the Purple Torchbug, or so some claim. Others believe that those who once held Sheogorath's attention attract these insects. Either way, perhaps Sheogorath's dubious blessing touched them.
7282.name: Purple Torchbug

7283.description: Some believe that gaining Meridia's favor is like gripping a double-edged blade tightly with bare hands. Yet, if you perform an action she likes, she may gift you with a White Torchbugâperhaps the least worrisome of her favors!
7283.name: White Torchbug

7284.description: Some followers of Stendarr claim that those who see a Pink Torchbug must perform great acts of charity and mercy by sunset the following day. If they please Stendarr, the pleasant little creature might follow them for a time.
7284.name: Pink Torchbug

7286.description: Long ago, the secretive Pyre Watch bred local jackals into mounts, allowing them to move swiftly as they patrolled their cursed caverns. Now this nimble and fleet pale steed can be yours!
7286.name: Pyre Watch Jackal

7287.description: A bloodied Daedric dagger used by a spurned lover. The tears of a victim tormented by Molag Bal. When used in a wicked Icereach coven ritual, they help shape a wicker mount that is worthy of bearing everyone's worst nightmare: you.
7287.name: Icereach Wicker-Steed

7288.description: "Ahzidal made the shadowcap's azure glow the centerpiece of this unsettling feline mount. Prized by spelunkers, this luminescent mount can light up the darkest caverns without making a sound. "âHalund Greycloak
7288.name: Shadowcap Cave-Senche

7289.description: "One of Ahzidal's experiments involved creating an ideal wolf mount for dangerous forests and caverns. This Fungiflare Wolf has a vicious temperament by design and natureâfungiflare mushrooms are lethal."âHalund Greycloak
7289.name: Fungiflare Wolf

7290.description: "Seeking to meld fire with fungi, Ahzidal created the first Embermould Warhorse. Formed from char morels often used in stews, this mount can light a rider's way on the darkest winter nights."âHalund Greycloak
7290.name: Embermould Warhorse

7291.description: Ride a stick mount that symbolizes your fiery dreams of all-consuming doom. Complete with flaming mane, tail, and eyes, this thrice-cursed novelty horse makes your stick-riding experience one for the books â¦ of burning horror!
7291.name: Nightmare Stick Horse
7291.hint: |cff0000This mount doesn't increase your movement speed. Riding Lessons don't affect its appearance. This mount cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r

7323.description: A perfect replica of the priceless tapestry called Khajiit of the Moons.
7323.name: Khajiit of the Moons Replica
7323.hint: Awarded for bringing all twelve pieces of Khajiit of the Moons, an ancient Khajiiti tapestry, to the Senchal Palace.

7345.description: Place on the Altar of Ambition in the Hall of the Lunar Champion to unlock a portal to Khunzar-ri's childhood home.
7345.name: Behold Khunzar-ri's Ambition
7345.hint: Awarded for completing the "The Dragonguard" quest in Southern Elsweyr.

7360.description: The unusual properties of the crystal known as aeonstone continue to confound alchemists and arcane researchers. This particular formation resonates with nearby inactive deposits, causing them to emit a soft glow.
7360.name: Aeonstone Formation
7360.hint: Awarded for completing the "Fall of the Dark Aeon" achievement in Southern Elsweyr.

7464.description: "When a Bright Moons Lunar Moth follows you, the blessings of Jone and Jode flutter close behind."âMoon-Priest Tedaza
7464.name: Bright Moons Lunar Moth

7467.description: Born when a sunset's light tickles Magicka-imbued bird feathers, the Crimson Indrik possesses a flowing gait. Scholars observe that the indrik's magical nature promotes self-reflection.
7467.name: Crimson Indrik
7467.hint: Obtained by combining four different Crimson Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Crimson Indrik.

7468.description: Summerset scholars state this indrik, which comes into being at the base of the oldest tree in the forest, possesses an air of profound agelessness. Those riding these magical creatures find that weighty matters ease away.
7468.name: Mossheart Indrik
7468.hint: Obtained by combining four different Mossheart Berries with a Nascent Indrik mount. The Nascent Indrik will become the Mossheart Indrik.

7501.description: Once these death hounds served crypt wardens exclusively, stalking the gloomy barrows of Skyrim in search of prey. Now, thanks to an ingenious mage from Solitude, these mounts can serve you, lending you their menacing air.
7501.name: Crypt Warden Death Hound

7502.description: Some Alinor scholars claim these indriks form when Magicka mingles with the petals of early-blooming roses. Others note that the roses' thorns need to have drawn blood first. Regardless, this creature inspires creativity in any it follows.
7502.name: Rosethorn Indrik

7503.description: As trees awaken in the spring, the first light of dawn sparks the formation of a Sapling Indrik from Magicka-touched acorns. Boundless hope fills those they choose to follow.
7503.name: Sapling Indrik

7504.description: A miniature statue of Sithis, patron of the Dark Brotherhood.
7504.name: Statuette: Sithis, Dread Lord

7505.description: A miniature version of the enigmatic mermaid statue found in Anvil.
7505.name: Statuette: Mermaid of Anvil

7506.description: A miniature statue of Auri-El, chief deity of the Aldmeri pantheon, with an eagle.
7506.name: Statuette: Auri-El, Aldmer King

7515.description: Bears afflicted by a necromancer's curse become baneful, easily enraged beasts. Loyal only to their masters, these transformed ursines show no fear in the face of danger, making them excellent battlefield companions.
7515.name: Cursebound Bear

7516.description: The roar of a sabre cat bridled by a deathless curse shreds a soul to pieces, or so say those at the Bards College in Solitude. Yet that doesn't deter ambitious necromancers from trying to tame these frightening creatures.
7516.name: Cursebound Sabre Cat

7517.description: Glorious and deadly. Majestic and haunting. This well-armored steed serves its master faithfully, though its nightmarish appearance once inspired rumors of a ghoulish nature in the area around Cragwallow.
7517.name: Cursebound Horse

7518.description: This fell monstrosity inspired Maestro Efnort of the Bards College to write the poem "The Red-Eyed Terror of Zthenganaz." In truth, this steed most often chooses intimidation and flight tactics over direct confrontation.
7518.name: Cursebound Kagouti

7519.description: The dramatic black and white coloration of this lithe mount makes for striking entrances. Watch out, though! Karthstalkers show affection by trying to groom your face.
7519.name: Karthstalker Sabre Cat

7520.description: Originally tamed and bred as mounts by the ancient Grimfang Reach clan, these riding bears became popular among Nords who captured them in raids. Despite their inherent docility, these bears anger swiftly when threatened.
7520.name: Druadach Mountain Bear

7521.description: Battlemages within the perfidious Legion Zero conjure these powerful warhorses out of thin air using forbidden Daedric magic. The sight of this otherworldly charger inspires both fear and awe on the battlelines.
7521.name: Legion Zero Charger

7522.description: When seen at night, this elk emanates a faint glow, rivaling the unusual color shifts in the northern skies of Skyrim or the glowing fungus of Blackreach's vast caves. Stunning!
7522.name: Pineblossom Vale Elk

7523.description: This elk's blue luminescence stems from its origins, claim Mages Guild scholars: they coalesce from a beam of pure light, blessed by Azura, that falls upon a drift of snow. Or perhaps, as others state, its diet of blue entolomas causes the azure glow.
7523.name: Snowdrift Vale Elk

7524.description: Some claim a ghost possesses this proud steed, providing it with a haunting glow. Others point to its chosen diet: glowing flora and fungi. Regardless, riders feel as if they're gliding on air.
7524.name: Hailcinder Vale Elk

7525.description: In an annual Windhelm competition, contestants must ride their potential prizes up a mountain then down at top speedsâbareback and without falling off. Most rams toss riders into the air on purpose, validating the claim that the ram chooses its rider.
7525.name: Yorgrim River Ram
7525.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

7526.description: "Pure white, these bats, making them hard to see in wintry conditions. But give one a bit of banana, and it'll stick close to you for a while. With a constant diet of bananas and other fruits? You are its boon companion."âTanandra, Scholar-Errant
7526.name: Snow Throat Fruit Bat

7527.description: "Normally you don't see these black bats because they prefer caves and other areas avoided by people. However, if trained, these fellows consider you a member of their colony and hate to leave your side."âTanandra, Scholar-Errant
7527.name: Shadowswift Bat

7528.description: "People blessed by these brown bat companions experience very few issues with insects. They love hiding in your pack during the day, and they'll keep you bug-free while you sleep at night."âTanandra, Scholar-Errant
7528.name: Brown Steeple Bat

7529.description: "Sometimes called Friends of the Caravan, these black-and-white bats migrate among cacti stands in arid regions. Trackers follow their guano to find hydrating, safe cacti when in need. Easily trained to be a companion."âTanandra, Scholar-Errant
7529.name: Dappled Cactus Bat

7530.description: "So colorful! And common around orchards, farms, and other places with cultivated fruit and flowers. A priceless companion for foragers and travelers since they can lead you to food."âTanandra, Scholar-Errant
7530.name: Duskfire Nectar Bat

7531.description: Legends claim that Dibella sent one of these joyful gryphon fledglings to the Bards College during the bards' opening performance, marking it as being the first creature inside the building.
7531.name: Skald-Muse Fledgling Gryphon

7532.description: Decades ago, Nords whispered stories of a reclusive dark-furred lynx that ate spirits barred from Sovngarde. Imagine the Nords' surprise when they found these lynxes domesticated as tent guards during a raid on Reach natives.
7532.name: Twilight Striped Lynx

7533.description: Known for both their stubbornness and their ability to climb on structures at the worst possible times, the Whiterun Mottled Goat picks a favorite person and tries to follow them. Affectionate? Only if you find gentle headbutts to be so.
7533.name: Whiterun Mottled Goat

7534.description: "Though I lost many trained frostbite spiders to those who took them for an aggressive infestation of Solitude, I moved outside town and now give them away. They are trained, venomous, and ready to follow you in your travels!"âHlokela of Solitude
7534.name: Frostbite Spider

7535.description: Enterprising merchants seek out and capture these delightful little creatures, calling them either "bunnies" or, if the buyer prefers accuracy or a certain level of decorum, Pale Pass Mountain Hares. So cute!
7535.name: Pale Pass Mountain Hare

7536.description: "These fastidious cats bring the blessing of Tu'whacca and hold a place of honor within their chosen homes. Further, they often start sleeping with any who near death, and thus we venerate them as guides to the Far Shores."âTanandra, Scholar-Errant
7536.name: Tu'whacca's Sphynx Cat

7634.description: Trophy taken from the Icereach Coven in honor of an Undaunted victory in Icereach.
7634.name: Trophy: Mother Ciannait

7635.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Icereach.
7635.name: Bust: Mother Ciannait

7636.description: Trophy taken from Kjalnar Tombskald in honor of an Undaunted victory in Unhallowed Grave.
7636.name: Trophy: Tzirzhalir

7637.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Unhallowed Grave.
7637.name: Bust: Tzirzhalir
7637.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Unhallowed Grave.

7738.description: Though this adorable fawn's kin shimmer with hues different than its own, the first color ever seen was the pearly white glow on this one. Give it enough care and you can help it overcome its shyness, allowing it to cavort at your side.
7738.name: Vale Fawn

7739.description: "The red glow of a Nightrose stems from its time of birth," a spelunker claims. "If the sky above is red, so is the fawn." While some scoff at this, all agree on one thing: Nightroses have a sixth sense for danger, nudging awake any chosen family.
7739.name: Nightrose Vale Fawn

7740.description: Its amber-gold glimmer creates a warmth that one stablemaster states, "Can get you through chilly nights under the Skyrim stars." All it takes to keep one of these vale fawns at your side is a lick of honey now and again.
7740.name: Ambersheen Vale Fawn

7741.description: For a time, scholars thought only one type of vale fawn existed. Now, knowing better, some wonder why the variation? The fawns care not. But, ones with a green shimmer love to race. Choose one as a companion, and it might even race you!
7741.name: Emerald Vale Fawn

7742.description: One scholar studying vale fawns notes that the purple-hued Orchidfall fawnânamed after a now-lost flora-filled cavern in Skyrimâenjoys eating flowers. "Give it a flower, and it's your friend for life!" Do you have your flower in hand?
7742.name: Orchidfall Vale Fawn

7786.description: Once known as the toughest Baandari thief in the Stitches, Abahayda ran afoul of a terrible curse in the Ashen Scar. She seeks a companion who will help restore her former life and vigor. Is that you?
7786.name: Cursebound Senche-Raht

7788.description: "It's said that when a worthy Nord seeks a glorious end, Sovngarde will send them a fleet steed to spirit them to their final battle, but pay no mind to skalds who sing of a horse of many legs."âClever Woman Moritra
7788.name: Valiant Sovngarde Charger

7789.description: "The clawthanes of Sovngarde often stand watch over the Whalebone Bridge, but some choose to join forces with a courageous soul in Skyrim or beyond. Noble wolves, these are, and clever."âClever Woman Moritra
7789.name: Sovngarde Clawthane Wolf

7790.description: "Lithe sabre cats are prized among Sovngarde's heroes, particularly those called valorfangs, who died while defending their riders. They stand ready at the Hall of Valor, waiting to convey a hero to a warrior in need of aid."âClever Woman Moritra
7790.name: Sovngarde Valorfang Sabre Cat

7795.description: "During times of great need, Sovngarde releases some of its heroes back into the world, and legendary beasts to serve them. The stoutheart bear is one such creature. A fearless companion to carry true warriors to battle."âClever Woman Moritra
7795.name: Sovngarde Stoutheart Bear

7796.description: "Guar who fall in battle earn a place in Sovngarde. Some later walk among us, serving as faithful and courageous mounts to those who dedicate themselves to brave acts. They leap quickly into action when called."âClever Woman Moritra
7796.name: Valorous Sovngarde Guar Strider

7797.description: "Camels do indeed thrive within Sovngarde. When called to join battle in Tamriel, these resplendent creatures eagerly race forward to meet their valorous riders. Do not believe the claims that they spit mead, though."âClever Woman Moritra
7797.name: Resplendent Sovngarde Camel

7931.description: Don't let Biro-dar's appearance deceive you! He's not your average scholar. In fact, he makes for an entertaining and trouble-prone guest. After adding Biro-dar to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
7931.name: Biro-dar

8013.description: An outlaw with a talent for magic but a thirst for alcohol, Sereyne wants a cozy place to drink her troubles away. Perhaps you can provide? After adding Sereyne to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
8013.name: Sereyne

8016.description: "Imbued with the spirits of those turned away from Sovngarde, this dark courser emanates tendrils and spines of those lost souls. Dare you walk with it along its path of shadows and regret, taking on some of its burden?"âClever Woman Moritra
8016.name: Lambent Shadowmane Courser

8017.description: "Duskstalkers hunt and gather tormented battlefield ghosts, providing these lost souls a safe haven until they willingly leave. They can be seen as wisps, whose colorful auras emanate around both the sabre cat and its rider."âClever Woman Moritra
8017.name: Auric Sabre Cat Duskstalker

8024.description: "Those who give up hope, dying from heartbreak or other such ailments of the spirit, find a kind companion in this wolf. Until they gain peace, these beings sheathe both wolf and rider in colorful mists and jagged spikes."âClever Woman Moritra
8024.name: Silver Nimbus Wolf

8025.description: To those living in Hew's Bane, seeing a spotted senche-serval is an omen of good luck. Some, hoping to gain a constant supply of good fortune, captured and trained several cubs. Now they serve as mountsâgood luck indeed to those so blessed with one!
8025.name: Khefrem Senche-Serval

8026.description: With barding featuring Whiterun's heraldry, this indomitable horse remains sure-footed in the snowy mountains of Skyrim and beyond. Majestic!
8026.name: Whiterun Mountain Charger

8027.description: This wolf of light was born out of fierce devotion, and it tirelessly seeks a rider whose soul burns brightly for Meridia, the Lady of Infinite Energies. Will it be drawn to your inner light?
8027.name: Auroran Penumbra Wolf

8028.description: The magic of the Icereach Coven shapes these striped durzogs in the womb, and handlers train the pups to the saddle. To transfer loyalty to a new rider, that rider should sleep with the saddle for a few days before attempting to mount the durzog.
8028.name: Frostborn Durzog Mangler
8028.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

8029.description: Sparks fly with this dwarven spider! Light up your life by taking this automaton for a lively jaunt around town. It'll follow over any terrain, happily zapping away!
8029.name: Energetic Dwarven Shock-Spider
8029.hint: Acquired by earning the "Stonethorn Explorer" achievement.

8030.description: Dramatic coloration marks this gryphon as one originally bred by Khajiit in Elsweyr. Due to some "incidents," the unfortunate breeders sold their stock, making them available to fine folk such as you!
8030.name: Firepoint Fledgling Gryphon

8031.description: Some may find the fiery cuteness of this horned cub unbearable, but you can handle it! Just watch out for those adorable little pawsâthey're hot as coals.
8031.name: Nightmare Firestalker Cub

8032.description: "This devious little creature will drop the ambient temperature considerably when summoned. And mind your fingersâthe little monster likes nothing better than to freeze them, break them off, and pop them into its mouth!"âDivayth Fyr
8032.name: Frostshriek Imp

8033.description: Originally from the Tenmar Jungle, these green moths spread via caravans and carry the scent of fresh spring rains with every flap of their wings.
8033.name: Springlight Moth

8034.description: Though adorable, even as cubs these sabre cats seek out trolls in the White River region, hoping to nip at their flesh and bring them down by sheer force of numbers. Luckily for you, you're not a troll! Also, we mentioned they're adorable, yes?
8034.name: Graywinter Sabre Cat Cub

8035.description: "Potential. Bear cubs from Sovngarde sense it and follow those who have itâall the way back to Sovngarde. While here, they make for sometimes silly companions."âClever Woman Moritra
8035.name: Sovngarde Bear Cub

8036.description: "You may laugh at the idea of a pony guar from Sovngarde, but they exist. In fact, one showed up around here, but it chose to follow a worthy traveler. Or perhaps one freer with cuddles than I am."âClever Woman Moritra
8036.name: Sovngarde Pony Guar

8037.description: "Noble ponies trot forth from Sovngarde, seeking those who have made oaths, knowingly or not. Curiosity prompts them to follow an oathmaker to see how they fulfill their promise. If one follows you, give it an apple. They love them."âClever Woman Moritra
8037.name: Sovngarde Pony

8038.description: "Sabre cat cubs from Sovngarde might play with string, but it's not visiting us for such trifles. Instead, they serve as the eyes and ears of Sovngarde, allowing them watch our worldâwhile sometimes getting tangled in yarn."âClever Woman Moritra
8038.name: Sovngarde Sabre Cat Cub

8039.description: "Wolf cubs from the Hall of Valor tumble into our world, ready to help catalogue knowledge for their masters. They particularly love to howl along to skalds and bards, but they'll join up with anyone who travels widely. "âClever Woman Moritra
8039.name: Sovngarde Wolf Pup

8040.description: "My notes indicate these vibrantly hued watchers once inhabited the ruins of Zaintiraris until an unfortunate explorer set them free. Given their color and origin, I suspect Sheogorath holds some sway over them. Also unfortunate."âWarlock Aldaale
8040.name: Amaranthine Pocket Watcher

8041.description: Born with a snarl, these striped durzogs tend to bite the hand that feeds themâbut only gently after they get to know you.
8041.name: Snowsnarl Durzog

8075.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Nocturnal, the Night Mistress.
8075.name: Statuette: Nocturnal, Gloamqueen

8076.description: A miniature statue of the divine warrior Trinimac, holding aloft a sword.
8076.name: Statuette: Trinimac, Paragon

8077.description: A miniature statue of the Night Mother, worshiped by the Dark Brotherhood.
8077.name: Statuette: Revered Night Mother

8088.description: "Placing the Potentate wolves in High Rock in 2E 4 seems off to me, but I find no texts disputing Mirannah of Gwylim's notes. 'Caused a panic in Shornhelm'âwell, these wolves with their horned barding look menacing. Perhaps."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8088.name: Akaviri Potentate Wolf

8089.description: "Mirannah of Gwylim writes 'the Potentate sabre cat mounted regiment combed Skyrim for Reman loyalists in 2E 7'âpotentially accurate. But I think she meant 'killed Solitude's wolves using magical roars' to be local myth."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8089.name: Akaviri Potentate Sabre Cat

8090.description: "Label your fact from fiction, Mirannah! 'The barding on Potentate horses shimmers due to a geas of loyalty Versidue-Shaie instilled in the materials.' No. It's simply magic. But 2E 5 for their first use? Feasible."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8090.name: Akaviri Potentate Charger

8091.description: "While I find the idea of 'Dark Elf assassins chasing Reman's loyalists in Morrowind on luminous Potentate guar steeds' to be laughably absurd, Mirannah's date of 2E 27 seems accurate for the first use of these ferocious mounts."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8091.name: Akaviri Potentate Guar

8092.description: "The Potentate bought several herds of camels in 2E 25 for delivery to Versidue-Shaie, Mirannah of Gwylim states. 'Reman desert pursuit' and 'enchanted barding like bear' are also true. Chased by glowing camelsâwhat a sight!"âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8092.name: Akaviri Potentate Camel

8093.description: Keldora left her adventuring life behind to fulfill her dream of overseeing and organizing a connoisseur's mead collection, though she possesses expertise in all forms of alcohol. After adding Keldora to your home, you can set her on a path.
8093.name: Keldora

8096.description: Gellena left the Icereach Coven to see firsthand what they loathed about other culturesâand to consider what scores she needs to settle. After adding Gellena to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
8096.name: Sister Gellenna

8097.description: Told to go "find yourself" by a Tribunal superior, Deras traveled enough to find all but himself. Now he seeks a quiet meditation spot. After adding Deras to your home, you can set him on a path.
8097.name: Acolyte Deras Arelas

8098.description: "Mirannah of Gwylim notes that the first Imperial bear cavalry came into use in 2E 23. Scrawled next to this: '10th Legion steed?' and 'Leyawiin bear parade.' I can verify the date, but the latter two must be fiction notes."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8098.name: Akaviri Potentate Bear

8124.description: "The instability inherent in the structure of some morpholiths makes them unsuitable for use as sigil stones, yet that doesn't stop certain Daedric Princes from trying. Imagine the surprise when said portals don't work."âWarlock Aldaale
8124.name: Unstable Morpholith

8131.description: A man of few words, Jorn stood guard over Solitude's bank until a recent illness laid him low. Now, his position filled by another, he needs workâperhaps a guard position in your home! After adding Jorn to your home, you can set him on a path.
8131.name: Solitude Guard Jorn

8132.description: Phedre loves history. A lot. Give her a place to study, and her gratitude nears "eternal"âas does her wish to share what she learns. After adding Phedre to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
8132.name: Historian Phedre

8133.description: Ride like the wind on this fleet and sure-footed horse! A favorite of stablemasters, Whiterun Windsteeds possess steady temperaments and gentle gaits, making them the perfect first mount for any rider.
8133.name: Whiterun Windsteed

8134.description: Delicate in both form and color, this pink-hued butterfly flits around Elsweyr, Skyrim, Rivenspireâand around you! Tailor Medresi Grulathil looked to her own butterfly companion for inspiration while crafting ceremonial garb honoring Mara in Solitude.
8134.name: Mara's Blush Butterfly

8151.description: Trophy taken from Lord Falgravn in honor of an Undaunted victory in Kyne's Aegis.
8151.name: Trophy: Lord Falgravn

8152.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Kyne's Aegis.
8152.name: Bust: Lord Falgravn
8152.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Kyne's Aegis.

8153.description: While many crustaceans struggle to remove clinging barnacles, the Barnacle-Back Coral Crabs appreciate the company. Some naturalists believe the crabs welcome their guests' sharpened shells as an added protective layer. But maybe they're just gregarious!
8153.name: Barnacle-Back Coral Crab

8154.description: "The amber glow of this Gill Guar marks its origin as Gideon. Gideon Glowgill Guar is a mouthful, yeah? That's why it's an Ambergill instead. Watching a herd of these race out from Gideon? Impressive, just like their riders!"âUkaspa of Lilmoth
8154.name: Ambergill Guar

8155.description: With the chaos and mischance of Black Fredas on your side, you're sure to cause quite a stir when you pass through townânone wish to catch the eye of your Ashen Sabre Cat lest they fall under its curse!
8155.name: Black Fredas Ashen Sabre Cat

8156.description: None can say the Blazeborn Wolf lacks a bold appearance, formed from flames as it is. Even bolder, though, is its temperament, making it a perfect companion for racing through icy wastes to confront foes you deem worthy of your courage!
8156.name: Blazeborn Wolf

8157.description: None dare stare Riften's native ram in the eyesâit sees threats in many things, and only its owner can meet its gaze without needing to brace for an immediate headbutt. In short, would-be Riften Coalhorn Ram thieves are frequently airborne.
8157.name: Riften Coalhorn Ram

8158.description: Trained with special care, a chaurus egg hunter's horse requires an even temper, a smooth gait, and the ability to navigate through dark passages with equanimity. This steadfast mount will break fewâif anyâof your prized eggs!
8158.name: Chaurus Egg Chaser's Horse

8159.description: As stablehands across Tamriel can attest, the ravager comes by its name honestly, destroying anything that moves between it and its master. Scholars speculate that the blue Hist of Dead-Water Village brought forth this green-hided breed.
8159.name: Nagahide Welwa Ravager

8160.description: "Yes, 2E 30 seems right for the first Cloudracer steed, but Mirannah of Gwylim's notes about them being spectral fall into fiction. While their creation is a mystery, I suspect magic is involved."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8160.name: Potentate Cloudracer Courser

8161.description: "Having ridden this ephemeral senche, I see why Mirannah insists they are spirits. Her origin date of 2E 29 doesn't match another's 2E 35âeither could be true. Regardless, its roar calls forth magic, making it a memorable ride!"âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8161.name: Potentate Halcyon Senche

8185.description: "The inky black form of this steed, first seen in 2E 42 according to Mirannah of Gwylim, reminds me of a Potentate stealth rite used to track down Reman loyalists. I feel a frisson of dread when I ponder my recent ride on one."âHonorata Ancrus, Eyevea
8185.name: Potentate Aphotic Wolf

8186.description: With its sharp teeth, scary spines, and enormous horn, this fabricant follower not only shows that you mean business as you go about your day, but also indicates an appreciation for the complex and refined machines of Sotha Sil.
8186.name: Microtized Verminous Fabricant

8187.description: Frequently seen sniffing items and creatures alike, these Murkmire guar glow a soft amber. Those with close ties to the swamp claim they feel it feeding the guar's light, but some scholars believe the luminescence is simply an alchemical reaction.
8187.name: Tawny Lambent Guar

8188.description: "Talking with the trainers of the wolf riders that Versidue-Shaie established in 2E 4 allowed me to see the armored pups at play. I adored how they bonelessly stretched on the ground. Hard to believe they grow to be so fierce!"âMirannah of Gwylim
8188.name: Akaviri Potentate Wolf Cub

8189.description: "Before heading to Skyrim in 2E 7, the Potentate had to train sabre cat cubs to the saddle. Watching these cubs pounce while wearing their training barding all these many years later almost made me lose my composure and squeal."âMirannah of Gwylim
8189.name: Akaviri Potentate Sabre Cat Cub

8190.description: "In 2E 5, companies using the new enchanted barding designed by Versidue-Shaie's battlemages received their orders: hunt and kill Reman loyalists. Though initially only horses, ponies and more earned the special barding and training."âMirannah of Gwylim
8190.name: Akaviri Potentate Pony

8191.description: "The Potentate first mounted up on guar steeds in 2E 27 under the Red Mountain's shadow, but they trained guar calves to the saddle just outside Mournhold. One barded calf demanded nose-pats from me when I visitedâI couldn't resist."âMirannah of Gwylim
8191.name: Akaviri Potentate Guar Calf

8192.description: "The cubs trained into steeds by the Potentate in 2E 23 proved so successful that this practice continues today. Seeing one melted my heartâthat tail tassel! In their training barding, they walk through Leyawiin's streets each week."âMirannah of Gwylim
8192.name: Akaviri Potentate Bear Cub

8193.description: Bred to withstand the winters in the Druadach Mountains, these dogs are favored among the Timberclaw Reach clan. They show deep tenderness to their clan or family members while protecting their territory with ferocity.
8193.name: Druadach Mountain Dog

8194.description: Quiet, tree-shaded lakes attract these blue-purple moths. Legends claim they glide on starlight and rest upon the Moons' reflections in the water. If one follows you away, good luck is said to bless your path.
8194.name: Dusklight Lunar Moth

8195.description: This fastidious little jerboa originated from Orcrest, but recent events saw them scurry away or go into deep hiding among the nooks and crannies of that ill-fated city. With coaxing, one of these delightful little creatures might venture forth with you!
8195.name: Orcrest Jerboa

8196.description: Who would not want such a cute Breton Terrier trailing behind them, garbed in the red and black of the Ebonheart Pact? Perfidious fools from other alliances, that's who! Blood for the Pact!
8196.name: Pact Breton Terrier

8197.description: So many wiggles in this Breton Terrier! And wearing the Aldmeri Dominion colors of yellow and silver? Such a good dog! The best dog! For the Queen!
8197.name: Dominion Breton Terrier

8198.description: The blue and silver of the Daggerfall Covenant decorate this adorable Breton Terrier, who wants to sniff all the sniffs while you go to war in Cyrodiil. For King and Covenant!
8198.name: Covenant Breton Terrier

8199.description: When raised from the egg, these small chaurus learn commands extraordinarily well. Some folk insist that carrying the egg near your heart helps the chitterling form an attachment to you, making it less likely to wander off and become a menace to others.
8199.name: Teacup Chaurus Chitterling

8200.description: Silver hide and dark gray stripes mark these domesticated boars, which once ran wild around Karthwasten. Their stomachs run on a tight schedule, making them perfect for those who lose track of time. Nothing like waking up to boar snuffles in your ear!
8200.name: Karthwasten Silver Boar

8201.description: "I'm not sure why my apprentice insists on making pets of gooey creatures, but here we are, looking at a smaller void rot. So far, it seems the sleeping potion keeps it tractable. So far. Those black tendrils concern me, however."âAleri Andalor
8201.name: Somnolent Void Rot
8201.hint: Acquired by earning the "Peered into the Abyss" achievement in the Reach.

8218.description: This intimidating horned senche steed wears coal-black barding, making its orange flames stand out in stark contrast. Though none know its origins, the touch of the Deadlands looks to be upon this mount, making it favored by Mehrunes Dagon's adherents.
8218.name: Battlefield Nightmare Senche

8219.description: "As we people of the root know, the Hist provides. With this feathered sep adder, it gives us a creature who provides both loyal companionship, as well as keen eyesight and smell. It senses danger before its companion quite often."âDaixth
8219.name: Jewel-Feathered Sep Adder

8220.description: Some say you should embrace your nightmares. With this darling little bear cub, you can do exactly that! This trundling bundle of adorable terror might have flaming eyes and fiery paws, but it loves hugs.
8220.name: Nightmare Bear Cub

8221.description: Never be without a snowball to throw at â¦ uh, wait. It appears and goes plop onto the ground? Ah, I see! Ahem. Never be without a friendly snowball buddy as you adventure in Tamriel! Guaranteed to show up in even the hottest climates as if by magic.
8221.name: Snowball Buddy
8221.hint: |cff0000This pet cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r

8222.description: "A tale says these green frogs grew as large as Dragons, but envied the Dragons their wings. One pact with Peryite later, and they gained their wings but lost their size. So, best not to make pacts with Peryite. Yet they are amusing companions."âDaixth
8222.name: Viridescent Dragon Frog

8223.description: Born from wamasu taken from Shadowfen to the Deadlands, or so their vendors claim, these progeny light up with fire instead of lightning. When confronted, their fiery spines project fire, making them fierce defenders of those they choose to follow.
8223.name: Deadlands Wamasu

8320.description: A miniature statue of Alessia, the liberator of the humans of Cyrodiil.
8320.name: Statuette: Alessia, Liberator

8321.description: A miniature statue of a Nord warrior with his wolf companion.
8321.name: Statuette: Wolf and Warrior

8322.description: A miniature statue of Morwha, the Yokudan goddess of fertility and love.
8322.name: Statuette: Morwha, Desire's Root

8374.description: A miniature statue of the Hortator Nerevar
8374.name: Statuette: Hortator Nerevar

8375.description: A miniature statue of a Son of Skyrim
8375.name: Statuette: Son of Skyrim

8376.description: A miniature statue of the Scion of Bal
8376.name: Statuette: Scion of Bal

8377.description: Son of Jorunn the Skald-King, Prince Irnskar often feels as if he lives in his father's shadow. Hoping for a respite, he came to visit you. After adding Prince Irnskar to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
8377.name: Prince Irnskar

8378.description: Adusa-daro lives by a code of honor, vigilance, and restraintâthe latter being of particular concern for a vampire. Will you invite her in? After adding Adusa-daro to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
8378.name: Adusa-daro

8379.description: "Want a distraction? If you need to head overland to your mark, take your partner with you on a shiny Dwarven spider, make a showy arrival to draw eyes away from your third, and then get to business. Never fails â¦ someone. Not me."âDahnadreel
8379.name: Duo-Dynamo Burnished Spider

8383.description: The Undaunted, Hroltar, may frown upon modern convenience, but this Reach native is quick to make himself at home in your abode. After adding Hroltar to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
8383.name: Hroltar the Boaster

8455.description: "During the long journey from Nenalata to High Rock, beloved mounts became saviors. A song, nearly forgotten, details how a bear named Sunnawend saved Ayleids from a watery grave as they sought to cross a rain-swollen river."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8455.name: Nenalata Ayleid Bear

8456.description: "King Dynar insisted their camels leave Nenalata as well, setting them to carrying the gravely ill and fatigued among the evacuees. Their fortitude shone brightest with Silatam, who was the last camel standing each rest period."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8456.name: Nenalata Ayleid Camel

8457.description: "While resting during their evacuation from Nenalata, guar mounts would voluntarily form a circle around the young and infirm, protecting them from danger. Their leader, Mafrelatta, set her calves amid them to share warmth."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8457.name: Nenalata Ayleid Guar

8458.description: "The Nenalata horses bore the brunt of the cargo work whether trained for battle or not. To allow them to rest, their riders would often walk alongside them for a time. Oiobaun, though, carried his rider the entire way."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8458.name: Nenalata Ayleid Horse

8459.description: "Hunters among the Nenalata Ayleids teamed up with senche mounts daily to track and kill game to help feed the evacuees. King Dynar joined them, riding Ceydarre; he fed her from his own rations."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8459.name: Nenalata Ayleid Senche

8460.description: "Those riding the Nenalata wolves during the evacuation to High Rock served as scouts, moving ahead of the group. Many wrote of Nenagai, who seemed almost prescient in finding hidden dangers and indicating them to his rider."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8460.name: Nenalata Ayleid Wolf

8461.description: Trophy taken from Arkasis the Mad Alchemist in honor of an Undaunted victory in Stone Garden.
8461.name: Trophy: Stone Husk

8462.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Stone Garden.
8462.name: Bust: Stone Husk
8462.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Stone Garden.

8463.description: Trophy taken from Lady Thorn in honor of an Undaunted victory in Castle Thorn.
8463.name: Trophy: Lady Thorn

8464.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Castle Thorn.
8464.name: Bust: Lady Thorn
8464.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Castle Thorn.

8507.description: Some speak of Reach clans that keep these little bundles of fluff as companionsâand hunt down any who harm them. Regardless of veracity, these creatures love to be cuddled, often sleeping in the crook of their companion's necks.
8507.name: Karthspire Coney

8508.description: "Pregnant mares imbued by a welkynd stone in a lengthy ritual may bear these steeds, my sources say. Additionally, as the Nenalata evacuated, they took with them glowing barding that bolstered these steeds' tirelessness."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8508.name: Welkynd-Born Courser

8509.description: "This steed's glow comes not only from its Culanda-enhanced barding but also from an interaction between it and the animal. Culanda is in its bloodâstate various Nenalata Ayleid writingsâgiving this senche envious grace."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8509.name: Culanda-Born Senche

8510.description: "The eerie glow of those born from Varla-touched wolves, as the Nenalata called them, intensifies when a rider uses Varla-embellished barding. Such wolves possess a sure-footedness that lends them stealth despite their glow."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8510.name: Varla-Born Wolf

8512.description: "Need a mount that won't eat you out of house and home? For two? Well, this argent Dwarven spider mount can manage both! And don't worry about it losing its shineâit'll gleam until the end of times."âDevbarth the Stablemaster
8512.name: Duo-Dynamo Argent Spider

8513.description: The blazing orange of its hide hints at both the origin and temperament of this guar mount. Though born from and shaped in the fiery Deadlands, you hold the power to temper it into a fierce but loyal mount.
8513.name: Deadlands Guar

8514.description: First tamed by the Ahemmusa Ashland tribe, this lighter nix-ox steed only recently gained use by those outside the tribe. In fact, some riders who journeyed through Skyrim's winter noted that this nix-ox loves jumping around in snow.
8514.name: Chyle Seamed Nix-Ox Steed

8515.description: More docile than other rams, this mount provides a steady seat even among the most challenging of mountain terrain. In fact, some Windhelm natives claim they'd not ride any other steed through mountain passes during the winter months.
8515.name: Windhelm Cliff Ram

8516.description: After the Scorch of Senchal and nearby areas, several prides of senche-lions moved into the area. Enterprising and desperate Khajiit trained some of these fearless creatures to saddle, hoping to bolster their forces against deadly Dragons.
8516.name: Pellitine Scorch Senche-Lion

8517.description: This grieving steed of the Silver Dawn lost its riderâand its purpose. Now, it seeks a new companion. As long as you ride in search of worthy foes, this proud warhorse will heed your call.
8517.name: Dawn's Avenger Destrier

8518.description: "At the Battle of Falinesti, several herds of Wood Elf totem elk vanishedâsome say to Khajiit scoundrels. Later, Falinesti Faithful regained them, gifting them to devout riders. What constitutes a devout rider? Ask them."âFlaccus Terentius
8518.name: Falinesti's Faithful Totem Elk

8519.description: Followers of Meridia who assist Aurorans can gain enough favor to earn one of their wolf steeds. Trained for war, these wolves stay the course even in siege situations, making them excellent mounts for all manner of dangerous situations.
8519.name: Auroran Zenith Warwolf

8520.description: "During the Nenalata evacuation, barded wolf pups fought off a berserking bear until a warrior could take it down. These same pups helped keep their Ayleids warm when resting. Fierce but loving little creatures."âBeredalmo the Signifier
8520.name: Nenalata Ayleid Wolf Pup

8521.description: The Dunewalkers once roamed deserts beyond Elsweyr, seeking knowledge amid the sands of other lands. Mighila seeks to return to that tradition, hoping to bring back information on how to definitively vanquish the Dragons. Will you assist her?
8521.name: Dunewalker Senche-Raht

8522.description: Years of winning racing competitions finally bored Hazazkheran, so he ran messages for the queen for a time. Alas, even that grew predictable. Now he wants to poke his whiskers into all the hidden corners of the worldâperhaps with you.
8522.name: Spotted Duneracer Senche-Raht
8522.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

8523.description: "Dremnaken are fearsome creatures with crushing footpads and jagged teeth that promise only pain. Anyone who can strap armor onto one's back and ride it into battle should be doubly feared. That's only logical." Nororlie, Alinor Daedrology Society
8523.name: Dremnaken Wrathsteed

8525.description: After giants claimed the White Fall area as their own, these dark-ombre rams migrated into Skyrim, where Nords trained them to saddle. Although they frequently butt heads, literally, while being broken in, you'll not find a more loyal mount.
8525.name: White Fall Hinterland Ram

8526.description: Some scholars say the eerie blue markings on this nix-ox result from strange energies that once emanated from Mzuleft. Locals claim that no such energies exist these days and immediately speak of the steed's endurance and adaptability.
8526.name: Dagon Fel Nix-Ox Steed

8527.description: That flash of orange and red before a bull kagouti attacks can cause anyone's heart to skipâunless you're riding this intimidating mount into battle! Embrace this creature's ferocity, but be prepared for its adorable cooing when you scratch its nose.
8527.name: Bull Kagouti Charger

8528.description: Bred for war by the Netch Gouger Goblins, these vicious war durzogs require a firm hand or even magical coercion to stop when they have prey within their jaws. Their primitive precocity makes them good choices for those who frequently confront agile foes.
8528.name: Emberthroat Warzog

8529.description: The Winterborn clan claims that winter's frost rimes this wolf's heart and a blizzard's raging winds bellow from its howl. They also state only those with cold hate in their veins can endure riding these creatures.
8529.name: Winterborn Wild Hunt Wolf

8530.description: Bloodroot senches revel in the gore of their rider's battle fury, making them excellent steeds for those who love bloodlust as much as the Dreadhorn clan does. Will you embrace this partnership of slaughter?
8530.name: Bloodroot Wild Hunt Senche

8531.description: Though the Dragon Maarselok's blue-limned scourge illuminates this conjured steed, never fear! The magic that summoned it contains the blight, keeping the Green safeâbut given its penchant for biting, tip the stablemaster extra for its keep.
8531.name: Azure Blight Wild Hunt Steed

8532.description: Though shy, this orange and black creature fiercely defends its den, which builders of Fort Linchal noted in their records. They tamed those they displaced during construction, then took them home to the Imperial City, to the delight of many a noble.
8532.name: Linchal Titian Fox

8533.description: Some Wood Elf spinners claim Y'ffre granted these bunnies as part of the Green Pact, scholars contest that Second Empire Imperials brought them when establishing Woodhearth and, well, nature took its course. These hoppy hares make great fuzzy friends!
8533.name: Woodhearth Brown Rabbit

8534.description: "Everyone told me not to explore Bal Ur. Yeah, Daedric, blah blah whatever. What's worse? Striders there go for the head in droves. Gorgeous colors, though, all red and black, so I trapped and started training them. Won't crack your crown now!"âSkorg
8534.name: Bal Ur Cliff Strider

8535.description: The fiery red of this daedrat's fur indicates its origin: the Oblivion plane called the Deadlands. How it got here and why it's following you are both questions you'd best find the answers to, and soon.
8535.name: Deadlands Daedrat

8536.description: Striking scarlet hues mark this ancestor lizard, which some claim are the ancestors of the Bright-Throats. While this hospitality-minded tribe remains silent on this claim, these lizards are known to comfort the pain of others by nuzzling them.
8536.name: Lilmoth Ancestor Lizard

8537.description: This boar's regal bearing and attire indicate a level of breeding that would not allow for "cute" or "comical" behavior. Nothing could be further from the truth! He digs for his own truffles, plus rumors indicate he loves batter-based treats.
8537.name: Regal Razorback

8538.description: Resourceful scavengers and the bane of all street chefs, rathounds are a favorite among beggars. Survivors from Orcrest say the Rathounds and their uncanny ability to sense danger led a canine exodus from the city before it fell to the Knahaten Flu.
8538.name: Orcrest Rathound

8539.description: Originally from General Thibaut's hunting pack, these dogs later gained a reputation as fierce defenders of Greenhill's livestock and grain. If you're looking to keep rats out of your bags plus gain a loyal companion to hug, this handsome dog is for you.
8539.name: Greenhill Farmdog

8540.description: Both the fleecy white sheep and their doughty shepherds enjoy the clear water of Cloud Spring in High Rock. Though dangers abound, the sheep avoid the worst of it, making the rumors of their ability to sense and avoid peril seem plausible.
8540.name: Cloud Spring White Sheep

8541.description: Though one Reach clan claims their ancestors bring them messages via these snowy bunnies, the creatures seem mundane enough. That said, it couldn't hurt to have someone's extremely cute and cuddly ancestor helping you, right?
8541.name: Powderwhite Coney

8542.description: Those traversing the Niben River can see these fellrunners racing along the banks, avoiding dangers while seeking safe water. Enterprising merchants capture and sell them to buyers captivated by their teal-feathered, avian beauty.
8542.name: Niben River Fellrunner

8543.description: The Nords absolutely loathe these particular nixads since they interfere with their beesâand thus mead production. In an effort to help, Solitude's Mages Guild trained them to take instruction, making them into companions. Need a drinking buddy?
8543.name: Nectarthief Nixad

8544.description: "The unusual decorative touches on this clockwork creature show off the skill of its creator, which must be Sotha Sil himself. To what purpose? Well, I plan to keep one by my side to see if that ever becomes clear."âJournal fragment found on a skeleton
8544.name: Blue Cloisonne Clockwork Shalk

8545.description: The superstitious Nords of Solitude seek out wool originating from the black sheep of Bleakrock, claiming its dark color fends off evil intent. True or not, these darling sheep love to curl up next to their keepers and help them fall asleep.
8545.name: Bleakrock Black Sheep

8546.description: Legends claim the Red Mountain's first eruption not only gave brown sheep their current hue, but also imbued them with the fortitude to thrive despite hardship. Knowing their sheep remain placid while in danger, many Dark Elves believe these tales.
8546.name: Ascadian Umber Sheep

8547.description: Long ago, some of the striped fawns of Clearspring Tarn felt a call to migrate elsewhere, and they eventually found protection and a home with the Falinesti Wood Elves. Though you can spot them in many areas, they retain their original name.
8547.name: Clearspring Striped Fawn

8551.description: Some adventurers call animunculi like these nuisances since they get under foot easily. Some who prefer constructed companions recommend the Dwarven Scarab over any other type, stating that not only are they pleasing to the eye but also neat as a pin.
8551.name: Dwarven Scarab
8551.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in the Reach.

8823.description: Taming even a young terror bird requires patience, full-coverage armor, and even more patience. The result, however, can put pause to any seeking to cast you in the role of victim. Plus these fledglings cuddle so nicely while making cute sleeping noises!
8823.name: Fledgling Terror Bird

8835.description: "I named these senches Nighthaunts because, I suspect, the cult of Vaermina curiosities I was studying during their creation affected their appearance and intensified their glow. Not their nature. Grim-looking they are, yes, but not evil."âMage Naleldil
8835.name: Nighthaunt Gloomspore Senche

8845.description: What do you really know about the mysterious Dremora Lyranth aside from her affiliation with Coldharbour's Foolkiller clan? Listen and maybe learn. After adding Lyranth to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
8845.name: Lyranth

8846.description: A chef of many soups, but perhaps only one at a time, the Argonian Makes-Many-Soups seeks to add her culinary creativity to your abode. After adding Makes-Many-Soups to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
8846.name: Makes-Many-Soups

8847.description: Javinus Tirnendo left the Order of the Waking Flame, a cult dedicated to Mehrunes Dagon. Now he seeks refuge from his former allies. Will you help? After adding Javinus to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
8847.name: Javinus Tirnendo

8872.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Vateshran Hollows.
8872.name: Bust: Maebroogha
8872.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Vateshran Hollows.

8873.description: Trophy taken from Maebroogha in honor of an Undaunted victory in Vateshran Hollows.
8873.name: Trophy: Maebroogha

8874.description: The magic-wielding knights of Zenithar's Crucible prize these molten steeds above all elseâeven their arms and armor! To this day, no force has weathered the charge of an Iron destrier.
8874.name: Iron Atronach Horse

8875.description: Aer, the Conjurer Magnificent, summoned the first of these Iron Bears in 1E 2150. According to her notes, the lumbering, ursine frame matches the atronach's temperament perfectly, making the calling-ritual far easier.
8875.name: Iron Atronach Bear

8876.description: Famous Redguard conjurer, Rozaba af-Nizhadal, often referred to Iron Atronach Camels as "glass-treaders." Adventurers in Hammerfell still find glass tracks from where the atronach's scorching feet seared the sand!
8876.name: Iron Atronach Camel

8877.description: On a drunken dare, the mage Tarvyn Othren summoned the first known Iron Atronach Guar, which immediately killed his companions. Grieving, the mage sought redemption, riding only that guar as a reminder of his mistake.
8877.name: Iron Atronach Guar

8878.description: Stories tell of how Maalanrie Direnni, though restrained by bandits, somehow walked through dreams and called the first Iron Atronach Senche. Upon arrival, it destroyed her cage and freed her so she could kill her captors and flee upon its molten back.
8878.name: Iron Atronach Senche

8879.description: Of all the Iron Atronach's diverse forms, the wolf comes hardest. Atronachs resent the wolves' pack reliance and yearn for a shape befitting their solitary nature. Mages who bend these molten goliaths into a lupine form are among the strongest in Tamriel.
8879.name: Iron Atronach Wolf

8880.description: "Burning ash and feathers dark, sharpened claws and rageâthese hew close to the Razor Prince, or so explains a sage. Yet ere chaos warped this beast, Direnni crafted well. The Deadlands taints it with fell heat, impossible to quell."âQilik the Skaafin
8880.name: Dagonic Quasigriff

8884.description: A miniature statue of a Nord skald with hawk and horn.
8884.name: Statuette: Child of the Sky

8885.description: A miniature statue of Boethra and feline companion, a banisher of the demon Orkha.
8885.name: Statuette: Boethra, Orkha-Bane

8886.description: A miniature statue of Kinlord Nemfarion, founder of Corgrad on Summerset Isle.
8886.name: Statuette: Kinlord Nemfarion

8906.description: "A hint of playfulness. A touch of joy. An aura of mystery. These mix under Jode's light and take the form of a masked fox who seeks out these traits in their next rider. Or so the priests say. But maybe they've had too much moon-sugar."âSulema
8906.name: Ja'zennji Siir Fox
8906.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

8907.description: "True, these golden wolves hail from Solstheim, but bred by Snow Elves? Ha! Mead hall fish tales. What matters is they heed the call to battle. Snow, ice, trolls, avalanches â¦ they'll face it all with a snarl!"âAelirma of Solitude
8907.name: Solstheim Lunar Wolf

8994.description:
This Blackfeather Court banker wants your shinies â¦ to keep them safe for you, of course! The chaos of Cyrodiil and Battlegrounds are murder on his plumage, so he won't visit you there.

When summoned, his services can be used by you and your groupmates.
8994.name: Baron Jangleplume, the Banker

8995.description:
This Blackfeather Court merchant can relieve you of shiny, non-illicit burdens. She avoids Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, describing them as "unprofitable" and "full of fat-legged giants."

When summoned, her services can be used by you and your groupmates.
8995.name: Peddler of Prizes, the Merchant

9009.description: Scholars disagree on whether these iron atronach steeds took on the aeonstone hues during the summoning ritual intentionally or after by mistake. Motives aside, riders magically summon these mounts, creating an impressively explosive visual impact.
9009.name: Viridian Iron Steed

9010.description: Born from the same wretched forges as Dark Anchors, these ebony-alloy senche atronachs manifest in a burst of soul-searing light when called. Though onlookers may feel as if they'll never be warm again, some riders claim they feel nothing while mounted.
9010.name: Black Forge Iron Senche

9011.description: A meteoric boom presages the arrival of this summoned atronach wolf, making it a natural for those who prefer to live with flairâand flare! A sunset's ruby radiance lends its hue to this steed's magical glow. Glory in its intense incandescence.
9011.name: Sunflare Iron Wolf

9057.description: Trophy taken from Pyroturge Encratis in honor of an Undaunted victory in Black Drake Villa.
9057.name: Trophy: Encratis's Behemoth
9057.hint: Awarded for completing Black Drake Villa.

9058.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Black Drake Villa.
9058.name: Bust: Encratis's Behemoth
9058.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Black Drake Villa.

9059.description: Trophy taken from Baron Zaudrus in honor of an Undaunted victory in The Cauldron.
9059.name: Trophy: Baron Zaudrus

9060.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in The Cauldron.
9060.name: Bust: Baron Zaudrus
9060.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran The Cauldron.

9062.description: Through an Argonian ritual imbued by the Razor Prince's chaos, this former welwa mount seethes with both fury and destruction in conflagration-touched form. Only the strong-willed can control this beast. Perhaps that's you?
9062.name: Sul-Xan Fleshripper
9062.hint: Complete the "Xalvakka's Bane" achievement in the Rockgrove trial.

9063.description: Though some claim these horses are bred purely for show, the Grand Nibenese Stallion serves as more than just a good luck charm in Leyawiin. They possess a keen intelligence and even temperamentâmaintaining their composure, even on crowded streets.
9063.name: Grand Nibenese Stallion

9064.description: "Though Iron Orcs ate nearly all these gentle camels, the puissant Elinhir mages took them in, allowing them to flourish. With their flowing gaits and downy fur, the sweet-scented creatures became the mages' steed of choice."âGarold Farfly
9064.name: Dappled Elinhir Camel

9065.description: This steed's sunny disposition matches its vibrant multihued coat, making it an excellent horse for a new riderâor one who regularly ventures into treacherous situations. Herds often race the Gold Coast waves, manes flowing freely and tails high.
9065.name: Sungold Bay Thoroughbred

9066.description: "The stars do not always stay in the sky in Craglorn. They wander, leaping over rocks, and occasionally eat everything you planted in your garden. Those tusking goats can take their shimmering hides somewhere else!"âUbri, Belkarth Horticulturalist
9066.name: Celestial Ram

9067.description: Once considered a delicacy by Maormer, these iridescent mudcrabs regard every creature a threat, even other mudcrabs. With proper handling, it probably won't snap at your nose. Probably.
9067.name: Wasten Coraldale Mudcrab

9068.description: While Alik'r natives count this sleeping boar's twitches to foretell of coming sandstorms, others enjoy its penchant to bob along to a drum's beat or squeal until it gains a taste of burgundy wine. Clearly, a boar that favors festivities! Like you, maybe?
9068.name: Goldspine Boar

9069.description: Ask an Iliac Bay native what they'd miss most about their home and the answer might be the sight of tree-climbing spotted goats. Fortunately for these goat-lovers, the creatures now bleat their way from the bay to climb all manner of trees in new homes.
9069.name: Iliac Spotted Goat

9070.description: Ready for action? Like Khamira herself, this kitten certainly is! With a roll and a hiss, Ja'khajiit Khamira enters your life, ready to face danger at your side.
9070.name: Ja'khajiit Khamira

9071.description: Because these ponies love flowersâto the point of nudging and nickering at any picking themâNibenese folk started stabling them amid gardens as guardians. Their gentle grace in such a colorful setting make them superb companions for beauty lovers.
9071.name: Nibenese Pony

9072.description: These cerulean-toned haj mota hatchlings learn to fend for themselves amid ice caves, frozen wastes, and crevasses early on. If you tame one, not only do you have a future terror loyal to you, but you also gain its keen survival instinct in frosty lands.
9072.name: Scutecicle Haj Mota

9073.description: Syliril the trapper caught a sabre cat from the Vale and presented it to Emperor Durcorach in 2E 531. Not to be outdone, Durcorach's beastmaster created a more resplendent cat. He was fed to the hunting dogs when the color washed out of the cat's fur.
9073.name: Vale Sabre Cat

9074.description: The Argonian who named this multihued jelly claims inspiration from the mineral, though some note she was calling it a "watermelon jelly" first. Oddly enough, some find its flavor resembles that of the fruit.
9074.name: Tourmaline Swamp Jelly

9075.description: With pincers resembling Dagon's spires and a ferocious multibarbed stinger, these Deadlands natives see most creatures as prey. If you let a softshell baby ride your shoulders until it molts, however, you might just have a friend for life. Might.
9075.name: Deadlands Scorpion

9076.description: Visiting the Stitches requires a certain amount of fortitude and bravado. Living there, as do these cavies, involves hiding and good timing, as well. Gain a cavy's hard-won trust, and you gain a furry friend seeking neck-snuggles for life.
9076.name: Stitchfur Cavy

9079.description: Watching mighty trees fall to this ram's practice leaps and headbutts led to its eventual domestication by the Nords around its home peak. Bring that power, as well as its love of scaling treacherous heights, into your stable!
9079.name: Eldersblood Peak Ram

9083.description: "Blackwood has some odd creatures. Take the bog dog. Sure, it lives in bogs, but it's no dog. That said, tame it and train it, and it'll follow you anywhere. Just make sure the local guards know it's yours."âGrelaith of White Stallion Inn
9083.name: Bog Dog
9083.hint: Acquired by completing the "Lost in the Wilds" achievement in Blackwood.

9088.description: The long-suffering Stibbons, Lady Laurent's servant, needs a break. He chose to seek you out, desperate for the peace your home provides. After adding Stibbons to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
9088.name: Stibbons

9089.description: Erilthel's quest to become Lady Twilight, Tamriel's greatest thief, brought her to your door until her teacher, Seeks-the-Dark, finds her again. After adding Erilthel to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
9089.name: Erilthel

9090.description: The blacksmith, Narboth, dedicated her life to her art after fulfilling an oath to Malacath. Now she seeks a worthy patron. After adding Narboth to your home, you can set her on a path.
9090.name: Narboth

9235.description:
These black-and-gold barded destriers carry their riders with distinction as they sweep across Cyrodiil, serving as but one symbol of goals and experiences their dauntless combatants share. 

|cFFFFFFRiding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r
9235.name: Bonds of Battle Destrier

9236.description:
The envy of treasure-seekers throughout Tamriel, this sure-footed steed serves as both a sturdy companion and an enduring reminder of what fellowship and camaraderie can achieve.

|cFFFFFFRiding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r
9236.name: Guild's Pride Charger

9238.description: "If the creature following behind me truly is a ghost, then this is the gentlest haunting I have ever seen. The crustation only skitters at my feet and occasionally clacks its claws at unwelcome houseguests."âBensharaz, Spirit Hunter
9238.name: Spectral Mudcrab

9240.description: In the wild, Topaz Terror Birds cloak themselves in wind-blown sand to ambush unsuspecting prey. This little fledgling is keen to practice the technique, so be sure to warn your companions before a sandstorm hits. No one wants to lose a toe!
9240.name: Topaz Fledgling Terror Bird

9243.description: "Which lowland does this ornery creature call home? Why, all of them! Think I'm exaggerating? Believe what you want, but know that unless trained while young, they'll charge you in a heartbeat. Best have them on your side."âMiet, Breeder
9243.name: Lowland Bristleback

9244.description: These feral pigs prowl through the boreal forests of Bleakrock Isle. They grudgingly adapt to domestication, and take pleasure in plowing through deep snow, mud, or grasslands alongside their owners.
9244.name: Snowbarrow Boar

9246.description: A product of wizardry and selective breeding, these chimeric steeds descend from Summerset gryphons. According to creator Irastimil Direnni, their wingless frame kept upkeep costs low, while maintaining superiority over the upstart Bretons' clumsy steeds.
9246.name: Quasigriff

9247.description: A miniature statue of Syrabane, an Aldmeri god-ancestor of magic.
9247.name: Statuette: Syrabane, the Warlock

9248.description: A miniature statue of Kynareth, Divine patron of sailors and travelers.
9248.name: Statuette: Kynareth, Air Goddess

9249.description: "This lithe feline possesses the quiet madness of a clever assassin, making it a harmonious steed for those methodically ending the lives of others. Even betterâmine sometimes brings gifts of mangled Mer. Perhaps you'll be so lucky?"âMother Regrets
9249.name: Grinning Terror Senche

9250.description: "I can't pick a favorite from the Grinning Terrors, but this ominous horse kissed by madness appeals to me on a visceral level. Perhaps because they enjoy spreading the viscera of unwelcome riders about with their hooves."âMother Regrets
9250.name: Grinning Terror Steed

9251.description: "You need more than colorful barding to harness one of these bearsâa splash of blood freed by Neb-Crescen and a teardrop from a watcher's eye might bind one to your cause. Might. Otherwise, stand clear. You won't survive their hugs."âMother Regrets
9251.name: Grinning Terror Bear

9252.description: "Croon to this guar, describing recent murder sprees, and you might win a place at this guar's side. Or capture its attention by emulating loud bodily functions. Either delights this creature."âMother Regrets
9252.name: Grinning Terror Guar

9253.description: "This wolf might seem a playful Jester's Festival creatureâa performer's beast ready to entertain. But no. Its sharp wit and sharper teeth care not for another's amusement, favoring its own. Only its rider is safe from its joy-nips."âMother Regrets
9253.name: Grinning Terror Wolf

9254.description: According to the Ash'abah, if you receive one of these fierce sep adders as a gift and you both survive for a year with each other, you have passed the first trial necessary to trade in poisons. Bonus? You keep the jewel-toned creatureâif you live.
9254.name: Sapphire Sep Adder

9255.description: Nearly driven to extinction a century ago by Nibenese, who used their brilliant ruby wing dust as rouge, these moths made a comeback in a different area: Valenwood. Friendly to a fault, they are now favored companions among alchemists.
9255.name: Carmine Wood Moth
