9256.description: Farmers in Southern Cyrodiil carry an antidote to Spotted Plow Spiders since it is not uncommon to accidentally rake through a nest and be bitten by thousands of tiny hatchlings. Despite the dangers and if raised correctly, the spiders make good pets.
9256.name: Spotted Plow Spider

9257.description: A staple of Morthal wardens, these imposing bears trundle near the outskirts of town, serving as extra guards when not in use as steeds or resting. Those who seek to one day become valiant defenders of their town often sneak away to feed them extra treats.
9257.name: Sunback Bear

9275.description: Said to have been bred by Coral-Splitter Goblins to hunt for fresh fish, these aqua-blue and coral-striped durzogs spread to the shores of Topal Bay decades ago. To this day, they still love to dive into the surf and snag aquatic bounty!
9275.name: Topal Durzog

9276.description: With dappled skin perfectly matched to the white rock and marshy wetlands east of Bthanual, these Kagouti favor stealth and ambushes over brute force attacks. Ride one of these creatures and you'll be sure to turn heads in Mournhold.
9276.name: Chalkhide Kagouti

9277.description: The Knights of the Silver Rose spent years finding the best felines to rid their fortress of pests and annoyances. Generations later, and these senche-servals can clear out banekin infestations in a single day.
9277.name: Silver Rose Senche-Serval

9278.description: Woe to any who ride this fiery steed without its consent! Sanctified by ashes from the funeral pyres of venerated witches, this wicker steed blazes a path across Tamriel and beyond, reminding any mortals who see it of their own short lifespans.
9278.name: Bonfire Wicker-Steed

9368.description: "Celestial senches prowl over jagged rocks on surprisingly soft paws for creatures made of Spellscar-like stone. Yes, the Steed constellation is a horse, but how the Warrior didn't ride a starry senche into battle is beyond me."âMadadi, Celestial Scholar
9368.name: Starchaser Senche

9370.description: "The glow emanating from this celestial horse soothes and energizes me at the same time. Odd, given its origins in Spellscar. Sitting astride this mystical mount can make even the most wretched pauper feel like a master mage."âMadadi, Celestial Scholar
9370.name: Nebulous Star-Born Steed

9377.description: The Cropsford Hen is a beloved staple of many Cyrodilic farmsteads since just one hen will staunchly protect the entire coop against foxes. Children in Cropsford say the hens herd them into the coop whenever a hawk is circling.
9377.name: Cropsford Hen

9378.description: "My Wick and I have built many nests, felled sickened trees, and cleaned the roots of our Hist. Dryskins think shalks of her color are lucky, but Wick dirties her pinchers in rotting bark for our fortune."âVunsu, Arborealist
9378.name: Mzark Jade-Cap Shroom Shalk

9379.description: Wardens of Morthal ride large, hulking Sunback Bears into battle. While the full-sized bears tend to scare villagers, cubs are more easily accepted. Plus, the cubs' tiny ears can get the staunchest of merchants to lower their prices.
9379.name: Sunback Bear Cub

9382.description: "The Mind-Shriven usually have no concept of the self, but this feline appears to be as content with its nature as always. It seems that Molag Bal himself cannot enslave a cat."âWarlock Aldaale
9382.name: Mind-Shriven Cat

9383.description: This hound's attire may suggest that it was once a fun-loving companion; there is nothing playful about it now. This resurrected creature is not for the faint of heart, but it will show loyalty in not setting you ablaze with its fiery muzzle.
9383.name: Infernal Trickster Death Hound

9384.description: "There is madness in all of us, and senches don't commit to anything half-heartedly. I came across one such mad senche and still bear the scars of its wild attacks. To take one on an adventure, you'd have to be mad as Sheogorath himself!"âVi Aspblade
9384.name: Dark Delirium Senche

9385.description: The shadowy shapes of inky goats lead revelers through the streets to Sanguine's latest celebration. Often, the animals are fitted with the symbols of the party: sweet drinks and heady rose perfumes. Take a ram like this into your care at your own peril.
9385.name: Ram of Dark Delights

9386.description: "Clockwork fabricants possess keen intelligence, but their characters remain blank slates. Rumor has it that the Astronomer can import a dissected beast's memories directly into a fabricant's animo core, making for an enlightened mount."âUleni Silarys
9386.name: Mnemoflare Kagouti Fabricant

9387.description: Originally found in the arid canyons of Northern Elsweyr, these striped beauties rarely submit to training, making cats that do extremely desirable. Just make sure to have plenty of toys on hand or you'll find your leather boots gnawed to pieces.
9387.name: Dunecoat Senche-Serval

9388.description: A crackle of lightning accompanies this hatchling wherever it goes, providing a foreshadowing of what it will become in its adulthood. Before that point, though, it makes an excellent if imposing adventuring buddy!
9388.name: Wamasu Hatchling

9389.description: Few Reach witches make the effort to invest eldritch magic into unborn pups, train them to draw attention without fear, and decorate them with eerie skeletal bone markings. All it takes is one look to either fear this canine or love it beyond reason.
9389.name: Witch-Tamed Bear-Dog

9390.description: Known for their prowess at sweeping an area clean of shalks, these armored kittens possess a keen sense of group tactics at an early age. So, not only do you gain an affectionate furball as a friend, but you also have fewer pests distracting you.
9390.name: Ironclad Senche-Serval Kitten

9399.description: Woven carefully from shadow wisps of Nocturnal's realm, these noble indriks shy from the light of day until trained by a patient rider to tolerate it. Forever after, they move under Magnus's fierce glow as if to defy it.
9399.name: Evergloam Indrik

9400.description: These wolves were among the first creatures to storm Evermore when the Reachmen's attack broke through the city's walls. Each wolf's unique markings display their lineage with some incorporating designs from Durcorach's beloved howler herself.
9400.name: Black Drake Howler

9401.description: Contrary to popular belief, this cute-yet-terrifying Evergloam creature does not eat shadows to grow larger. But they definitely do win at games that involve hiding in murky placesâa gift from Nocturnal herself, perhaps?
9401.name: Gloam Gryphon Fledgling

9408.description: A popular song in Camlorn tells of a white Breton Terrier who wiggles himself into a pile of ashes.  Different singers offer rhyming suggestions on how to clean the terrier, but by the time the chorus is reached the terrier never gets the stain out.
9408.name: Sooty Breton Terrier

9409.description: "Though I agree these pyrelings are fiery and intimidating, I can't believe they acted like ticks on Dragons, as one scholar who shall remain nameless stated in my presence. No, instead I think they are variants native to the Deadlands."âVi Aspblade
9409.name: Scorion Pyreling
9409.hint: Awarded by earning the "Waking Flame Explorer" achievement.

9431.description: A favorite of veterinarians and beast masters across Tamriel, these netches are prized for their clear gelatinous outer membranes that allow students to view its organs from a distance.
9431.name: Pellucid Swamp Jelly
9431.hint: Acquired from the Gates of Oblivion Grab Bag.

9437.description: "After much knowledge-seeking, I learned to summon an illusion of a small, fiery Dragon to follow me. While it's not the same as the real thing, that endears me to it more. Who wants a real Dragon around, after all?"âNinaleon Sightbinder the First
9437.name: Soulfire Dragon Illusion

9439.description: This Dremnaken may be the runt of its pack, but it is still prepared to follow its leader into danger. It uses its armor to show other Dremnaken that it is every bit as fierce as they are, despite its diminutive size.
9439.name: Dremnaken Runt
9439.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Hope Springs Eternal."

9440.description: Diligent and steadfast heroes like Bastian Hallix still need time to unwind. His chivalrous charm is sure to brighten up any room. After adding Bastian to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
9440.name: Bastian Hallix

9441.description: The intrepid explorer, Mirri Elendis, needs a break from her irksome family. With thrilling tales and a sailor's mouth, she's sure to impress! After adding Mirri to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
9441.name: Mirri Elendis

9442.description: Granted to the winner of the 2020 Tamriel Together Sweepstakes. After adding Larry, Duke of the Dance to your home, you can set him on a path.
9442.name: Larry, Duke of the Dance

9445.description: "Long ago, during the annual Ket Keptu hunt, Tula the Skullcleaver and their bear Falk rose above the others in the amount of prey they killed for the shared larder. In celebration, Falk received these markings of Hircine's favor."âFori, Keptu Scholar
9445.name: Keptu Bear

9446.description: Several theories circulate on the nature of the torchnix's light. Some scholars suggest the luminescence is a mating display, while others argue that it's a form of communication. Children in Ahemmusa tell each other the glow is bad food in the nix's gut.
9446.name: Summer's Herald Torchnix

9448.description: The cockerels of Alcaire Castle uphold their noble duty and make as much noise during daybreak as possible. Their screeching continues well into the morning, waking any lucky enough to miss out on their earliest morning calls.
9448.name: Alcaire Blue Cockeral

9449.description: Creating a perfect diversion any time it walks behind you, a Rustbite Ringtail's adorably wide eyes never fail to draw a crowd of enamored onlookers. What you do with a crowd of happily distracted townsfolk is your business.
9449.name: Rustbite Ringtail

9450.description: "Now, surely the presence of this creature is enough to dissuade those pompous academics from believing magic created the first Vvardvark. Who would create a creature so listless that moss grows on it?"âAtmore, Vvardenfell Zoological Field Commission
9450.name: Mossy Vvardvark

9451.description: Known for its brilliant yellow hues, this moth flits through the deciduous fall forests of Cyrodiil almost unseen. Each year, some fly beyond the Heartland's borders in all directions, as if trying to escape the war-torn province.
9451.name: Mustardseed Moth

9452.description: Originally, young Keptu bear cubs received fresh markings once each season to gain Hircine's favor. Some seeking to keep the tradition alive continue to mark cubs until these creatures bond to a hunting companion, then share the marking ritual with them.
9452.name: Keptu Bear Cub

9459.description: "The hues on these reefborn steedsâwondrous, yes? Instead of flowing manes on these so-called equines, colorful coral grew. Just don't try to feed them apples. They prefer to feed on algal blooms."âSaissula, Stablemaster
9459.name: Reefborn Charger

9460.description: "Those who love wolves may find this breed boosts their prestige in some Abecean coastal areas, especially among the druid folk. While you need stern discipline to train this one to saddle, you gain a lifelong adventuring partner."âSaissula, Stablemaster
9460.name: Reefborn Wolf

9461.description: "Mages Guild scholars think someone creates these types of senches. With what magic, I don't know. Maybe some sea-loving druid? Regardless, they're as fierce as you'd expect for a senche mount."âSaissula, Stablemaster
9461.name: Reefborn Senche-Lion

9462.description: Foolhardy warriors travel into the charred Deadlands forests to face off against the ursine horrors that reside there. Lucky adventurers return to their homelands alive, but forever haunted by the sound of red-hot claws digging into ashen dirt.
9462.name: Nightmare Bear

9463.description: "If you visit Abecean islands, you need to be ready to handle reefborn creatures. The bears, for example, do bear things. Mostly. But watch them near saltwaterâthey'll roll in it whether you're on them or not."âSaissula, Stablemaster
9463.name: Reefborn Bear

9464.description: "You'll find few wild guars wandering Abecean shores, but these coral beasts dance in the shallows nonetheless. Wherever they came from, they still exhibit the tamed guars' playful disposition."âSaissula, Stablemaster
9464.name: Reefborn Guar

9465.description: Trophy taken from Xalvakka in honor of an Undaunted victory in Rockgrove.
9465.name: Trophy: Xalvakka

9466.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Rockgrove.
9466.name: Bust: Xalvakka

9507.description: "Some claim these elk originate from necromantic rituals involving restless spirits. Perhaps, I say. Regardless, these fawns make for delightful companions, though they'll sometimes stare at nothing for hours."âPhrastus of Elinhir
9507.name: Palefrost Elk Fawn

9510.description: Moonlight glints off glittering snowflakes during a ritual to imbue a white elk with the intelligence of a ghost captured from the frigid seas near Jehannaâor so claims High Rock lore. True or not, this steed understands more than most expect.
9510.name: Palefrost Elk Mount

9511.description: Granted to the winner of the 2020 Tamriel Together Sweepstakes.
9511.name: Statue of Gloria

9512.description: All Star-Born horses are children of the Steed. Impatient and in a rush, these creatures are difficult to tame. Any time spent earning their trust is always recovered the second they're allowed to canter down an open road.
9512.name: Star-Born Guardian Horse

9513.description: "Don't let this bear's mesmerizing stars fool you into thinking it's a harmless bit of magical transport. Recall the sway of the Constellations, and understand that this creature embodies that power."âWheezing Wilren
9513.name: Star-Born Guardian Bear

9514.description: Legends in Fulstrom say that a star-studded guar brought the bastard child of King Vrage to their village one snowy night. No one heard or saw the pair arrive, until a child cried out for warmth. The guar disappeared before dawn.
9514.name: Star-Born Guardian Guar

9515.description: Senches are opinionated creatures, but ones imbued with the confidence of the stars are infinitely more judgmental than their Nirn-born counterparts. Riding one of these across Tamriel is a clear sign that even the stars heed your power.
9515.name: Star-Born Guardian Senche

9516.description: "There's something out there, stalking me through the dark underbrush. My eyes deceive me and see only stars moving across a starless sky. They growl and bare their pointed teeth. Vaermina take pity."âHavaldar the Crazed
9516.name: Star-Born Guardian Wolf

9517.description: A painting of Leyawiin, the Nibenese city standing at the mouth of the Niben River and known for its majestic chapel honoring Zenithar.
9517.name: Painting: Leyawiin Awaits

9523.description: A perfect replica of the Adytum Gate from the Zenithar Abbey.
9523.name: Replica Zenithar Adytum Gate
9523.hint: Created by combining 50 Inscribed Shards from the Zenithar Abbey in Blackwood.

9524.description: Exquisitely designed, this warm-hued tapestry of Blackwood serves as both an art piece and a practical guide to the region.
9524.name: Blackwood Tapestry
9524.hint: Acquired as an Antiquity, found in Blackwood.

9565.description: "When Sir Byric's flames razed the ground outside our walls and the Reachfolk hurled stones at our walls. I stood tall at my post, knowing that our smallest knights padded the ramparts alongside me."âSir Hughes, Alcaire Castle
9565.name: Knights of the Flame Pup

9566.description: A miniature statue of Sai Sahan, the liberator of Leyawiin.
9566.name: Statuette: Sai Sahan, Deliverer

9567.description: A miniature statue of Zenithar, holding an anvil.
9567.name: Statuette: Zenithar, God of Toil

9568.description: The Khajiit called M'aiq the Liar travels widely, speaking foolishlyâor wisely, depending on whom you ask. Host him before deciding, yes? After adding M'aiq to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
9568.name: M'aiq the Liar

9569.description: Is your home bedecked in shiny treasures? Did you leave carrion out in the sun? Regardless, Blackfeather Court's most nettlesome squire noticed! After adding Squire Caw to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
9569.name: Squire Caw

9570.description: Trained in the Battlespire, Lucilla Caprenia made a decision that altered her future. As she ponders her next steps, invite her into your abode! After adding Lucilla to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
9570.name: Lucilla Caprenia

9571.description: A painting of the Havocrel named Baron Zaudrus, defeating those who oppose him.
9571.name: Painting: Baron Zaudrus Triumphs

9572.description: Though still feared by those traveling to and from Amenos, the ornaug packs native to local waters can serve as loyal steeds if tamed and trained. Or so say the prisoners dreaming of freedom on that prison isle.
9572.name: Amenos Ornaug

9573.description: As swift as the waves at high tide, this steed's gallop is unmatched. With its glowing mane and shining tail, night riding on this Surfglow Courser is the most sublime experiences known to equestrians.
9573.name: Surfglow Courser

9574.description: "Like Spriggans roam the glades on land, so does this creature prowl around the tidepools. Its gnarled wooden bones sprout with aquatic life. If it sees me, I'm sure it'll tear my throat out."âScrap from the lost journal of Teldh
9574.name: Cat O' War Senche Lion

9575.description: "Do these coral spiders simply mimic Dwarven spiders or did coral grow over a discarded animunculus? I haven't pried one open to find outâthey really don't like that, so don't even try."âWheezing Wilren
9575.name: Coral Crawler Dwarven Spider

9576.description: Ride in style with a close friend or partner on this sturdy Skyrim-bred draft horse! With its pillion saddle crafted from genuine horker leather, this horse possesses strength to take two riders without breaking a sweat.
9576.name: Grand Pillion Draft Horse

9577.description: The cat's eyes seem to speak, saying, "Jolly good to see you! We appear to have a small blight of rodents. Dreadful crawling things. Scuttling everywhere. Hmm, skittering blights. I knew a good joke about that. What? Oh, yes. Lovely day for a hunt!"
9577.name: Catwell

9578.description: "The mythic texts of discredited scholars are right, the Great Dark Ram lives! Hircine appears in this form only during Rain's Hand in the Great Forest. Soon, there will be the trials of virility. I hope my strength endures."âLost Journal of Bekelva
9578.name: Great Dark Ram

9631.description: Trophy taken from Prior Thierric Sarazen in honor of an Undaunted victory in Red Petal Bastion.
9631.name: Trophy: Prior Thierric Sarazen
9631.hint: Awarded for completing Red Petal Bastion.

9632.description: Trophy taken from the Magma Incarnate in honor of an Undaunted victory in the Dread Cellar.
9632.name: Trophy: Magma Incarnate
9632.hint: Awarded for completing The Dread Cellar.

9633.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Red Petal Bastion.
9633.name: Bust: Prior Thierric Sarazen
9633.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Red Petal Bastion.

9634.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in the Dread Cellar.
9634.name: Bust: Magma Incarnate
9634.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran The Dread Cellar.

9635.description: Alchemists in Cey-Tarn Keep fashion mount armor out of specially treated Culanda stones. No alchemist will say exactly what properties the resulting meadowglass has, but scouts riding meadowglass armored wolves have yet to be captured.
9635.name: Meadowglass Wolf

9636.description: Tainted by proximity to active harrowstorms, these bears have become hexed abominationsâperfect for warriors with cold blood and dark intentions.
9636.name: Harrowstorm Bear

9637.description: Happiest when climbing their native Valus Mountains, these sure-footed mounts grudgingly accept both saddle and reins for as long as their rider allows them to keep movingâor provides them with prodigious amounts of mountain flower treats.
9637.name: Clawhorn Mountain Goat

9639.description: No one knows how these beasts found their way into Blackreach, but it didn't take long for them to heed the Dark Heart's call. Drenched in the void's corruption, this mount will chill your enemies to the bone.
9639.name: Voideater Durzog

9640.description: These small Daedric worms may follow visitors around the Deadlands or Apocrypha to appease their curiosity. Some continue to tag along after their chosen mortal on Nirn!
9640.name: Skitteris

9643.description: Bred for their lithe frame and large eyes, these senches excel at tracking prey through the dark underbrush of Balfiera. The Direnni Hegemony fell, but their senches prowl on, hunting during the night and sharpening their claws during the day.
9643.name: Balfiera Senche Cub

9645.description: Cey-Tarn Keep dog-handlers made armor training wolf pups a priority after older members of the pack gnawed their plate-harnesses to pieces. The practice lives on in this pup who proudly displays his Elven panoply as he trots beside his owner.
9645.name: Meadowglass Wolf Pup

9674.description: "I thought my salvation was at hand. That someone came for me here in this abyss. I was wrong, it was unnaturalâa saddle with no horse beneath it. A form but no soul. Death itself would've been more kind."âTorn page in the cell of Vignac Ence
9674.name: Soulrazer Steed

9675.description: The soulrazer wolves protected the crypt of House Penot near Breakwater cave. Now that the crypt is in ruins, they wander the shoreline during stormy nights, letting the wind howl mournfully as it passes beneath their cuirasses.
9675.name: Soulrazer Wolf

9676.description: Plates of armor hover around the nonexistent fur of a blue senche. It makes no noiseâdoes not growl or roar with the thrill of the chase. It creeps across the ground slowly, knowing that no prey can escape once the hunt has begun.
9676.name: Soulrazer Senche

9677.description: "We know that a crazed necromancer forged these creatures with his dying breath. They are unrelenting, and never stop even when the Ritemaster commands them. Inexplicably, some of the bears sit calmly at the feet of the apprentices."âYrssin, Psijic Order
9677.name: Soulrazer Bear

9678.description: The crypts of High Isle are littered with walking suits of armor. Those who survive say that the armor protects treasures of old. But I suspect they haunt the black hallways, waiting for the dead to wake."âGrod, Castle Navire Crypt Keeper
9678.name: Soulrazer Guar

9680.description: "Horses may be speedy enough for open roads, but they can't board a ship in the dead of night or delight the crew when there's nary a breeze to fill the sails. And no horse ever ripped out the throat of the night watch."âKylian, Bosun of the Red Sky
9680.name: Dreadsail Howler

9681.description: The distinctive blue colors of the Iliac Bay Crab make it both a sought-after adventuring friend for those who adore crabs as companions and a target for fisherfolk seeking the shellfish's tender meat. Are you the former, the latter, or maybe both?
9681.name: Iliac Bay Crab

9683.description: "A whole bear? You grew a whole bear? Well? What are you doing with it still? Get out there! Burn a fort to the ground! Make it hit some rocks with its paws! Bask in bear-y devastation!"âGlooredel, Vinedusk Ranger
9683.name: Wealdspirit Bear

9684.description: "In my defense, those heroes just left pieces of that Dark Anchor lying there. All of that auxiliary magic? What if some evil cult got it? Oh, and I wanted to make a Senche â¦ but one of the runes got smudged."âInterview with Frugal Jedd, Mage
9684.name: Wailing Shackler Wolf

9685.description: "Meridia's charger manifests wherever vile darkness gathers. In 298 1E, it blazed out of the sunrise and into Cath Bedraud where the righteous flames of the Sunfire reduced a nest of bloodfiends to ashes."âTerendra Vocula, Priest of Inner Luminance
9685.name: Luminous Meridian Charger

9743.description:
This factotum exists to serve as your personal bankerâexcept in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, where it shuts down and vanishes to hyperogonal points unknown.

After it's summoned, you and your groupmates can use its services.
9743.name: Factotum Property Steward

9744.description:
Need to sell a few things? Do so with this shiny factotumâexcept in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, which initiate its retreat protocols.

After it's summoned, you and your groupmates can use its services.
9744.name: Factotum Commerce Delegate

9745.description: You and your groupmates can prepare for combat by summoning Ghrasharog to change and save builds outside of your home. He avoids Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, which he swears made him complacent after winning victory upon victory.
9745.name: Ghrasharog, Armory Assistant

9775.description: Taken from the nest almost as soon as it breaks through its shell, this quasigriff is pampered and preened as befits a creature sacred to Auriel. Its golden feathers are used as fletching by archers in Balfiera.
9775.name: Aurielic Quasigriff

9784.description: "Ride one of these piebalds for any travel outside Sentinel. They love the heat more than any senche-serval I've stabled. Makes me believe the tales of Summerset outcasts raising them out in one of the bandit caves nearby decades ago."âBurhan, Stablehand
9784.name: Piebald Senche-Serval

9785.description: Argonian farmers sell Fellrunner feathers to hunters by the sack. Even one armband of pale Fellrunner down allows hunters to slink through the swamps of Murkwood unnoticed.
9785.name: Nightcrest Fellrunner

9786.description: "Why. Can't. They. Keep. Quiet? Arkay blesses them with their own cycle, but every few years they claw their way back into Greenshade. And what do they do once they get here? Scream. Constantly."âHasinel, Lament of the Midyear Screech
9786.name: Screaming Midyear Nixad

9791.description: Brigands in Wayrest tried to use these creatures to help them harass nobles of that town, but after that plan backfired on them, they sold their stock. Lucky for you, these fiery salamanders receive loyalty training before being sold now.
9791.name: Appleback Salamander

9794.description: Legend tells of a Breton hunter who freed a Flint-Pelt Fox from a hagraven's snare. Now these creatures seek out any warrior who calls hagravens "foe," often lingering around areas terrorized by their hated enemies.
9794.name: Flint-Pelt Fox

9795.description: Hay-Crown Chub Loons were revered as omens of good harvests until one winter in Rivenspire, when desperate farmers discovered that these creatures were delectable. Druids took the dim-witted, delicious birds with them when they fled to High Isle.
9795.name: Hay-Crown Chub Loon

9797.description: Native to the Systres Islands, these haj mota prefer coastal areas, where they spend so much time submerged that coral forms on them. So, if you love to spend quality time at the beach, this fierce predator might just make for a great beach buddy!
9797.name: Coral Haj Mota
9797.hint: Obtained by using 25 Coral Haj Mota Lures from Ghost Haven Bay in High Isle, and 25 Coral Haj Mota Decoys from the Spire of the Crimson Coin.

9805.description: The people of Falkreath call these lynxes "blizzard bringers." The cats are as powerful as the buffeting winds that scour the slopes of the Shriekwind Bastion. There are even rumors that the lynx's growl causes avalanches high up in the mountains.
9805.name: Falkreath Riding-Lynx

9819.description: Kneel before the mighty Arox and he might just offer to crush your enemies for you! But, as a daedrat. Not his former much bigger self. After adding Arox to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
9819.name: Arox the Mutilator

9820.description: Fresh from Madam Whim's in Fargrave, this irrepressible Skaafin immediately imparts a surprisingly upbeat atmosphere to your abode. After adding Hezehk to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
9820.name: Hezehk

9821.description: With her initial Daedric studies finished, Marafar hopes to uncover more secrets as she assists Artaeum's Relicmaster. Will you host her efforts? After adding Marafar to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
9821.name: Relic-Apprentice Marafar

9829.description: Soul Shriven knights ride only the most finely stitched steeds. As one old knight proclaimed, "Don't mind the bit of fray at the bottom there. Or the pesky splinters sticking out of the handle. This guar is a jolly smooth ride!"
9829.name: Stitchedwell Stick Guar
9829.hint: |cff0000This mount doesn't increase your movement speed. Riding Lessons don't affect its appearance. This mount cannot path when placed as a furnishing.|r

9837.description: "Boredom. Boredom and that accursed holiday in Stonefalls. That's why I used my considerable skills to merge a salamander and a guar. Hmm. The colors are striking. It was just a whim, but I'm pleased with the results."âIrastimil Direnni, Creature Creator
9837.name: Salamandrine Guar

9874.description: "Legends claim the Erabenimsun tamed these luminous creatures after Ashu-Ammu rode the first nix-ox into battle. While it's strange to choose a steed whose glow gives away your position, some warriors delight in added danger before battle."âMurdyn Athren
9874.name: Rubyflare Torchnix
9874.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

9875.description: "At first, Baezati was angry. They give him a camel? Baezati rides nothing less than a charger. But this one must confess he enjoyed the ride. It was smooth. Fast. Surefooted. Even the rocks around Hel Ra gave the beast no issues."âBaezati's Travelogues
9875.name: Hel Ra Camel of Kingship

9876.description: "Graniteclaw Durzogs gorge themselves on the array of sea life swimming around the Systres Archipelago. Their markings help them blend in with the reefs and their feathers keep water from dripping into their eyes."âExcerpt from Physiology of Amphibians
9876.name: Graniteclaw Durzog

9977.description: Feeling festive? Let this little firepot spider follow you around! With its adorable alchemical light show, you're bound to brighten up anyone's dayâincluding your own!
9977.name: Aurora Firepot Spider

9978.description: "To my chagrin, thieves stole my current batch of pony guars! I'd hoped to gift some to my cousin, who adored my salamandrine guar and whose love of pony guars knows no bounds. Those thieves had better watch out."âIrastimil Direnni, Creature Creator
9978.name: Salamandrine Pony Guar

9979.description: After spending years expelling dro-m'Athra from Nirn, M'aar decided to follow a new path. Now they hope to explore as much of the Mundus as possible before venturing to the Gates of the Crossing.
9979.name: Midnight Cantor Senche-Raht

9980.description: While they often disagree on theology, the Orsinium Orcs are unified by their love of this echatere's coat. Some call it a blessing from Trinimac. Others call it an outcast's brand from Malacath. Either way, this beast is a bundle of skittering joy.
9980.name: Tortoiseshell Echatere

9981.description: Driven to madness by the erratic magic around the Spellscar, these kagouti make surprisingly excellent pets. In comparison to their lucid and more aggressive kin, an insane kagouti is docile and picks up commands with ease.
9981.name: Spellscar Kagouti

9982.description: "Some believe these skeletal senche respond to the call of a lost soul seeking safe passage. I firmly believe Y'ffre's hand is involved, and I pray I can prove it one day."âDruid Phillic
9982.name: Wraithtide Senche

9983.description: "The day a Stonelore druid thundered in on this frightful sea-birthed horse, well â¦ let's just say I'm glad I recognized Druid Dolvasie on top. Her ferocious expression will haunt my nightmaresâas will this steed."âSquire Hareld, Oaken Order
9983.name: Wraithtide Horse

9984.description: "The ghost of Ol' Brineburr herds glowing guar down trade roads, seeking buyers. Don't be put off by their appearance. Or, hmmm, maybe seeing your steed's skeleton is a bonus to you? Regardless, get one."âInitiate Rogeric
9984.name: Wraithtide Guar

9985.description: "Where mages born from water gather, they enact ancient rites. Together they bind the essence of bear and sea and death, forming it into a mount one of their number may ride. Or so the tales go."âDruid Sandire
9985.name: Wraithtide Bear

9986.description: "Communing with the Evergrowth is sometimes confusing. I saw the waters birth an unusual wolf pack, flowing like the angry waves that gave them life. Experience proves they possess the same loyalty other wolves have toward their riders."âDruid Anotille
9986.name: Wraithtide Wolf

9997.description: "Respect the dovah-fly. They are the spirits of the ancestors given new life. They brighten the quiet tranquility of ponds and streams. What better afterlife is there?"âDruid Henneque Blakeley
9997.name: Glimmergreen Dovah-Fly

9998.description: Shimmering like fire, these dovah-flies dart around port cities, eating many of the nuisance insects that pester transported livestock. Recently, merchants started training and selling them to help others with insect issues.
9998.name: Yoltoor Dovah-Fly

9999.description: You can place this station in multiple homes, where it allows you and your guests to save and equip Armory builds.
9999.name: Armory Station

10055.description: "Tears of rage and hatred don't go wasted in Skyrim. These rare droplets fall upon the snow, calling a spirit of bone and rime from Aetherius. Within seconds, a frost-spiked wolf forms, snarling and bridled with grim purpose."âHef, Tale Collector
10055.name: Ossified Rime Wolf

10056.description: Scales the color of High Isle's sky speckle this beast, making it highly sought after by nobles. When domesticated, the Reefstrider joyfully takes its rider across tidepools and shallows, but avoids the deepsâespecially in northern climes.
10056.name: Reefstrider Ornaug

10057.description: Though some claim these fiery steeds first sprang from the Earth Forge, others make a case for the fires of Morkuldin's Descent taking that honor. None can quench the blaze of this incandescent horse!
10057.name: Forge Master's Charger

10058.description: With plumage as vibrant as the setting sun, these terror birds are often trained to parade around the halls of Rimmen. Nobles delight in the strangeness of their movements and the brilliance of their feathers.
10058.name: Ruby Fledgling Terror Bird

10059.description: Rarely do these inky black death hounds venture beyond Castle Volkiharâmost serve their master's purpose at home better than abroad. The ones wandering after folk are probably some form of spy for the Volkihar vampires.âNalana, Advisor to House Tamrith
10059.name: Volkihar Death Hound

10060.description: Families along the Niben River bred Butcher's dogs to protect their homesteads. The dogs earned their name generations later when the farmers realized they were more likely to watch the ribs and roasts than the front door.
10060.name: Heartland Butcher's Dog

10061.description: "The sight of this welwa's claws sparks something in my imagination, showing me different scenarios where those icy talons end my life. It's beautiful. In a horrible, gruesome way. I wonder if it can be tamed?"âPyn Bossard, Welwa Researcher (Deceased)
10061.name: Azuredoom Wrathsteed

10062.description: Unlike their mainland cousins, the quasigriffs of the Systres Archipelago have vibrant, sea-tinted feathers. Admittedly, Irastimil Direnni never intended to create such colorful creatures. Noble Bretons adore them and travel about High Isle on their backs.
10062.name: Baysong Quasigriff

10065.description: Spring blossoms nod their heads as if recognizing kin in this Elf-pampered companion. Some caretakers claim these gryphons provide a sense of ease to those who care for themâand pain for those who seek their demise.
10065.name: Aurulun Fledgling Gryphon

10181.description: A miniature statue of Saint Kaladas, builder of the Great Chapel of Zenithar in Leyawiin.
10181.name: Statuette: Kaladas of Leyawiin

10182.description: A miniature statue of Mehrunes Dagon, Daedric Prince of Destruction and Ambition.
10182.name: Statuette: Mehrunes Dagon

10183.description: A painting of Mehrunes Dagon, towering over his cultists in the Deadlands.
10183.name: Painting: Dagon's Mercy

10184.description:
Giladil happily trades items you don't need for useful crafting materials! She doesn't ply her trade in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds because those areas aren't lucrative enough.

After she's summoned, you and your groupmates can use her services.
10184.name: Giladil the Ragpicker

10186.description: "Don't let those icy blue eyes fool you. It's their claws you need to keep an eye onâthey can shatter stone, leaving behind nothing but glowing rubble. Thankfully, they're actually quite good-natured creatures once they imprint on you."âDivayth Fyr
10186.name: Stoneglow Imp

10199.description: "I prefer the company of animals over people. Communing with the Evergrowth provides a calming respite from the need to speak. This ursauk, for example, has proven most personable. And now, it needs a rider."âDruid Dolvasie
10199.name: Druid-Bound Ursauk

10201.description: Each of the druid circles keeps a different ursine companion. The Stonelore bear was originally bred to help with ambitious construction projects. While druids shaped heavy stone slabs, their bears supported the more fragile components of the structures.
10201.name: Stonelore Bear

10202.description: "We value elk for their nimble hooves and gentle nature. They accompany us where larger beasts cannot go. They do not shirk in the face of danger or abandon their work. I wish I could say the same about some of the initiates! Hmph!"âDruid Barjot
10202.name: Stonelore Elk

10203.description: Druid stories say that the first foxes swam from Y'ffelon shortly before Mount Firesong spewed ash and flame. Those who befriend a Stonelore fox live long lives, though the Stonelore insist it has nothing to do with the fox's survival instincts.
10203.name: Stonelore Fox

10204.description: "This one adores the guar with its useless small arms and big round head. J'zurdru and the guar bonded over a love of belly rubs. Also napping on warm rocks and watching the clouds in the sky. Lazy but very relaxing, yes?"âDruid J'zurdru
10204.name: Stonelore Guar

10205.description: "It may be a little biased of us, but predators take longer to earn their horns. I suppose we just want proof that they're well-trained before we give them another weapon. Still, little Ivy was so proud when she got hers."âDruid Celina, Beast Master
10205.name: Stonelore Lynx

10206.description: "On the first night of Hearthfire, folks all over the Systres burn blessed oldefire logs. The smoke mingles with the soughing of leaves, giving form to spirits unseen the rest of the year. They take the form of loyal elk steeds."âBook of the Leaves
10206.name: Oldefire Elk

10207.description: "When trees shrug off their colorful mantles, druids gather around a lynx summoned by Y'ffre. While they sing chants, the God of Song and Forest transforms the feline into a steed. Only a Hearthfire champion may claim such a mount."âBook of the Leaves
10207.name: Harvestleaf Lynx

10208.description: "We choose some of our guardians based on their overwhelming presence, like this ursauk. While riding it, I swear that the marrow in my bones resonates with her growls."âRolmanoril of Glimmertarn
10208.name: Glimmertarn Ursauk

10209.description: "Her calm presence keeps our patients at ease. Sometimes I ask them about the patterns and shapes they see in her coat, and their answers give me insight into their state of mind."âMender Teliel
10209.name: Mottled Sheep

10210.description: "Sturdy rams graze the lush meadowlands all around Nibenay Bay. An amusing tale claims they first became steeds because the local herbalist wearied of them eating all the nirnroot. They were trained to saddle and now, here we are."âSadia Vonius, Student
10210.name: Nibenay Bay Ram

10211.description: "Lizard-steeds are a gift from the Hist. They have dependable backs and dry scales. You know, we only realized how entwined our roots were when we trekked back from Mazzatun. These beasts kept us off our aching feet."âSkeexalttul, Su-Zahleel Ambassador
10211.name: Su-Zahleel Horse-Lizard

10212.description: "I found the wamasu that â¦ resisted my care. It bit my hand. It's blue! Well, more of a tealish color. Did the druid's magic affect the creature? Or was it some other factor? I think I'll release more of them!"âValerine Cadiou, Master Beast Tamer
10212.name: Amberdust Wamasu Hatchling

10215.description: Thief though he is, Jakarn promises not to steal from your house if you allow him to stay. But as to your heart? Well, that's a different matter. After adding Jakarn to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
10215.name: Jakarn

10217.description: This Jester's Fest performer brings all the joy and frivolity of that holiday to your homeâperfect for when you wish to host a friendly gathering! After adding Jester Anglidor to your home, you can set him on a path and interact with him.
10217.name: Jester Anglidor

10219.description: A miniature statue of the Divine Stendarr, God of Mercy, Justice, and Charity.
10219.name: Statuette: Steadfast Stendarr

10220.description: A miniature statue of the Yokudan Prince Hew, who is also known as Prince Hubalajad.
10220.name: Statuette: Prince Hew

10221.description: A painting of the Brass Fortress, seat of power for the Clockwork God, Sotha Sil.
10221.name: Painting: The Gates of Brass

10222.description: "Why do people insist on having imps about? And why especially these kind? They twist whatever you tell them to do into something that serves them best, not you. Only those with an extraordinarily firm hand should even bother with them."âDivayth Fyr
10222.name: Frostmoss Imp

10224.description: "The cavy's placid essence makes them nature's mediators, dear. I adopted this one years ago. There's an undeniable sophistication in silver hair, you see. It gives one the impression of wisdom, whether earned or not."âLady Arabelle Davaux
10224.name: Sterling Cavy

10225.description: Originally hailing from Bleakrock Isle, these blue-eyed canines love playing in the frosty air and snow of that distant spit of land. In fact, the locals often bring them inside at night just so that they aren't awoken by their antics in the morning.
10225.name: Bleakrock Snowdog
10225.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

10231.description: "House Mornard won't say where it tamed these gorgeous beasts. My guess is Summerset. For a time, only the elder nobles of that house rode their own. Now, after a downturn in Mornard fortunes, you'll find them all over Tamriel."âSadia Vonius, Student
10231.name: Ashgray Senche-Serval

10237.description: While Nords claim this lightning-limned wolf seeks out Kyne's champions to serve, the Stonelore Druids believe differently. Only an imbalance in nature would cause such a creature to coalesce. Its purpose? To find a rider who can restore the balance.
10237.name: Warmaiden's Wolf

10238.description: It's the prestige of the mastiffs of Morthal that give the city's resident breed of bear-dog license to be a bit more â¦ silly. Whether watching over children or facing intruders, someone's bound to get a licking.
10238.name: Morthal Bear-Dog

10239.description: Before the druids, before the coin-barons, before even the noble houses, the hermit crab held dominion over the Systres. Hauling its belongings wherever it travels, its beady eyes give you a look that seems to say, "We're not so different, you and I."
10239.name: Mulberry Hermit Crab
10239.hint: Awarded by earning the "Lost Depths Explorer" achievement.

10240.description: "Where'd I get the cat? Cards. Poor thing was used in place of coin by some pet-smuggling lowlife. I'm teaching her how to count cards and fetch me a pint."âPrivateer Mahk
10240.name: Rustpelt Sabre Cat

10242.description: Covered in coral and barnacles, this unusual sea creature moves like rushing water, creating a smooth traveling experience for its riders. Some speculate that Kyne crafted them from a sea storm and sent them to land to find those who revere her.
10242.name: Stormsurge Howler
10242.hint: Awarded by earning the "Swashbuckler Supreme" achievement.

10243.description: "Now, I says to my friend, look at all this dark anchor debris. No one's using it. No one owns it. And I look at his pony, this sickly little thing, and I say, why not make ourselves something nice?"â"Innovator" Delan
10243.name: Anchorborn Pony

10244.description: This savage welwa so interested members of the College of Sapiarchs that they brought several to Sil-Var-Woad for study. To help endear them to the public, an enterprising conservator trained them to saddle and "lent" them out into the wild.
10244.name: Speckled Welwa

10250.description: The eye-catching tail pouf of the ringtail jerboa makes for a daring fashion statement especially appreciated by the aristocracy of High Isle. It's also, of course, used for balance.
10250.name: Ringtail Jerboa

10251.description: "See the crab's big tidepool eyes? Delicious. Their big claws that can fell saplings with one snip? The meat inside is as juicy as the fruit about to drop off a tree. Trust me. Keep one of these around in case you need a snack."âXoko, Hee-Tepsleel Chef
10251.name: Hermit Crab

10252.description: "My study of pangrits have provided few clues as to their origin. Their young don't possess the spikes of the adults, and their hide is supple like velvet. I could almost hug one of these smaller versions! Almost."âSadia Vonius, Student
10252.name: Pangrit Nymphling

10253.description: "Some claim the Hadolids created the pangrits somehow. I suspect they simply tamed these spiky beasts. If they'd made them, they'd be smarter. If a pangrit wants something, they poke you. Learn quickly how to tell what they want!"âSaissula, Stablemaster
10253.name: Turquoise War Pangrit

10254.description: Bred by savvy Wayrest stablehands to handle heavy loads, these horses can carry more than one rider. The saddle, crafted by leatherworker Amal, provides both riders with stability while making for an easy ride on the animal.
10254.name: Wayrest Vanner Pillion Steed

10262.description: "A knight's mount is the extension of her body. Four more legs to push her forward. Two longer ears, to warn her of danger. And a large heart to pump courage through her veins."âGwenifyr Dufort, The Meaning of Chivalry
10262.name: Grand Joust Destrier
10262.hint:
|cFFFFFF
Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.|r

10277.description: "Do colors seem louder? Does music taste different? Does Tirdas have a personality? You're probably experiencing the synesthesic venom of the rare lemondot netch. Relax. It's harmless. A little new perspective never killed anybody."âAlinon the Alchemist
10277.name: Lemondot Netch

10290.description: "Do not underestimate the foxes trained by the Cult of the New Moon. Their glowing crimson eyes should be enough to warn you away. If you are foolish enough to attempt to steal an adult, say farewell to Nirn."âJonnet of the Sunwalkers
10290.name: New Moon Fox

10300.description: Trophy taken from Varallion in honor of an Undaunted victory in Coral Aerie.
10300.name: Trophy: Kargaeda

10301.description: Trophy taken from the Maormer Pirate in honor of an Undaunted victory in Shipwright's Regret
10301.name: Trophy: Nazaray

10302.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Coral Aerie.
10302.name: Bust: Kargaeda
10302.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Coral Aerie.

10303.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Shipwright's Regret.
10303.name: Bust: Nazaray
10303.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Shipwright's Regret.

10306.description: When merchants don't arrive through the passes of the Jerall Mountains as expected, groups of searchers head out with these well-trained dogs to find them. More than a few winter caravans have these friendly dogs to thank for their lives.
10306.name: Jerall Rescue Dog
10306.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "Challenges of the Past" in High Isle.

10311.description: Years ago, vermin overran Kvatch during a poor harvest year. To combat this threat to their low winter food supplies, the citizens brought in spotted lynx cubs from breeders. These creatures love freshly hunted vermin, warm hearths, and crusty bread.
10311.name: Highland Spotted Lynx Cub

10312.description: This spotted lynx was an uncommon sight in the Colovian hills until an enterprising hunter brought back some young to raise. Decades later, these lithe creatures serve well as mounts to those who prefer felines.
10312.name: Highland Spotted Lynx
10312.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

10313.description: "Clearing wasps from the Betnikh docks falls to our youngest warrior. One such asked a mage to help her befriend the wasps, and she led them away. All but one settled elsewhere, instead choosing to follow her loyally. I see you have one now."âStulga
10313.name: Dockside Paper Wasp

10316.description: As the weather chills and leaves take on fiery hues, the spirit of this young indrik begins to stir. When a paladin of Jephre performs an act the God of Song and Forest finds worthy, it takes its shaky steps into the world.
10316.name: Autumnal Indrik

10317.description: "We found daedrats eating our ceremonial supplies in the cellar last Midyear. Now the damned things have gone green, and the Archdruid says they're a bridge from Galen to Oblivion? Draigh!"âCallice Marence, formerly of Daggerfall
10317.name: Moss Spine Daedrat

10318.description: Tales tell of a mercenary abandoned by her lord during a storm. Her frozen lips begged for help. Sanguine heard her pleas, forming the ice into a steed. Come Saturalia morn, the crimson blood of that lord drenched the snow and evergreen boughs.
10318.name: Saturalia Ice Steed

10319.description: Bretons have a strange practice of letting piebald cats loose in the secret passages of their manor homes. It stems from an ancient, noisy infestation of Sheogorath's never-there beetles. It took years, but the clever felines eventually killed them all.
10319.name: Piebald Cat

10320.description: The Dragonstar Caravan Company first found these brilliant moths while traveling from Evermore. Though attracted to the campfires, they didn't burn themselves. Instead, they settled on the caravan's goods, then followed them as if guarding them.
10320.name: Orchid Whisper Moth

10321.description: Once bred for their ability to smell when a grape is perfectly ripe, the Sweetgrape Dragon Frog is now considered an invasive pest. Winemakers go to great lengths to keep the grape-loving frog away from their vineyards.
10321.name: Sweetgrape Dragon Frog

10324.description: The naivety of the chub loons endears them to druids, whose mission is to protect nature. When the Eldertide landed on Galen and found a new species, they took it as a blessing from Y'ffre and built their villages where the loons make their nests.
10324.name: Fellbraun Chub Loon

10325.description: "In retrospect, attempting to add nirnroot to molten silver by using magic was a terrible idea. Now my guarlings and I are covered in silver, blue, and black streaks. Nothing I do will change us back. At least it's attractive!"âMy Experiments, Vol. 5
10325.name: Silver-Bellied Guarling

10326.description: Wisps are sent from Y'ffre to herald the storms of Rain's Hand. To see one is to see the promise of new growth, new life, and a new chapter in nature's cycle.
10326.name: Galen Wisp

10328.description: "Studies into ragebound breeds trace their lineage to Hircine and the Reach. Legend says the Lord of the Hunt gifted the first Ragebound Horse to a tribe after witnessing them chase down a vampire. On foot. In the dark."âBeastmaster's Practical Bestiary
10328.name: Ragebound Steed

10329.description: "When you're at your worstâwhen the only thing keeping you going is pure rage? That is the moment you know its strength. These cats will happily teach you this lesson, if you need a tutor."âArparnagh of Markarth
10329.name: Ragebound Sabre Cat

10330.description: "Each pelt and bone on this monster of a bear reminds its rider of past battles. Rage turned to an end. Victory ripped from the rider's enemies. You know the feeling, I think. It's in your eyes. Rage. Barely controlled."âArparnagh of Markarth
10330.name: Ragebound Bear

10331.description: "You're not hearing me. These were nothing like normal kagouti. Fury, froth, and carnage. And their riders, eyes wide with harnessed rage. That's what drew me in. That's why I joined them."âMedresi Guvron of Markarth
10331.name: Ragebound Kagouti

10332.description: "This beast lives a life of controlled fury that only its rider keeps in check. Unfortunately for us, these durzogs usually pick riders who let loose their own wrath with great frequency."âMedresi Guvron of Markarth
10332.name: Ragebound Durzog

10348.description: The Ash'abah revere Fennec Foxes for leading lost children back to the tribe. Scholars say that it is more likely the foxes are seeking out the nearest watering hole, which is usually where the tribes are anyway.
10348.name: Bergama Fennec Fox

10349.description: Trails through the thick marshlands outside Gideon change with every passing storm. Hunters in the city bred these dogs to be light enough not to get stuck in the muck and trained their noses to detect new paths of sure footing.
10349.name: Gideon Trail Dog

10382.description: Bards in Skyrim claim these luminous sabre cats gain their glow from Kyne. Scholars in the College of Sapiarchs refute this, each with their own pet hypotheses. Everyone agrees that this growler's fur is silky soft and its rumbling purr soothing.
10382.name: Vale Sabre Cat Growler

10384.description: "The first pillion mount in Skingrad came about when two of Rislav's siblings wished to ride with fewer guards about. 'Two guards per horse,' they were told. Thus they created the first battle-hardened pillion mount."âRichon Charchere, Stablemaster
10384.name: Skingrad Pillion Courser

10386.description: "Though these fellows work the tilt-yard like a dream, they're trained to the field, too. You never know when you'll need a finely barded steed to get you across those fancy sunflower fields you see around High Isle."âPerien Jerrick, Castle Navire
10386.name: Jouster's Charger

10387.description: Telvanni magisters use only the hardiest of the fire-hued fungi when magically coercing it into a new form. Whether one such magister crafted these pleasantly companionable spore ponies causes snippy disagreements among mages and scholars alike.
10387.name: Sadrith Mora Spore Pony

10388.description: Softly spoken words cut apart those who claim a mere Telvanni mage crafted this spore steed. The correctionâan archmagister brought this russet and amber glory into beingâgently flays the soul of the ignorant s'wit. As it should.
10388.name: Sadrith Mora Spore Steed

10389.description: "You'd not think to see camels around this one's home of Black Heights, but you'd be wrong! We love to brighten these fragrant beasts with pigments and a touch of sleekening oil so that they provide both beauty and transport!"âHurzarr, Artist
10389.name: Black Heights Camel

10396.description: Easily identifiable by their flaming red feathers, this aggressive barnyard fowl has been used as an alternative to a guard dog by knights on crusade. Their loud crowing is nearly impossible to sleep through.
10396.name: Crusader's Coin Chicken

10397.description: "What have you learned, Watcher? Mortals on Nirn keep small companions. Oh, is that so? Names you say? As my small companion, you wish one? Very well, I shall call you Ocula. You have indeed earned it."âMorian Zenas
10397.name: Cipher's Eye Pocket Watcher

10398.description: "These hard-headed creatures might seem empty-minded. Yet, somehow, they keep you alive when you've angered the ornaugs. Such is the nature of a loyal mount."âSaissula, Stablemaster
10398.name: Scarlet War Pangrit

10399.description: The ancestry of this rambunctious dark-furred pup goes all the way back to the Five Hundred Companions of Ysgramor. That doesn't stop it from acting like a mischievous little furball, though!
10399.name: Companion's Wolf Pup

10408.description: The Nord diplomat Rigurt travels around Tamriel to learn about other cultures while demonstrating his own brand of Nord culture. Welcome him home! After adding Rigurt to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
10408.name: Rigurt the Brash

10409.description: Mysterious and kind, Druid Ryvana welcomes the chance to teach others about the wisdom of the Stonelore Druids. What teachings has she for you? After adding Ryvana to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
10409.name: Druid Ryvana

10410.description: Brahgas loves playing Tales of Tribute but needs a break to shake off some bad luck. Perhaps a fellow player like you can put him up for a bit? After adding Brahgas to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
10410.name: Brahgas
10410.hint: Acquired by completing the "Tales of Tribute Master" achievement.

10414.description: "A reminder to all researchers that a close eye must be kept on the Mnemoflare Fabricant. It has a frustrating knack for picking locks and its sharp claws have made short work of Attendant Mhunvack's herb garden."âBthuchard, Dwemer Researcher
10414.name: Mnemoflare Fabricant

10418.description: "Harrowforged Durzog: Ready your quickest poisons and most potent spells. Your target defeated horrors possibly beyond your ken to earn this glorious crimson steed."âRecent notation in a chapbook for Dark Brotherhood Initiates
10418.name: Harrowforged Durzog

10419.description: "Come closer, Namira's chosen. Take a good look at this spectacular welwa. The Spirit Queen wishes to reward you with it. Of course, journeys with this steed will lead you into further efforts for your queen. Small price to pay, yes?"âVoidmother Della
10419.name: Voidmother's Welwa

10427.description: Lady Joslin Garick brought her crew home safely until the last timeâor so the legends state. Now that you have proven worthy of her heritage, you can hang this famous All Flags Navy captain's shield on your wall.
10427.name: Lady Garick's Sacred Shield
10427.hint: Awarded for completing the quest, "Race for Honor" in High Isle.

10429.description: "You wouldn't think a guar would get along with a murder of crows, but this fine fellow does! Maybe it's the exquisite purple hue? In any case, it's started leaving gemstones for the little menaces. Most peculiar."âIrastimil Direnni, Creature Creator
10429.name: Crow Court Pony Guar

10434.description: Curled up in the corner, perfecting a new spell â¦ just how much trouble could Ember get into? Why not find out? After adding Ember to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
10434.name: Ember
10434.hint: Obtained by completing quest "Green with Envy."

10435.description: Isobel Veloise is equally happy hunting Daedra in a dank cave and kicking back in front of a roaring fire. An upbeat addition to any home! After adding Isobel to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
10435.name: Isobel Veloise
10435.hint: Obtained by completing quest "The Princess Detective".

10438.description: Cavalry masters of the Oaken Order diligently trained mountain goats to the bridle. Now, these surefooted creatures are both mounts and companions. None can match their spirit or persistence, or so the wizardly knights boast.
10438.name: Oaken Order Mountain Goat

10440.description: A painting featuring Gonfalon Bay nestled among its protective waters and cliffs, with a mysterious knight overlooking it all.
10440.name: Painting: All Flags on High

10509.description:
Set up your home's gaming room properly with this exquisite Tales of Tribute table.

|cFFFFFFThis table does not allow you to play Tales of Tribute matches.|r
10509.name: Tales of Tribute Table, Display
10509.hint: Acquired by reaching Master Rank in Tales of Tribute.

10510.description: A perfect display case for your perfect decks! What more can you ask for other than victory?
10510.name: Tales of Tribute Decks, Display
10510.hint: Acquired by completing the Deck Builder Achievement.

10576.description: Scrolls from Direfrost Keep indicate that the ice witches first invoked these creatures as vessels to contain their rage and hunt those who had wronged them. Presumably they wanted loyal familiars, but found the bears also make formidable mounts.
10576.name: Icerage Bear

10577.description: Trophy taken from Tideborn Taleria in honor of an Undaunted victory in Dreadsail Reef.
10577.name: Trophy: Tideborn Taleria

10578.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Dreadsail Reef.
10578.name: Bust: Tideborn Taleria
10578.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Dreadsail Reef.

10579.description: The shimmering blues and purples of this ornaug mimic the coral shallows around Galen. If you stumble upon these playful creatures cavorting in the water, move slowly and you may just tickle their curiosity. If they like you, one might even adopt you.
10579.name: Shallowstalker Ornaug

10582.description: Hunters often rely on the services of a loyal dog to protect them as they retrieve their kills. This breed not only ensures that their hunter remains well-guarded, but also provides quiet companionship.
10582.name: Biscuit Bear-Dog

10586.description: In some towns, pledging oaths before Mother Mara is accompanied by a lavish gift. Legends describe a steed exchanged at Bravil, white as fresh snow and adorned with spring's first flowers. And thus a tradition was born that has survived until today.
10586.name: Mara's Pledge Mare

10587.description: You may place the hourglass within your home. Focusing on its falling sands causes them to blur, and local perception of time to shift. Until the hourglass is disturbed, time seems to stand still. Enjoy everything from eternal sunrises to endless nights.
10587.name: Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh

10599.description: When this beautiful beast lost their rider while traversing a labyrinth, this banded Senche-raht left to seek mystical help to get back inside. Since their efforts often lead them into peril, Nushaben hopes to find a partner for the long journeys ahead.
10599.name: Umbral Striped Senche-Raht

10600.description: Using knowledge gained from the forbidden book Occaecium Beluaria, followers of Hermaeus Mora transformed a welwa into a multi-hued, darkly shimmering steed. He allows his most experienced agents in Tamriel to use them for overland tasks.
10600.name: Duskfall Welwa

10603.description: "Don't mind my new friend. She's very gentle as long as nobody gets handsy. I love her emerald scales, too, don't you? A little bit of joy on days when I bring her to help me with customers."âMilesa Relavel
10603.name: Balmora Constrictor

10604.description: "To fear change wastes time one could spend engaging with the moment. These dark creatures are gifts from our past to both voh-vastei and those who need to be led into the present."âNisswo Uaxal
10604.name: Duskfall Ancestor Lizard

10605.description: These adventurous cubs love playing in waterfalls, often using crevices behind them as lairs during the winter. The smell of butter draws them like nothing else. As a result, some claim a dairy farmer first tamed one of these cubs.
10605.name: Brindle Bear Cub

10606.description: "Angry squirrels ruined this one's wares last season, but also called forth this little savior. A hunter of rodents, moths, and other pests. Azartah takes saving when offered."âAzartah of Cropsford
10606.name: Heartland Coon Cat

10609.description: "This wondrous gift from the keepers of the Royal Menagerie tickles me so much. I hope this adorable breed finds warm hearths and caring hearts wherever they land."âQueen Ayrenn
10609.name: Ayrenn's Fledgling Gryphon

10615.description: Before climbing atop these richly hued camels, those who revere Ruptga kneel within the mount's shadow and pray for safe passage. Some focus on the immediate journey while others renew their wish for guidance to the Far Shores after death.
10615.name: Indigo Twilight Camel

10616.description: Yahareni sought to survive by any means necessary when the Knahaten Flu struck Orcrest. Death won, and Namiira gained their corrupted soul. Now, freed from the Dark Behind the World by a foolish mortal, they seek an equal to walk beside them in darkness.
10616.name: Ahz-m'Athra

10617.description:
Aderene is willing to trade items you don't need for useful materials. Some obscure Daedric contracts prohibit her from trading in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds.

After she's summoned, you and your groupmates can use her services.
10617.name: Aderene, Fargrave Dregs Dealer

10618.description: You and your groupmates can prepare for combat by summoning Zuqoth to change and save builds outside of your home. Some obscure Daedric contracts prohibit her from offering her services in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds.
10618.name: Zuqoth, Armory Advisor

10619.description: "Someone made this. I reached out to Apocrypha, to a place of pure thought and potential. And when I withdrew, this hideous unblinking monstrosity stepped from the shadows. It will not leave. It will not stray. Why? WHY?"âFinal notes of Iratian Cipius
10619.name: Hermitage Servitor

10620.description: Records indicate Tel Aruhn merchants bred the tawny lambent guar with the freckled guar. Scholars dispute this, saying instead that the Imperial Legion accidentally created them when they administered the area. Either way, they're crafty little snugglers.
10620.name: Tel Aruhn Guarling

10621.description: "The Unfeathered sought victory over the Sunnatren. 'Their banners portray crude elks. Let them tremble as we defeat them on such beasts.' A season ended before I finished my work. May they forever remain loyal to him."âGandravanya's Journal, Translated
10621.name: Umaril's Radiance Elk

10622.description: "The marshfolk vexed the Unfeathered. 'They scatter to fight. But they fear so-named guar. Let us use that.' It took longer to acquire the needed guar than to ready them. May they forever hunt Umaril's foes."âGandranya's Journal, Translated
10622.name: Umaril's Radiance Guar

10623.description: "Nomads of the sands traded with the Unfeathered's foes. 'Let us disrupt them with mounts both fleet and quiet.' The desert cats I worked with adapted quickly. May they forever slip through the silence for him."âGandravanya's Journal, Translated
10623.name: Umaril's Radiance Senche

10624.description: "Umaril sought to direct the paths of the conquered. 'The creature must take initiative and stay the course.' Balancing these traits with loyalty took many seasons. May they forever direct the Unfeathered's flocks."âGandravanya's Journal, Translated
10624.name: Umaril's Radiance Wolf

10626.description: Wood Elf tribes introduced these prairie dogs across the northern Valenwood to help maintain the overall health of the forest. Some even kept a few around their homes. Now you'll see them scurrying after man and mer alike, cute little noses twitching away.
10626.name: South Weald Prairie Dog

10627.description: "Look at that tongue! You can thank Spellwright Domavas for these bug-eating beauties, expanding on Magister Varkenel's work. I hear he first tried to give them feathers, failed, then came up with this gorgeous steed."âCidius Sosia, Necrom Stablemaster
10627.name: Hivethief Vvardvark

10628.description: "We don't get many durzogs from Gnisis, but when we do, we stable them away from kwama. You see, House Redoran bred them to help herd kwama in the mines. They found out the hard way that the beasts love eating scribs."âCidius Sosia, Necrom Stablemaster
10628.name: Gnisis Durzog

10632.description: "Each morning during my travels around Grahtwood, one of the local fishers clung to the trunk of a nearby tree. I think it wanted some of my breakfast, so on the third day, I shared. Now it follows me everywhere."âNurome
10632.name: Grahtwood Fisher

10633.description: "Tales say Grahtwood's ancient oaks called these black-furred ursauks from the deep woods. But why? Every reason this one hears is different! Guards for a sapling grove. Help with a werewolf problem. Or maybe for bear hugs."âZhiraz, Traveling Farmhand
10633.name: Inkfur Ursauk

10644.description: These brown-furred bats pollinate flowers along the Xylo River. Without them, nature's web in the Valenwood would be deeply disrupted. Plus they look adorable when they sneeze.
10644.name: Xylo Pollen Bat

10645.description: A rare sight, these colorful foxes keep to the shadows in the wild. When trained to the saddle, they proudly display their glossy coats and fine saddlery. Their favorite food is snow berries, and they will do almost anything for their daily treat.
10645.name: Duskember Fox

10646.description: Zuugarz of Orsinium says she first discovered these obsidian-worked animunculi, a claim backed up by the loyal construct that follows her around. She's since learned her scholarly companion "gifted" it to her, but that's not something she's eager to share.
10646.name: Obsidian Dwarven Sphere
10646.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Keeper of the Bastion."

10653.description: Deep in the Karth River canyon, this golden sabre cat jumps from rock to rock on sparkling spring mornings. Knowing this, young Reach witches often camp nearby to set up their taming rituals, hoping to gain one as a loyal mount.
10653.name: Karth River Sabre Cat

10654.description: Get ready for a visit from Clan Mother Tadali! She'll share her wisdom with you if you share your sunbeams with her. After adding Tadali to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
10654.name: Clan Mother Tadali

10655.description: Grab your favorite beverage and settle in for pithy tales from former pirate, current Mages Guild member, and Stonelore druid friend Dhulef. After adding Dhulef to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
10655.name: Dhulef

10656.description: Ghostly Isara may think she's still part of the All Flags Navy, fighting their ancient foes, but that just makes her a hauntingly novel guest. After adding Isara to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
10656.name: Captain Isara Davaux

10664.description: Inspired by the knights of Castle Navire, a band of Fauns decided to breed elks as their mounts. They stopped when they realized their hooves made it difficult to ride and, in truth, they could run just as fast as the elks could.
10664.name: Faunfrolic Great Elk
10664.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

10668.description: "Yes, Gemmy here glows. The Hlaalu of Balmora fed the first of its kind a rare mushroom, causing a reaction in its belly. The glow passed to its young. They're fast but feisty. Don't say I didn't warn you."âCidius Sosia, Necrom Stablemaster
10668.name: Berylglow Nix-Ox Steed
10668.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Savior of Necrom."

10697.description: Allow the passion of Dibella to lead you in a dance of her choosing and, in return, she may gift you with boon of one of her lively blooms. These frolicsome flowers flourish in the presence of energetic adherents like you.
10697.name: Passion Dancer Blossom

10701.description: Originally bred by Kvatch for speed, these pale horses became the favored mounts of outriders during the rivalry with Skingrad in the First Era. Since then, though their numbers vary from few to many, they've continued to serve with honor and distinction.
10701.name: Kvatch Outrider's Warhorse

10703.description: Gallivant across any terrain, seeking your next treasure, with this massive, gilded ursauk. Not only does it bear the blessing of Sai, or so its breeders claim, but its gear contains one element from another successful treasure-seeker's hoard.
10703.name: Hoardhunter Ursauk

10704.description: "Nightmares of scorpions. So many colors, but the dream-sea blue one tipped with angry-eyes red stepped forth. I woke to see this wondrous creature. A gift from Vaermina? My partner says they live in Satakalaam, but how did one get to Wayrest?"âGaelle
10704.name: Chromatic Scorpion

10708.description: Smuggler crews in Hew's Bane first trained these palfreys to bear two riders. Originally, the training was just a cover story to hide their illicit work. But they quickly found having a mount that could hold two extremely useful for heists.
10708.name: Hew's Bane Pillion Palfrey

10709.description: After forcing sabre cats to drink the Blood of Coldharbour, Legion Zero soldiers mounted up and secured the Imperial City Nobles District for Mannimarco. Many of these soldiers died, leaving their steeds without riders. Perfectâfor you, anyway.
10709.name: Legion Zero Sabre Cat

10717.description: "The mix of hues in this Auroran wolf reminds me of the Colored Rooms. The beauty pains me, piercing my heart like a dagger. And if you stare too hard, you get lost in the eternity of its radiance. So, don't stare too hard."âYaduur, Scholar
10717.name: Auroran Polychrome Wolf

10755.description: "None can quench the life-fire blazing in this kagouti's heart. Night and day, we sing and dance amid magma rivers, fanning the spark of creation. If we're blessed, the magic takes and one of our number gains a devoted steed for life."âMy Life Amid Flame
10755.name: Cinderstone Kagouti

10757.description: "Don't be fooled by lesser steeds. These horses seem to ride Khenarthi's winds when treated with respect. Act as if the God of Winds gifted you with this noble creature herself, as this one does, yes?"âHuzdargo, Senchal Stablemaster
10757.name: Khenarthi's Windwalker

10758.description: "Of course I used pigment from local moths when painting Duke Blaise Guimard's portrait. Several of my artist friends keep sanctuaries for these colorful creatures. Perhaps my own little Springrain will help start mine."âLady Alyna Talemelier's Journal
10758.name: Evermore Painter's Moth

10759.description: Rumors that Systres Fauns call these gray-hued young deer to their frolics stem from the markings both share. Undoubtedly, the grog that accompanies such tales has something to do with these claims. Whatever the case, they're adorable in the extreme.
10759.name: Faun Fawn

10760.description: "My family thinks wasps are the worst, but one of these solitary fellows helped me stave off a cliff strider attack. It started following me after it nibbled on a strider I'd killed. I guess it likes to eat them."âGellius Nuncius, Wanderer
10760.name: Bitter Coast Wasp

10761.description: The wasps found in the heart of the woods around Lake Honrich use mud to build their nests. While they normally keep out of sight, they swarm any who threaten their nests. Those who help defend against intruders may just find a friend following them home.
10761.name: Heartwood Dauber

10844.description: A miniature statue of Kynareth, goddess of the elements, as sculpted in High Isle.
10844.name: Statuette: Kynareth of the Winds

10845.description: A miniature statue of the Duchess Martinne Guimard, leader of the consortium that purchased the Systres Archipelago.
10845.name: Statuette: Duchess Martinne

10846.description: A painting by Vaudrie Barthel, well-known for her landscapes and scenes depicting life and nature in the Systres Isles.
10846.name: Painting: Systres Archipelago

10847.description: Stablers who see this impressive steed enter yards say they're blessed with good luck. Not only does caring for these Glenumbran rams bring profit, but their presence is said to herald a calm and peaceful night ahead.
10847.name: King's Guard Ram

10848.description: Not long after the Battle of Sungard, these sabre cats started prowling the area. Scholars at the time believed some element of the battle disturbed their normal habitat. Seeing an opportunity, animal handlers found cubs and started raising them as pets.
10848.name: Sungard Sabre Cat

10849.description: Commonly seen trotting alongside carts and coaches in Stormhaven, these perceptive dogs serve as deterrents to bandits and other road hazards. Within recent years, they've become popular in other parts of Tamriel, including Blackwood and the Rift.
10849.name: Menevian Coachdog

10851.description: "I'd heard that Peryite followers wake up to find their skeevers transformed by his blessing. Never really thought about it until I woke up next to one. We're fine now, but by my Prince's pustules, those first moments got my battle rage up."âYamighu
10851.name: Blightlord's Skeever

10852.description: Some claim these curious Daedric wyrms from Apocrypha devour books to vouchsafe the knowledge for their master. Others believe cultists of Hermaeus Mora use these creatures to hunt tomes long thought lost. Perhaps you know the truth?
10852.name: Apocryphal Bookwyrm

10853.description: Though the artist who sculpted this statue remains unknown, those who have faced the Ascendant Lord declare it captures this leader's might and presence perfectly. Claimed from the treasure trove of the Ascendant Order.
10853.name: Statue, Ascendant Lord

10854.description: Trophy taken from Archdruid Devyric in honor of an Undaunted victory in Earthen Root Enclave.
10854.name: Trophy: Archdruid Devyric
10854.hint: Awarded for completing Earthen Root Enclave.

10855.description: Trophy taken from the Euphotic Gatekeeper in honor of an Undaunted victory in Graven Deep.
10855.name: Trophy: Euphotic Gatekeeper
10855.hint: Awarded for completing the Graven Deep.

10856.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Earthen Root Enclave.
10856.name: Bust: Archdruid Devyric
10856.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Earthen Root Enclave.

10857.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Graven Deep.
10857.name: Bust: Euphotic Gatekeeper
10857.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Graven Deep.
