10858.description: House Telvanni is renowned for the brutality of their scholarly infighting. In shadowy caves across the Inner Sea, a cult to Hermaeus Mora has grown up among those expelled from the House but still thirsting for knowledge, power, and one day â¦ revenge.
10858.name: Antecedent Scholar's Guar

10862.description: "When she came of age, young Stena took a rabbit under her protection. I swear, I've seen Hircine himself manifest within her to defend that creature."âBrewer Bodgrannagh of Markarth
10862.name: Understone Obsidian Hare

10869.description: "Give one of these green-shelled beauties food, and they'll follow you around a bit. Keep it up, and you've a friend for life. If they were smaller, I'd let them dangle from my ears, but they settle into my pack well enough."âAetis Salvitto
10869.name: Heartland River Crab

10870.description: "This one isn't sure just when these adorable jerboa first showed up in Rimmen, but they are recent. Also, nuisances. They distract so much, plus this one's keeps getting underfoot. Maybe it seeks to kill Sharrasti."âSharrasti, Scholar
10870.name: Rimmen Jerboa

10873.description: "You'd think a salamander warped by the Spellscar would be a frightening beast, but I find the play of energies in their form enthralling. Also, no matter the weather, having one at your feet helps you stay comfortably warm or cool."âNaifa, Scholar
10873.name: Spellscar Salamander

10874.description: Also called the "Dog of the Watch," these dark-furred mutts work alongside sailors on their docked ships. Recently, the craze among Gonfalon Bay nobles involves sponsoring the care, feeding, and, oddly, hats for these beloved canines.
10874.name: Gonfalon Sea Cur

10881.description: The scent of flowers precedes this cream-colored steed's arrival. White-and-merlot barding features the grinning silver-and-gold visage of Sanguine, Lord of Revelry. Will you let the promise made by its illusory roses and wine entice you into merriment?
10881.name: Sanguine Revelry Steed

10905.description: After an Investigator Vale story featured one of these variegated wolves native to Alik'r, their popularity as steeds rose among the ranks of the adventurous literati. Their loyalty may have, if anything, been understated in the story.
10905.name: Speckled Wolf

10906.description: "Anu. Padomay. That's what this camel reminds me of. Where one ends, the other begins. What one begins, the other ends. Striations of stasis and change. One. Eternal. Quintessential. Just like this camel. Duck. It's about to spit."âAtazal of Sentinel
10906.name: Quintessential Camel

10912.description: "These large, floof-tailed beasts love to scamper around their home Graht-oak, tucking nuts and seeds into hidey-holes around its roots. Keep an acorn in your pocket, and you've a friend for lifeâor until it sneaks that acorn away from you!"âAmridil
10912.name: Graht-Oak Squirrel
10912.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Great Oaks from Little Acorns."

10919.description: "Swirls of velvety purple. Curved horns. Eyes glowing as they stared down at me. Did I still dream? Had I eaten the wrong mushroom? But no, I was awake. Ah, Vaermina. I delight in serving you, but this gift interrupts my studies."âMalven Relas's Journal
10919.name: Ram of Dark Dreams
10919.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Sane and Clearheaded."

10926.description: Before these colorful creatures served as mounts for the Urshilaku, their shells were ground up for pigment. Seeing their potential as fast-moving steeds, handlers trained them for scouting missions, often hiding their bright colors with dried mud.
10926.name: Urshilaku Nix-Ox

10929.description: "One morning I found a little guarling in my garden. Rushing around, bouncing off things. I'm not entirely sure why it wanted to keep bits of its shell, but I don't care. Look at how cute it is! I think we're friends now, and I would die for it."âFaylva
10929.name: Half-Hatched Guarling

11059.description:
Summoned from the fourth Sinus of Takubar, Hoarfrost will convey your goods (or the goods of your groupmates) to the cold-flame pits of Oblivion in exchange for mortal coins.

Ancient bindings prevent them from appearing in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds.
11059.name: Hoarfrost, Takubar Trader

11062.description: A miniature statue of Bendu Olo, Baron-Admiral of the All Flags Navy, as sculpted in High Isle.
11062.name: Statuette: Baron-Admiral Olo

11063.description: A miniature statue of the mysterious Ascendant Lord, who seeks to claim an ancient legacy.
11063.name: Statuette: Ascendant Lord

11064.description: A painting by Vaudrie Barthel that captures the play of light and water at an elegant manor in the Systres Archipelago.
11064.name: Painting: Systres Seaside Manor

11065.description: "Druids say the moths are ash made manifest. They leap from the flames of Mount Firesong and flutter away on the breeze. Nonsense! I've seen a moth ignite and then emerge from the coals like a cocoon."âFeather-Brained Teeska
11065.name: Phoenix Moth
11065.hint: Complete the quest "Guardian of Y'ffelon" on Galen.

11067.description: The first destrier born from a harrowstorm spurned its original rider and galloped away before any present could capture it. This pattern continued for a time, leading many to wonder where they went. Some say they must find new ridersâfor good or ill.
11067.name: Harrowstorm Destrier

11068.description: "Vicious, the bear was, all a-rumble with menace, despite its chains. 'Let us please Lord Vivec with this two-toned creature. Its growls show promise in a world filled with craven whispers.' And so it began."âArmiger Tharys's Journal
11068.name: Buoyant Armiger Bear

11069.description: "Vile mischief inflicted wounds upon the striped kagouti. 'Lord Vivec must know we have healed this creature who protected his servants. Remembered pain will lead to prevented pain.' And so it befriended the bear and spider."âArmiger Tharys's Journal
11069.name: Buoyant Armiger Kagouti

11070.description: "Exuberance flowed from the emerald ornaug, then it despaired. 'It enjoyed its freedom from the cage, yet lack of purpose brought it low. Perhaps Lord Vivec can grant it one among us.' And so it joined our other three steeds."âArmiger Tharys's Journal
11070.name: Buoyant Armiger Ornaug

11071.description: "Curious, the horned beast sniffed at food before turning away. 'Ah, curiosity drives it, but caution tempers it. A wise beast for Lord Vivec's study. Perhaps it can teach fools wisdom and open sages to hope.' And so it ended."âArmiger Tharys's Journal
11071.name: Buoyant Armiger Ram

11072.description: "Intense shudders wracked the spider of Dwarven make. 'It smells most foul. Let us repair its workings for Lord Vivec. Its perpetual existence shall provoke needed change among us.' And so it joined the bear."âArmiger Tharys's Journal
11072.name: Buoyant Armiger Dwarven Spider

11073.description: With both knightly skills and druidic lore in his repertoire, Sir Stefan Mornard makes for a deadly foeâand a courteous houseguest. After adding Sir Stefan to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
11073.name: Stefan Mornard

11074.description: Caska the Senche-raht serves as the first mate on The Perfect Pounce, and she loves time off to pursue other interestsâperhaps in your house! After adding Caska to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
11074.name: Caska

11075.description: Vampire hunters such as Mel Adrys travel widely in pursuit of their quarry, and they need places to rest between hunts. Care to host this Dark Elf? After adding Mel to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
11075.name: Mel Adrys

11076.description: The unchained potential that emanates from the Spellscar twists and changes everything it touches. Who or what drew a quasigriff to Craglorn is still a mystery, but these esoterically beautiful beasts add something new and transcendent to Tamriel.
11076.name: Spellscar Quasigriff

11079.description: Unlike their more common domesticated cousins, the Firebelly Shalk constantly blazes. Militant Dark Elves sometimes train these Glasscrag Edifice natives to infiltrate the holds of their enemies. Others find them fiery friends on cold Ashlands nights.
11079.name: Firebelly Shalk

11082.description: "Love books, do you? What if they had tentacles and an eye? The gift of flight? Like them as much then? Yes? Oh, delightful! Here, befriend my beloved Philosophicus AeternumâPhilo for short. Expand its knowledge of Nirn."âThe Archivist of the Lost
11082.name: Abyssal Tomeshell

11097.description:
Hailing from the pocket realm of Infernace, Pyroclast will holdfast your items (or the items of your groupmates) in the fiery pits of Oblivion. Minor scorching may occur.

Ancient bindings prevent them from appearing in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds.
11097.name: Pyroclast, Infernace Conservator

11102.description: "We were all surprised when this senche arrived via envoy. 'A gift from Necrom to an armiger of great repute. Return and aid in the training of more!' And so I ventured to Necrom with a cunning, furry companion."âArmiger Tharys's Journal
11102.name: Necrom Armiger Senche

11120.description: Dremnaken runts do not take kindly to acts of aggression. They include chin scratches and head pats in this category, more's the pity. In fact, it's best you avoid even the gentlest of eye contact.
11120.name: Discord Dremnaken Runt

11121.description: Hermit crabs are nothing if not adaptable. Those from the Telvanni Peninsula use hollowed mushroom caps as their homes and serve as ornaments in Dark Elf gardens.
11121.name: Peninsula Hermit Crab

11143.description: Originally found in volcanic regions in the Dark Elf territories, these insects can be tamed with kind words and cheese. They chirp excitedly when happy or when skittering on slick floors.
11143.name: Fungal Ash Hopper

11146.description: Riders of these draugr bears find the dragonscale barding does an exemplary job. There's exactly as much jouncing as you'd expect riding hard on a skeletal ursine's back. Plus, the frost magic imbued within adds a frisson of chill to keep riders alert.
11146.name: Dragonscale Draugr Bear

11147.description: "You may laugh, but like Shor, this fox has added years to my life. Years. Saved me from some giants by outwitting them. Hoisted me by my breeches out of the angry spring waters of the Yorgrim. I breed them now, so I named them."âThorkell
11147.name: Shor's Fox

11149.description: Hermit crabs are famous for making homes out of any discarded shell, but the hermit crabs of Iliac Bay are pickier than most. They choose shells that match their own delicate blue coloration.
11149.name: Iliac Bay Hermit Crab

11150.description: Natives of the Ashlands of Vvardenfell, these flightless, winged reptiles use their pale coloration to hide amidst that barren terrain. They can be trained, however, and follow their owners almost anywhere.
11150.name: Ashen Cliff Strider

11151.description: In Telvanni lands, haj mota sometimes lay their eggs in broken catacombs or abandoned cemeteries. The hatchlings acquire a coating of green grave-mold on their shells and become sensitive to the presence of ghosts.
11151.name: Ancestral Haj Mota

11152.description: "As kits, these rambunctious little trouble-making furballs keep this one on her toes. But their predilection for trouble when young works in your favorâtheir ability to sense harm is nearly magical. Perfect for messenger work!"âTesusah, Stablemaster
11152.name: Autumn Messenger Fox

11153.description: Legend says a trading caravan was once ambushed on its way to Elden Root. Only one survived. Days later they arrived safely, slung across the back of a majestic white-and-black elk. Perhaps you might make such a friend if you find yourself in need.
11153.name: Elden Root Elk

11159.description: The bears of Solstheim have a deep and ancient connection to the All-Maker. When the time comes to serve as a mount to the Skaal, or so the stories go, they enter the corral as mild-mannered as a cub.
11159.name: All-Maker's Bear

11160.description: The harmony of the All-Maker dwells within the chest of this steed. It breathes in the breath and breathes out the wind. In its wake does the earth move, the waters flow, and the sun shine.
11160.name: All-Maker's Horse

11161.description: Unlike other Senche-rahts, Thryn has accepted many riders in its time, though only a few have lasted beyond one battle. This is due to Thryn's habit of testing its rider's mettle with daring maneuvers and wild risksâall in the name of a good story.
11161.name: All-Maker's Senche-Raht

11162.description: "I don't normally consult on the personal projects of other folk, but it was an honor to study beside you. Whatever gave you the excellent idea to overhaul it in the style of the Skaal?"âNeramo, in a letter to the artisan known as the Spidersmith
11162.name: All-Maker's Dwarven Spider

11163.description: "On a dark and moonless night, raiders stole into the village with plunder in their eyes and violence in their hearts. Their victory was assured, until a lone howl ripped through the icy night air." âThe All-Maker's Land, translated
11163.name: All-Maker's Wolf

11166.description: First domesticated around Bonerock Cavern, these miniature mammoths are affectionate pets and follow their masters at a cautious, reasonable gait. Carefulâpocket mammoths are known cuddlers.
11166.name: Ebontusk Pocket Mammoth

11167.description: A playful bit of incarnated plasma first summoned by talented arcanists from the strange realms beyond Tamriel, these cubs are mischievous, devoted, and harmless. Well, mostly harmless.
11167.name: Chaotic Creatia Cub

11168.description: These ashen vvardvarks are much adored by Ashlander children. Their long tongues hungrily searching Morrowind's volcanic vents for food make for an entertaining sight.
11168.name: Ashsorrow Vvardvark

11169.description: "The glint of gold I glimpsed when I first spotted these guar made me think I'd found a vein of gold, but no. Instead I found something betterâgolden guar that match my exquisite taste. One nudged me to ride it, too! We're best friends."âGanalyn Relvan
11169.name: Goldscale Guar

11170.description: The artists of Black Heights found a new canvas upon which to share their imagination: senche-servals. The high-quality pigments used on this feline's fur weather much without causing harm, and artists claim the cats preen as they're painted.
11170.name: Oleander Senche-Serval

11179.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Scrivener's Hall.
11179.name: Bust: Ozezan the Inferno
11179.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Scrivener's Hall.

11180.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Bal Sunnar.
11180.name: Bust: Roksa the Warped
11180.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Bal Sunnar.

11181.description: Trophy taken from Ozezan the Inferno in honor of an Undaunted victory in Scrivener's Hall.
11181.name: Trophy: Ozezan the Inferno
11181.hint: Awarded for completing the Scrivener's Hall.

11182.description: Trophy taken from Roksa the Warped in honor of an Undaunted victory in Bal Sunnar.
11182.name: Trophy: Roksa the Warped

11183.description: You may place the Chronometer in your home. Watching the dial spin causes local perception of time to shift. Until the Chronometer is disturbed, time stands still. Enjoy Sotha Sil's morning sun, Almalexia's mid-day mercy, or the star-spun night of Vivec.
11183.name: Chronometer of the Tribunal

11194.description: "I wished for ears that could listen to dreams. He gave them to me. How lonely was I that I needed to be part of your most private wonders? Now I wander a forest of waking horrors. Please, take care of him. It was my fault."âNote found in Jasper's basket
11194.name: Abyssal Bunny

11196.description: Iron Orcs labor hard and long, fight until their dying breath, and train mounts to do the same. So, if you're lucky enough to ride one of their welwas, expect to be pushed to your own limits as your mount keeps going despite all obstacles in its path.
11196.name: Iron Orc Welwa

11197.description: "Don't muck with another rider's wolf, unless you're ready to meet the All-Maker. These are spirit beasts. They come when summoned, but they're loyal only to their rider. I nearly lost a finger learning that lesson the hard way." âHlokela, Solitude
11197.name: Solstheim Shiver Wolf

11198.description: As her name implies, Crafty Lerisa possesses a cunning that keeps her alive. Right now it's telling her to sit tightâperhaps in your home? After adding Crafty Lerisa to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
11198.name: Crafty Lerisa

11199.description: No job is too small for this Pahmar-raht resistance fighter. That said, he needs a place to rest before his next efforts against his oppressors. After adding J'baanluk to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
11199.name: J'baanluk

11200.description: Ready to learn more about Peryite, the Prince of Pestilence? Then Filbert's ready to visit and share his knowledge. After adding Filbert to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
11200.name: Filbert Cienne

11201.description: "And thus did Alkosh bestow a companion of pure light upon his champion. From atop the beast, the champion rode a noble path. And wherever the lion's paws fell, light and justice soon followed thereafter." âPath of the Highmane, translated
11201.name: Blessed Highmane Lion

11202.description: "After weeks of searching, I finally caught a glimpse of that illustrious beast on the horizon. I thought it was a vision from Meridia, but then it approached on the icy tundra and I felt the warmth of its breath on my hand." âJournal of Mage Abzrolg
11202.name: Star-Orphan Elk

11203.description: Originally seen as a mistake by its creator, vvardvarks grew in popularity, compelling Telvanni magisters to expand its development. This dark-hued mount is perfectly suited to carry riders in funerary processions honoring revered ancient ancestors.
11203.name: Ashmourning Vvardvark

11204.description: "Twisted twigs, a scent of death, a dance amid the briars. A dash of howls and drip of gore starts sinister fires. Stir round with haunted bone, then call me with your screams. If I approve, a mount you gain to torment your foes' dreams."âLord Hollowjack
11204.name: Hollowjack Indrik

11209.description: "Some of father's creations can be so frightening what with the way they hiss and stutter, but not this small scarab, no. After all, its bright glow does wonders to keep the monsters beneath my bed at bay."âFabricator Anzalf's Daughter
11209.name: Ebony Dwarven Scarab

11210.description: A fabricant from the hidden laboratories of Sotha Sil, the clockwork nix-hound is a small but lifelike imitation. It even "hunts" and consumes tiny scraps of metal in its vicinity. Watch out for your coin purse!
11210.name: Clockwork Nix-Hound

11217.description: A miniature statue of Kaalgrontiid, the emerald sovereign of wrath and terror.
11217.name: Statuette: Kaalgrontiid

11218.description: A miniature statue of an Orc warrior emanating strength.
11218.name: Statuette: Orc Warrior

11219.description: A painting presenting a peaceful blending of Breton and druidic architecture, set against the wild lushness of Galen's flora.
11219.name: Painting: Galen in Harmony

11232.description: Guar have long been at home in the Black Marsh, making them steady companions to the Argonians. It is not uncommon for Lavender Guar to bond deeply with their riders, standing watch while they sleep and affectionately nuzzling them.
11232.name: Lavender Guar

11233.description: Much like the pocket mammoths first domesticated near Bonerock Cavern, these creatures are docile and affectionate, plus make excellent livestock. This sub-species is particularly prized among breeders for its distinctive fur color.
11233.name: Ginger Pocket Mammoth

11237.description: Aethereal light pours off this unearthly fawn. Some say it's a blessing from the Divines, while others think it's a Daedric trick. Still, it's a rare thing to be trusted by such an elusive creature, placing its companions in auspicious company.
11237.name: Star-Orphan Fawn

11238.description: Some claim this breed of bird from Cyrodiil's heartland has a deeper connection to Shezarr than the name. This is likely due to their escape artist reputation, which finds them "being misplaced" quite regularly.
11238.name: Shezarr's Chicken

11239.description: Docile and hardy, these sheep were first tamed near Whiterun. Their thick wool is woven into cloaks and blankets, protecting the wearer during harsh winters. Nord children sometimes bed down among the flock, enjoying the sheep's warmth.
11239.name: Silent Moons Sheep

11240.description: Aloof and strangely mournful, there's no question Pirzbi wields powerful magic. Some say their innate ability and keen intellect have become an obstacle for those who wish to partner with them. Perhaps you will find success where they did not.
11240.name: Sagacious Psijic Senche-Raht

11293.description: Fangtomes know not the importance or content of the books they inhabit. In the event that your rare first editions or vital academic texts have gained a tenant, simply befriend the tome via ample spine massages and a gentle ruffling of its pages.
11293.name: Albinoscript Fangtome

11326.description: Some find the color unnerving, but many riders enjoy the onyx shade and welcome the superstitious tales that follow this mount. Just know that countless legends and tales of woe begin when a Black Fredas beast crosses one's path.
11326.name: Black Fredas Senche-Lizard

11379.description: "How many times have I told you to keep your fingers away from the claws? Now look at you, knuckles bruised and nothing learned. The crab did nothing wrong. Maybe it's time this one found a more appropriate home."âOverheard on the Necrom docks
11379.name: Prodigious Crimson Mudcrab

11380.description: These ponderous moths flap slowly between pools of moonlight, attracted by the glow. During the day, they either rest on shady tree trunks or follow behind those who make them feel safe. Their delicate wings are famously soft to the touch.
11380.name: Hearthhome Moth

11390.description: Solitary mercenary Sharp-as-Night isn't used to company, but if you invite him into your home, this warden will leave his icy demeanor at the door. Mostly. Talk to him to hear his unfiltered thoughts, or set him on a path to let him wander your estate.
11390.name: Sharp-as-Night
11390.hint: Obtained by completing quest "Light the Way to Freedom".

11391.description: Azandar al-Cybiades is a consummate researcher and peerless arcanist. Just ask him! After adding Azandar to your home, you can set him on a path. You and your guests can also talk to him. Trust us, he's got plenty to say.
11391.name: Azandar

11402.description: "Cute little critters, aren't they? The white pelt helps them blend into the mountains of Skyrim. That's good, because they're just about the tastiest thing the winter has to offer. Except for that one. He's off limits."âNarrald Snow-Bourne
11402.name: Deepsnow Prairie Dog

11403.description: "The Wild Elves did something right when they tamed these adorable beasties! Look at those eyes, and that tail! Plus with that handsome armor, they'll be well protected on the road." âApprentice Odrethin
11403.name: Welkyndstone Ruins Pup

11407.description: "I'm not going to say that you need to ride this beast. But when the Prince of Secret Knowledge hands you the reins, are you really going to turn them down? I know I wouldn't!"âFiler Xess
11407.name: Maligraphic Mount
11407.hint: Acquired by completing the "Ichor Most Malevolent" achievement.

11408.description: Legend says this indrik was born of a child's toy, touched by magic on the year's longest night. Others believe a worthy rider wished it into being by pleading with the moons on a cold Frostfall night. Regardless, riders see the world for the wonder it is.
11408.name: Solstice Indrik

11409.description: "All durzog are relentless in the pursuit of prey, but this sub-species is particularly vicious, especially when following a harpy's scent. Even experienced handlers sometimes struggle to contain their ferocity on the hunt." âElsweyr: A Rider's Guide
11409.name: Harpy's Bane Durzog

11422.description: Selectively bred for generations by the Mages Guild and the Order of the Lamp, these steeds possess remarkable stamina and agility. No expense is spared in their training, and they are equipped with armor rivaling that of the finest knights in Tamriel.
11422.name: Order of the Lamp Destrier

11423.description: Cunning and fast, this jackal has a laughing bark that echoes for miles. While they can be somewhat wild even to their riders, the jackal's preternatural ability to find shortcuts and quick exits has made it a preferred mount for many Lamp Knights.
11423.name: Order of the Lamp Jackal

11424.description: "Magicka depleted. Enemies on all sides. The cornered mages despaired. Until they heard a growl erupt into a roar as a Lamp Knight and his leonine steed smashed through the enemy ranks."âTale of the Palatinus, translated
11424.name: Order of the Lamp Lion

11425.description: Though not the most fearsome mounts, these recent additions to the Lamp Knight stable are treasured for their loyalty, surefootedness, and tracking skills. Some mages claim they can smell magicka, making them invaluable to the Order of the Lamp.
11425.name: Order of the Lamp Vvardvark

11431.description: A miniature statue of the Daedric Prince Vaermina, the Lady of Nightmares.
11431.name: Statuette: Vaermina, Dreamweaver

11432.description: A miniature statue of a sentinel found outside many Dwarven ruins in Morrowind.
11432.name: Statuette: Dwemer Guardian

11433.description: The light of dawn caresses the spires of Bal Foyen as a trader and their travel-burdened guar arrive at this Dark Elf sanctum by the sea.
11433.name: Painting: Arrival at Bal Foyen

11434.description: "The ravens of Rivenspire are some of the smartest in all of Tamriel. Something about surviving in such an inhospitable land, I think. This fine fellow has been my companion on many a long night in the study."âLady Felyse Talemelier
11434.name: Eyebright Raven

11435.description: Need some mirth and mystery in your home? Invite Alchemy, a renowned performer from the House of Reveries, to stay with you. After adding Alchemy to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
11435.name: Alchemy

11436.description: The inimitable Captain Kaleen seeks some shore leave before setting sail for her next job. If you've a bunk for her, she'll gladly take it. After adding Captain Kaleen to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
11436.name: Captain Kaleen
11436.hint: Acquired by completing the achievement "Memories of the Spearhead."

11437.description: Divergences in fate's threads draw Scruut's attention. Yet, this mighty Watchling seeks your company until the Great Eye summons her. Coincidence? After adding Scruut to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
11437.name: Scruut

11438.description: The shallows of Buraniim Isle are rife with a unique subspecies of ornaug. Vibrant and playful, these ornaugs have been known to splash in the surf to attract the curiosity of would-be prey. When the unsuspecting meal draws too close, they strike.
11438.name: Buraniim Isle Ornaug

11439.description: "The training of one's canine is tantamount to the importance of military maneuvers. Neglecting a Legion canine weakens the entire unit. Like watering grapes in the field, proper care yields the fruit of loyalty."âLegion Recruit Training Manual
11439.name: Skingrad Guard Mastiff

11440.description: Why would a mage train an imp to cast a seeming of the God of Schemes? Who knows? But this tiny Dark Father, this diminutive Prince of Pain, this undersized Lord of Lies is almost cute. Almost.
11440.name: Molag Bal Illusion Imp

11441.description: Many have met their ends at the jaws of a fully grown Solstheim wolf. This trained version, however, still has snowflakes in its fur and frolics whenever it comes across a fresh snow drift. It even gives freezing cold kisses when called.
11441.name: Solstheim Shiver Wolf

11443.description: "We subdued this one and trained it a bit. Poor beast, fresh from the Recollection grow pits. Doesn't know what it is or where it came from. Maybe it will take to you. Just mind the tail, now."âFausta Arius, Legion member
11443.name: West Weald Tharriker

11444.description: "The Dawnwood's new, but the forest's roots reach deep. The Ayleids were here before us, and they left their own mark on the land. We tamed this beast through the Green, but Y'ffre knows how long it's been out here." âNothelas, Bosmer priest
11444.name: Welkyndstone Ruins Wolf

11450.description: "A very talented Imp, no? It cannot be denied Jone and Jode have blessed this creature with their light. Some even speak of having to hide their moon sugar from it!" âAdept Lakjo
11450.name: Bright Moons Dragon Imp

11451.description: This beast has been touched by the deep magic, connecting to the power between the worlds. It carried a draught of creatia back with it to Nirn, glimmering with potential in every feather and bone.
11451.name: Mystical Quasigriff

11454.description: Gilded from head to hoof, this indrik practically glows with the light of inspiration. It may have been a fabled companion of Vanus Galerion. Whether or not the legends are true, its rider will see a world full of shimmering ideas and possibilities.
11454.name: Galerion's Indrik

11455.description: "Reptilian welwa are particularly prized among the Argonians. This could be due to their perceived connection to the Hist, or simply the fact that their scales allow them to wallow in the marsh alongside their masters."âBlack Marsh Rider's Guide
11455.name: Sunset Welwa

11457.description: "I've only seen a wild brindle bear once, and I don't wish to repeat the experience. The creature found me in the woods, bagging up a deer. It growled. I froze. But then it walked right by me. It must have already eaten."âScarius Barbatus of Kvatch
11457.name: Brindle Bear

11458.description: "Most mages prefer not to ride onto the front line of a battle. But if they must, they go prepared. The Mages Guild chooses their steeds with care, only training the most surefooted rams to carry their magisters into battle."âMagus Vacia Sidonia
11458.name: Master-Wizard's Ram

11459.description: Leave it to a skeever to somehow wriggle free of the Infinite Archive. This Maligraphy probably poses minimal threat to the world at large. Let's just hope none of its bigger brethren learn the same trick.
11459.name: Maligraphic Skeever
11459.hint: Acquired by completing the "Scheming Skeevers" achievement.

11460.description: Despite their magnificent and fragile appearance, these butterflies are quite resilient. They've been known to cling to their chosen master through thick and thin, even in the midst of battle.
11460.name: Stainedwing Butterfly

11461.description: "Don't let the eyes fool you. This pup is a master manipulator. It'll have you believing it's never eaten a day in its life while there's still a frog leg hanging from its mouth. By Julianos, it's hard to resist though."âScholar Vilia Ceno
11461.name: Blueblood Frog Hound Pup

11464.description: "Any Nord can be proud with a canine like this at their side. Our ancestors tamed them ages ago. Ever since, they've been helping us watch our flocks, scare predators away, and keep unruly children from getting underfoot."âFarmer Eoeilif
11464.name: Saarthal Shepherd

11465.description: The way it shimmers in the sunlight makes it obvious this is not an average snake. The serpent glows with an iridescent magic, which it uses to hypnotize its prey when it rears up. Even men and mer struggle to resist its mesmerizing scales.
11465.name: Meridia-Touched Asp

11472.description: All statues of the Inevitable Knower are, after a fashion, access points from Apocrypha to Nirn. Given that, go carefully as you invite Hermaeus Mora into your home.
11472.name: Statuette: Mora, Lord of Secrets

11473.description: A miniature version of the "Thirty-Fourth Sermon" statue, carved by the people of Necrom.
11473.name: Statuette: Vivec's Triumph

11474.description: "As you can see by my attached references, I am one of the foremost experts in vicinage wards, forfending spells, and the art of research. If anyone can deal with the Dreamstone's ire, it is me. I hope you come to the same conclusion."âWarlock Vanton
11474.name: Painting: Sanity's Edge

11502.description: "My marshmates don't understand why I chose this beast. They say it is territorial and snappy. You just have to read the signs. Like right now. Its tail is twitching. You should move your hand if you like your fingers."âSkeeheieeus of Stormhold
11502.name: Silver-Limned Guar Charger

11504.description: "Absolutely not. We can't keep it! Pigs are livestock, nothing more. Don't give me that look. All right, I'll admit it's very cute. And soft. Still, though, we can't keep it. We'll find it a good home."âOverheard in Bruma
11504.name: Bruma Spotted Pig

11505.description: The eye-catching hue of this haj mota may be beautiful, but it belies a fiery demeanor. Haj motas are known for their harsh temperaments, but this one is not to be trifled with. Thankfully, it's too small to do more than snap at ankles.
11505.name: Ruby Haj Mota

11506.description: "Watch your moon sugar around these ones. They have keen eyes and clever hands. This one has lost her lunch to Zuzdu more times than she can count. Still, they can be quite sweet when they want to be. Probably from all the stolen sugar."âTahara
11506.name: Sugarsnow Monkey

11507.description: "Emerald Oak Nixads are known for their mischief. Their coloration allows them to hide in forests, waiting for unsuspecting travelers to pass by. Upon leaving, travelers will find their rations much lighter, especially sweets."âGold Coast Field Guide
11507.name: Emerald Oak Nixad

11508.description: "HoonDing knows they don't look fast. But that's actually a good thing. No one will expect you to cover as much ground as you do. And there is truly nothing more terrifying than a camel charging you at full speed."âBilami the Caravaneer
11508.name: Sword-Singer's Tufted Camel

11513.description: Though alarming at first glance, this fawn is perfectly content with its strangely blazing body. Those who can tame this extreme example of mystical adaptation will find its back an excellent medium for cooking over an open flame.
11513.name: Destruction Dale Fawn

11514.description: This impressive vision is the work of a very dedicated illusion imp. The shimmering form sparks the adoration of all who see it, making for easy handouts and safe havens for this tiny so-called Dragon.
11514.name: Conjured Dragon Imp

11515.description: "This cub is special, yes. Beautiful and quite friendly. Not the softest companion, but others have said the same about me."âScholar Zansora
11515.name: Prismatic Senche Cub

11518.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Sanity's Edge.
11518.name: Bust: Ansuul the Tormentor
11518.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Sanity's Edge.

11519.description: Trophy taken from Ansuul the Tormentor in honor of an Undaunted victory in Sanity's Edge.
11519.name: Trophy: Ansuul the Tormentor

11520.description: This beast is the result of a collaboration between Shad Astula students and Mages Guild apprentices. Rumor is it may be slightly psychic, responding to its rider's commands almost before they're uttered aloud. The color is a nice bonus, too.
11520.name: Altered Ornaug

11522.description: Though fearsome in appearance, these ursauks make staunch companions when properly socialized. Their thick fur and hardy constitutions allow them to thrive even in the harshest environments, especially those in the northern reaches of Tamriel.
11522.name: Atmoran Snow Ursauk

11523.description: Swift as a stream and silent as a shadow, this creature appears in many folktales across Tamriel. In some, the lynx stalks its quarry across the night sky. In others it's an agile companion, perfect for worthy hunters prowling the darkest nights.
11523.name: Celestial Lynx

11530.description: These playful golden canines happily accompany their people on journeys near and far, making friends with anyone they meet along the way. The downside to this endearing show of trust is, of course, that they're not the best guard dogs.
11530.name: Chorrol Retriever

11531.description: "Ah, this is a beast worthy of a hero! Don't worry, faithful Minana here has seen her share of battles and more than earned the armor she now wears. She will be a staunch companion to you, no matter where HoonDing bids you."âDragonguard Zarina
11531.name: Sai-Sahan's Revelry Ursine

11532.description: A steed worthy of an emperor, this courser represents the finest traits of Imperial equestrian skill. Steady and strong with an incredibly smooth gait, this mount could help its rider fell countless kingdoms.
11532.name: Varen's Revelry Courser

11533.description: Said to have been tamed by Lyris Titanborn herself, this fierce wolf easily bears its rider across nearly any terrain. While the beast is a frenzied fighter on the battlefield, one word from its rider will have it waiting docilely for the next command.
11533.name: Titanborn's Revelry Wolf

11534.description: "These mudcrabs developed their shine as both a defensive tactic and mating ritual. By angling their bodies, they can reflect blinding rays at would-be predators or signal their availability to potential mates."âMirrormoor: More Than an Illusion
11534.name: Mirrormoor Mudcrab
11534.hint: Awarded by completing the "Prisoner of Fate" quest.

11535.description: "The Imperials do love their regalia, don't they? Even I have to admit it's a rather dashing look, for a horse. Anyone who comes in astride that steed is certain to make an entrance."âAbelle Gernand of Kvatch
11535.name: Jubilee Steed
11535.hint: Acquired by completing the "Jubilee Confetti Conveyor" achievement.

11536.description: "This titan failed the Dark Lord once, and paid the price for it. After he ripped off its wings, Molag Bal bound it to his dark will, making it a usefulâif groundedâmount for his more faithful servants."âWorm Cultist Valoel
11536.name: Shackled Titan
11536.hint: |cFFFFFFDaedric Anchor effects appear only when paired with the Molag Bal Illusion polymorph.|r

11537.description: "It appears Sabhir has earned your admiration. This is not the first time his stunning spots have stolen hearts. Shh, don't let him see you looking. He has enough of an ego as it is."âStablehand Ghazaleh
11537.name: Piebald Camel

11552.description: "Look, it may not have much personality, but it's entrancing, in its own way. It's happy to see you, I think. The students at the Mages Guild were very proud of this conjuration. The least you can do is act impressed."âMage Student Hrantin
11552.name: Guild Conjured Wisp

11561.description: Oh, the ignominy of being an agent of justice trapped inside a small floating doll! Now Heiruna intends to plot vengeanceâin your retreat. After adding Heiruna to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
11561.name: Heiruna

11562.description: With no mysteries for this Khajiit of action to solve, he's at loose ends. Perhaps he can discover some curious doings around your abode? After adding Mizzik to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
11562.name: Mizzik Thunderboots

11563.description: This Orc mercenary usually keeps busy, but now he wants some actual quiet time. Not to reflect, thoughâhis well-used gear needs some attention. After adding Skordo to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
11563.name: Skordo the Knife

11639.description: A miniature statue of a Telvanni Mage, carved to venerate a Magister long past but not forgotten.
11639.name: Statuette: Telvanni Magister

11640.description: A painting depicting just one of the innumerable studies within the Endless Library of Hermaeus Mora.
11640.name: Painting: The Endless Library

11641.description: "Trust the Tharns to find a way to make a senche even more regal than it already was. I feel underdressed. Do you think it outranks me?"âLegionary Liodes Salvius
11641.name: Tharn's Lucent Revelry Senche

11642.description: Legend says that Mannimarco himself indoctrinated this Senche-raht to the way of the Anchorite. It's unknown if Zalzagh knows whether this is true, or if they have any recollection of life before joining the Worm Cult.
11642.name: Worm Cultist Senche-Raht

11643.description: "I've always preferred moose to elk or horses. In battle they're more reliable, they're cussed strong, and for overland travel they can't be beat. Plus, their noses are just so soft!" âYvon Serielle, Daggerfall
11643.name: Seaghost Pillion Moose

11644.description: "Yes, this one will do nicely. As vengeful and accursed as my master. It bears the mark of Malacath wellâour enemies will cower before us! May it lap the blood of its prey on the broken path we ride."âOgmash the Mighty
11644.name: Ashbone Sabre Cat
11644.hint: Acquired through crown purchase, promotion, or event. May also be purchased from certain Stablemasters in major cities.

11645.description: Even at this small size, this echalette is rather vicious. It's not afraid to use its tiny tusks to ram perceived threats, other echalettes, or really anything that moves. It's not a very effective tactic, but it is strangely cute.
11645.name: Ashbone Echalette

11646.description: "Look at the scales on this one! I did not know Useful Lizards could be so beautiful. Perhaps that is its use? Spreading beauty throughout the marsh? I will wallow with it and see if the Hist grant any more insight."âThinks-too-Much, Stormhold
11646.name: Goldcrest Ancestor Lizard

11647.description: Prized for their striking plumage, Ashen Scar fellrunners are also highly intelligent. They bond quickly with their caretakers but are known to be quite ornery when stared at for too long. It's best to avoid eye contact when possible.
11647.name: Ashen Scar Fellrunner

11648.description: Less fearsome than they look, the native guar of Alavelis have developed peculiar markings. Some believe they are a mimicry of the poisonous beasts of the Telvanni Peninsula, though the guar themselves have no such defense.
11648.name: Alavelis Ringed Guar

11652.description: "He's not the cuddliest pet, sure, but old Spike here is as loyal as they come. I just throw him some grubs every now and then, and he follows me anywhere I go. I like to think he likes the company and not just the snacks."âTrapper Marcien
11652.name: Thorn Gecko

11656.description: "Of course it's not a real Dragon. That's beside the point. Intense hue recoloration, brimstone expectoration, and a fusion of Wood Elf and Telvanni magical techniques? Tell Otheri the contract is fulfilled, and more."âMagister Varkenel
11656.name: Pyrodraconic Camel-Lizard

11657.description: Owners of this electrifying little friend must learn to handle the occasional shock from time to time. Thunderbugs are quite expressive, though their main form of communication is through sparks and sharp jolts.
11657.name: Mistral Thunderbug

11691.description: "Look, I know tomeshells need a place to live too, but that's one of the rarest volumes in the archive! Sure, it looks flashy now, but Mora knows what state the book will be in whenever this one decides to move on."âCipher Caldaafin
11691.name: Companion Revelry Tomeshell

11692.description: Every child in Winterhold asks for one of these ponies at some point, and a very lucky few will receive one. Their small stature is perfect for young riders, and even older adults cherish them as cheerful and hardy pets.
11692.name: Winterhold Chestnut Pony

11693.description: "Bees are simple, really. They respect power. That's why they follow a queen. Just act like you're supposed to be in charge and they'll work for you. Show any weakness, any hesitation? That's when you get stung."âHei Honey-Hands
11693.name: Mead-Dancer Honeybee

11863.description: Bronze bust commemorating completing Arc 4 in the Infinite Archive.
11863.name: Bust: Tho'at Replicanum
11863.hint: Awarded for defeating the final form of Tho'at Replicanum in the Infinite Archive.

11864.description: Trophy taken from Tho'at Replicanum in honor of completing Arc 1 in the Infinite Archive.
11864.name: Trophy: Tho'at Replicanum
11864.hint: Awarded for defeating the Tho'at Replicanum in the Infinite Archive.

11873.description: The adaptable durzogs that roam Tamriel's deserts have thick skin to protect from abrasive sands and feathers on their neck and back to help with cooling. Their sandy coloring and decreased need for water make them efficient predators in the dunes.
11873.name: Sandsquall Durzog

11874.description: These petulant welwas hail from Wrothgar and more than live up to their name. Hardened by their difficult landscape, the creatures delight in punishing their riders for the smallest slight, whether it's a late feeding or a slightly too-tight saddle.
11874.name: Grudge-Rock Welwa

11876.description: You and your groupmates can tend to the grove of your mind by summoning Drinweth, who will allow you to change and save builds outside of your home. A challenging past with various martial forces means she won't aid you in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds.
11876.name: Drinweth, Valenwood Armorer

11877.description:
Tzozabrar will intake items you don't need, expelling useful materials no doubt scavenged from a Dwarven construct. Tonal interference makes it unusable in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds.

After it's summoned, you and your groupmates can use its services.
11877.name: Tzozabrar, Dwarven Deconstructor

11878.description: Often found crawling up the banks of the Strid River, these crabs have recently made their way upstream into West Weald. While they taste delicious, many collectors prefer to keep them as pets thanks to their dazzling color.
11878.name: Strid River Crab

11879.description: Rarer than their alabaster cousins in High Rock, these spotted sheep are beloved for their gentle demeanors and extra soft wool. Many inexperienced farmers can't resist their sweet faces, and these sheep have been known to grow fat on extra treats.
11879.name: Cream and Coffee Sheep

11880.description: Born in the blasted wastes of Coldharbour, Molag Bal's ferocious welwa pursue their prey with terrifying tenacity. It is said that only the chains of the Dark Anchors themselves can hold the beasts back once they've scented their quarry.
11880.name: Anchorborn Welwa

11881.description: This feline fixes you with a gaze that seems to say, "Your attempts to pet me are presumptuous! Do you think mice can stop the most powerful catromancer Tamriel has ever known? This form is my first step toward immortality! Witness my true kitty power!"
11881.name: Meownimarco

11882.description: This bantam guar's coloring provides camouflage. This is both a blessing and a curse, as it has a habit of wandering off if left unattended. With a trusting attitude, few natural defenses, and no innate survival instincts â¦ don't leave it unattended.
11882.name: Twilight Bantam Guar

11887.description: "Beware lone roads and moonless nights. Beware the haunted hooves. Beware the burning-coal eyes and the fiery trail that follows each dogged step. Most of all, beware of the path of the steed's terrible riders."âFolk Legends of Tamriel
11887.name: Nightmare Pillion Courser

11924.description: War hero and governor of Gideon, Keshu seeks to better the Saxhleel people while searching for peace and good companionship for a time. After adding Keshu to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
11924.name: Keshu the Black Fin

11925.description: Hunter, Dark Brotherhood assassin, big brotherâKor is all this and more. Invite him into your abode, and he'll share observations about his life. After adding Kor to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
11925.name: Kor

11926.description: When this fledgling Dark Brotherhood assassin isn't using her werewolf abilities to complete contracts, she reflects on her dual nature. After adding Hildegard to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.
11926.name: Hildegard

11959.description: The steeds of the Dark Brotherhood are conditioned to run blindly ahead in the darkness, fully trusting their riders. When the situation demands it, the horses will even run with multiple riders clinging to them on all sides, never flinching or faltering.
11959.name: Dark Brotherhood Crew Steed

11960.description: Few creatures are more apt mounts for the Dark Brotherhood than sabre cats. Light on their feet, agile, and with a hunting instinct to match their rider's, many Dark Brotherhood members believe a sabre cat mount is a gift from Sithis himself.
11960.name: Dark Brotherhood Sabre Cat

11961.description: "Sithis teaches silence, yes, but stealth is not always the most important thing when you have enough speed and power on your side. That's why I choose to ride a kagouti. I find their ferocity more than makes up for the noise."âDark Brother Bols Uveleth
11961.name: Dark Brotherhood Kagouti

11962.description: Unlike other durzogs, which can become vocal when they sense their prey is near, those trained by the Dark Brotherhood have been bred for speed and silence.
11962.name: Dark Brotherhood Durzog

12054.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Oathsworn Pit.
12054.name: Bust: Aradros
12054.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Oathsworn Pit.

12055.description: Trophy taken from Aradros the Awakened in honor of an Undaunted victory in Oathsworn Pit.
12055.name: Trophy: Aradros

12056.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Bedlam Veil.
12056.name: Bust: The Blind
12056.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Bedlam Veil.

12057.description: Trophy taken from the Blind in honor of an Undaunted victory in Bedlam Veil.
12057.name: Trophy: The Blind

12058.description: "Hold your grudges well. Keep them close to your heart. Let them punctuate every blow you make as you fulfill upon your promise of vengeance. And display this statue in your dwelling so that all may know the cost of crossing you."âLucky Lashgikh
12058.name: Statuette: Malacath, Furious One

12059.description: Discipline and resolution. Protection and honor. These traits and more embody the spirit of the Imperial warrior. Display these noble qualities in this artful statuette!
12059.name: Statuette: Imperial Warrior

12060.description: "Those whom Hermaeus Mora calls to the Infinite Archive may serve himâor may choose to leave. But who, upon understanding the limitless knowledge they may access, dares refuse the Lord of Secrets without feeling bereft forever after?"âMage Allierwen
12060.name: Painting: Infinite Archive

12061.description: Like the Warrior-Poet himself, this striking butterfly is bisected by two distinct color palettes. The Tribunal's faithful consider it a good omen to see one of these creatures, and a blessing from Lord Vivec himself if one chooses to follow you.
12061.name: Vivec's Promise Butterfly

12062.description: These cats of Skyrim are used to harsh conditions with little respite. As a result, they're quite hardy, known for their large size and thick, gorgeous fur. They're prized by local villages for their mousing abilities and teeth-rattling purrs.
12062.name: Majestic Alpine Cat

12235.description: Some may call Tanlorin a rabble-rouser or rapscallion. They much prefer being called a friend. After adding Tanlorin to your home, you can set them on a path to wander. You can also speak with them. But be warned, they're a bit of a talker.
12235.name: Tanlorin
12235.hint: Obtained by completing quest "Of Crown and Flowers."

12236.description: Though far from his own time, Zerith-var is sure to brighten any living space with his thoughtful observations and warm company. After adding Zerith to your home, you and guests can speak to him. You can also let him wander by setting him on a path.
12236.name: Zerith-var
12236.hint: Obtained by completing quest "The Dark Behind the World."

12237.description: These mesmerizing creatures hail from the Daedric realm of Mirrormoor. Unlike some of the other denizens of that realm, Crystaljacks appear to be organic in nature, with shimmering skin that simply mimics the appearance of mirrored surfaces.
12237.name: Crystaljack
12237.hint: Obtained by completing quest "In Memory Of."

12244.description: The people of Riverhold have bred these horses for generations. The result is a line of bright-eyed and faithful steeds, eager to please with their rich chestnut coat. On the road, few horses are steadier or more reliable.
12244.name: Riverhold Chestnut Horse

12245.description: Very few mounts take to battle as readily as a warbear. This one answers only to the strength of its rider. Between its fierce disposition and ursine defenses, it has little to fear from any foes on the battlefield.
12245.name: Dragonclaw Imperial Warbear
12245.hint: Acquired by completing the "Imperial Warbear Seeker" Achievement.

12257.description: "Many strange and wonderous things hail from Mirrormoor. Perhaps this creature walked here along the threads of fate to assist you on your journey."âKeeper Adiir
12257.name: Refulgent Mirrormoor Steed
12257.hint: Acquired by completing the "Knot Worthy" achievement.

12258.description: "To follow the Dawnway requires faith. We are returning to our rootsâto the old magic that the Wild Elves used. You can't expect it to be without its share of weeds. Still, the Green provides."âPriest Nothelas, Vashabar
12258.name: Wildburn Lynx
12258.hint: Acquired by completing the "Savior of West Weald" achievement.

12259.description: "The great expanse between the planes of the Aurbis is endless night, the Outer Darkness of the Void. Some few things, blessedly few things, live in this endless nothingness. And they are strange beyond imagining."âAzandar al-Cybiades
12259.name: Hollowsoul Steed

12260.description: "Why the flowers? Because this one finds them beautiful, that's why. Charging into battle together does not mean we can't enjoy their colors. And a battlefield littered with petals is a sight to behold."âMathi-jo
12260.name: Ardor's Devotion Senche-Raht

12261.description: It is said that when the bloodlust of Hircine's Huntsmen goes unsated for too long, the collective prey drive forms a will and a shape of its own. Once its quarry is scented, the wolf will pursue at all costs, never stopping until it tastes blood.
12261.name: Bloodmoon Wolf

12262.description: Animal husbandry experts from Hammerfell and Wrothgar came together in a unique Covenant collaboration to create a good-natured pack animal with a hearty constitution and a pleasing aesthetic. The soft-coated, lovable brekka is the result.
12262.name: Russet Brekka

12263.description: "It's a strange creature, no doubt about that. I'm not sure if it's a bear that became enchanted too close to the sea, or a magical oceanic construct that just happens to look like a bear. Either way, it's a good swimmer."âMage Adept Erwan Cottret
12263.name: Shoal Bear

12264.description: Not all of Molag Bal's eyes are as vigilant as the Prince would like, it would seem. This one exhibits open curiosity about the world! The blinking certainly is creepy, though.
12264.name: Coldharbour Ocular Observer

12266.description: "This one has always admired the owls around here. Very wise creatures. Most do not get too close, even when offered treats. Most, but not all. This is Hooty. A very clever name, yes? What else does one call a pet owl?"âTraveling Merchant J'margo
12266.name: Senchal Horned Owl

12272.description: This is a small house item.
12272.name: Apocryphal Tome

12413.description:
Eri has been expertly trained by Nord beast tamers to act as a very good (such a good!) personal banker for you and your groupmates. 

He doesn't venture to Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds. Too much violence, not enough pets.
12413.name: Eri, Barking Banker

12414.description:
Xyn travels the Daedric realms looking for profitable opportunities. They'll happily take your goods (or those of your groupmates) in exchange for common mortal coinage.

Ancient bindings prevent them from appearing in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds.
12414.name: Xyn, Planar Purveyor

12416.description: "The metamorphic nature of the voriplasm is a bit of a passion of mine. Nothing in all of Tamriel is as adaptive as this simple-minded gel. My lab sample collection grows daily, showing unbelievable specificity in their adaptations."âGabrielle Benele
12416.name: Vineyard Voriplasm

12417.description: A miniature statue of Auriel, King of the Aldmer. Based on the storied effigy of the same name in the ruins of Garlas Agea along the Gold Coast.
12417.name: Statuette: Auriel of Garlas Agea

12418.description: A miniature statue of Peryite, the Daedric Prince of Pestilence.
12418.name: Statuette: Peryite, Blightlord

12419.description: Located within the Scar in Northern Elsweyr, the Stitches draws the eye of many an artist seeking the challenge of illustrating a more vertically oriented settlement.
12419.name: Painting: The Stitches

12420.description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in the Lucent Citadel.
12420.name: Bust: Orphic Shattered Shard
12420.hint: Awarded for completing Veteran Lucent Citadel.

12421.description: Trophy taken from the Orphic Shattered Shard in honor of an Undaunted victory in the Lucent Citadel.
12421.name: Trophy: Orphic Shattered Shard

12423.description: Nix-oxen are incredibly adaptable, thriving across Tamriel. This subspecies developed bright markings to attract one another across the heat waves of the desert. Their long legs also allow them to cross the sands easily and stay cool in harsh conditions.
12423.name: Oasis-Strider Nix-Ox

12424.description: The gifting of live animals is sometimes practiced among Mara's faithful as a sign of a couple's commitment to one another. Though bears are rarely used for this purpose, this one is immeasurably affectionate, with soft fur that begs to be petted.
12424.name: Mara's Awe Bear

12425.description: Unassuming at a glance, the closer one looks at a mirrorworm, the more mesmerizing they become. The creature's soft form is protected by glistening reflective scales that also serve to confuse and intimidate would-be predators.
12425.name: Mirrorworm

12426.description: "People say you should be wary of shadows, but what about blinding white snow? When you get disoriented in a blizzard, when you can't tell up from down anymore, that's when the snowclaws will strike! I can feel it."âLast journal entry of Hunter Keedru
12426.name: Snowclaw Senche-Serval

12428.description: As an assassin in the Morag Tong, Ashur takes his work deathly seriously. Invite him to stay and you need never worry about uninvited visitors. After adding Ashur to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
12428.name: Ashur

12429.description: After a Necrom ancestor spirit persuaded her to see more of the world, Miraso decided to accomplish this by taking on jobs in private residences across Tamriel and beyond. Will you take her on? After adding Miraso to your home, you can set her on a path.
12429.name: Necrom Guard Miraso

12447.description: Never again want for a nightlight with this enchanted, flaming larval yaghra at your side. Just beware that while it does keep the darkness at bay, prolonged exposure to its horrible legs and beady little eyes has been known to increase nightmares.
12447.name: Nightflame Larval Yaghra

12448.description: Perhaps the only thing sweeter than this cub are the snuggles it happily bestows on anyone it sees. It's rather addictive, and many who've begun petting the cub find it incredibly difficult to stop. Somehow, it always smells like roses.
12448.name: Mara's Awe Cub

12449.description: "Things that sink in the swamp never truly leave the cold embrace of the muck. Their tormented ends infuse the very land itself, haunting and changing the few living creatures that survive in that wretched place."âSwamp Songs: A History
12449.name: Sepulchral Swamp Jelly

12457.description: Though adorable at this tender age, Bloodmoon pups still possess the incredible hunting drive of their adult counterparts. However, their hunts often lead to squirrels and insects, and a falling leaf is more than enough to distract them from the scent.
12457.name: Bloodmoon Wolf Pup

12458.description: Having been created through selective breeding and magic, quasigriffs have a penchant for absorbing any excess magicka they're exposed to. This stock was raised within the penumbral realms of Evergloam, as you can see.
12458.name: Reaper's End Quasigriff

12459.description: It's rumored that these little amphibians may be as long-lived as the Ayleids themselves used to be. Found only in Rivenspire near the Erokii Ruins, they are highly prized for their unique coloration and ability to regrow their own missing limbs.
12459.name: Doomcrag Salamander

12460.description: Native to the southeastern region of the Black Marsh, these fellrunners are adept at hunting in the marshy terrain. Though their pecks can be quite swift, they clack their beaks with joy when greeting their owners and favorite people.
12460.name: Oliis Bay Fellrunner

12461.description: After placing this furnishing in your home, a quick prayer to Kynareth causes the weather around you to change. Until you use the vessel again, the skies remain in their current state. Homes without skies are not impacted by this furnishing.
12461.name: Kynareth's Icon of Storm Control

12466.description: "The Dwemer of old are known for their clever inventions. Here, they've captured the likeness of a senche through ingenious carving and materials. All these years later, the creature still easily heeds its master's call."âDwarven Constructs: A Guide
12466.name: Cyan Dwarven Senche

12467.description: "Be careful! This beast is meaner than a durzog and hot as a fire atronach. The furnace in its chest gives it incredible power and an appetite to match. I can't remember when last this one was fed. Best not to find out."âKallin, House Ravenwatch
12467.name: Brimstone Death Hound

12468.description: Few birds are as intelligent or vain as the Moorpecker Magpie. Prized by scholars and mages alike for their keen instincts and trainability, the birds can be huffy and prone to temper tantrums when not rewarded with shinies for their work.
12468.name: Moorpecker Magpie

12469.description: "Don't feed the squirrels! Once you do, they never leave you alone. Oh, they look innocent enough now, but when you find one making off with your last sweet roll, you'll be sorry!"âDrisuggan, Markarth
12469.name: Markarth Squirrel

12473.description: "Meet my faithful steed, Honor. He's always getting into my foodstuffs. Has the appetite of a mammoth and the cunning of a fox, that one!"âCadwell
12473.name: Golden Honor

12476.description: Bartered in the great merchant stalls of Fargrave, this horse has been trained and tested against everything the Daedric Realms have to offer. It responds to the slightest nudge from its rider, plunging into even the most bizarre battle with no hesitation.
12476.name: Lucent Guardian Horse

12477.description: Specially bred to fight Daedra, this ornaug has a jaw that has been left free of armor. Its powerful bite can cut through even Daedroth hide, and its tough scales are resistant to scrapes and cuts.
12477.name: Lucent Guardian Ornaug

12478.description: Chirhazi has fought more Daedra than most know exist. She's become accustomed to the protective armor necessary for such battles and willingly allows her partner to be her eyes.
12478.name: Lucent Guardian Senche-Raht

12479.description: Traded in the merchant stalls of Fargrave, this beast is far from its native home in the depths of Valenwood. Specially trained to hunt Daedra from every realm, it tracks even the largest Ogrim without fear or uncertainty.
12479.name: Lucent Guardian Wolf

12501.description: Although arcane investigator Fennorian of House Ravenwatch also happens to be a vampire, he's one of the good ones. Dare you invite him home? After adding Fennorian to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.
12501.name: Fennorian

12502.description: A series of defeats in the Three Banners War led veteran Larina to take some leave to recuperate before her next battle in Cyrodiil. Will you give her a place to rest? After adding Larina to your home, you can set her on a path.
12502.name: Imperial Legionary Larina

12507.description: This vibrant indrik is just the trick to enter the Carnaval festivities in style. Sporting bright plumage and gilded barding, this beast and its rider will be the center of attention, and may even draw the eye of a certain Daedric Prince.
12507.name: Carnaval Indrik

12513.description: Jaguar riders may find themselves thirsting for something other than wine as they stalk Carnaval feasting grounds on these stately and suave mounts. Good thing these felines are silent as the shadows.
12513.name: Carnaval Jaguar

12514.description: The allure of Carnaval is enough to entice even the dourest Dark Elf to celebrate. Done with their characteristic attention to detail, they present the nix-oxen of Vvardenfell in stunning color and gilded saddles, perfect for a night of excess.
12514.name: Carnaval Nix-Ox

12515.description: When kept on a tight leash, welwas can make for a showstopping mount during Carnaval. Riders must be careful not to partake too much in the festivities, or their control of the fearsome beast may slip. What happens next is up to Sanguine.
12515.name: Carnaval Welwa

12517.description: Even the most well-traveled adventurer should tread with care when entering Fargrave. This haunting welwa has an uncanny sense of direction that allows it to traverse the many planes of Oblivion with ease.
12517.name: Fargrave Walker Welwa

12657.description: The armor on this gleaming senche isn't just for its own protection. It's a necessary barrier between the rider and the knifelike shards that cover the beast's body. With time, a patient rider can learn where it's safe to touch the beast.
12657.name: Mirrormoor Shard Senche

12658.description: "In pursuit of ever more esoteric materials, I have drawn upon the most curious of realmic threads. Shards of mirror unending, on to the horizon and more. The whole place permeated with the deepest sense of loss." âJournal of the Spidersmith
12658.name: Glass Atronach Dwarven Spider

12659.description: "These majestic birds of prey are capable hunters, sighting their prey from great heights before descending in near silence for the kill. This prowess makes them prized by hunters and nobles alike."âFeathered Fauna, Translated
12659.name: Golden Eagle

12660.description: "She's been my faithful steed through every battle. Never lost her footing even once. There were plenty of close calls, mind you, but whenever I thought we were finished, she'd find some narrow path forward, and here we are."âCaptain Morel
12660.name: 10-Year Lion Guard Steed

12661.description: "Calmer than horses and more dependable than camels, elk are the preferred mount for traversing Tamriel's forests. Their regal bearing gives the rider plenty of visibility, without attracting too much attention."âSteady Hooves: An Elkback Journey
12661.name: Spiritwalker Pillion Elk

12662.description: Double trouble approaches when this pitch-black steed rides into town. With more than enough ill-tidings to go around, this Black Fredas steed is living proof that misery loves company.
12662.name: Black Fredas Pillion Walker

12663.description: "Watch your fingers, now! It looks small, but this little bugger makes up for it with its bite. Come to think of it, that might actually be how it shows affection."âTamer Gudleif
12663.name: Coldharbour Dremnaken Runt

12664.description: White sep adders are rare in the wild since their distinctive coloration doesn't allow for natural camouflage. They are typically found only in captivity, bred for the shine and luster of their scales and their beautiful novelty.
12664.name: Pearl White Sep Adder

12665.description: Mage faithful of Julianos create these unique creatures as a form of devotional art. The wisp represents orderly aesthetics, a sense of balance, and focused energy. It also makes for a beautiful focusing tone while meditating.
12665.name: Stonewisp of Truth and Law

12666.description: "I think Y'ffre has a lesson for us in all his creations. Moths especially. It's easy to overlook them. But they remind us how to be soft. How to move lightly through the world, and how to follow the light."âGundelion of Vashabar
12666.name: Vashabar Petal Moth

12667.description: The wings on these bats are mesmerizing, though difficult to spot during the day. When backlit by the light of Tamriel's moons, they seem to ignite in the sky. The illusion draws insects, a happy feast for the Stainedwing Bat.
12667.name: Stainedwing Bat

12668.description: Though these dragon frogs are striking to look at, not much can be said for their intelligence. When two of them meet face to face, they become mesmerized by their own reflection in the other's body. The resulting standoff can last for hours.
12668.name: Mirrormoor Dragon Frog

12683.description: "Don't mind old Honeycheeks, here. He's just snuffling around to see if you have anything tasty on you. Don't worry, he's a strict vegetarian! Although he has been known to swallow a bee or two when he gets deep in a honeycomb."âBeniah Bear-friend
12683.name: Dragontail Mountain Bear

12684.description: The one surefire way to tame a Dragontail Mountain Bear is to find one when it's young and tempt it with treats like honey and berries. The bears have a particularly strong sweet tooth and will do anything to satiate their cravings.
12684.name: Dragontail Mountain Bear Cub

12690.description: "Some people think these lemurs are psychic, but that's just nonsense. They're just very persuasive. Look at those gigantic eyes! How could you not do whatever it wanted just to get it to stop staring at you?"âIsabelle Onus, Wayrest
12690.name: High Rock Red Lemur

12691.description: "He's just as smart and loyal as any Legion mastiff! And twice as affectionate! Although he has a habit of not actually retrieving his ball if it's under a bush, or in a puddle, or just not easy to see. But that's all right."âLegionary Audania
12691.name: West Weald Retriever

12692.description: "Look, some might call it cheating to play with a ball that follows you around, but it's not like you asked it to! It's perfectly safe. Fine for a regulation game. I think. Might get confusing with two balls on the field, though."âCarrier Clairene
12692.name: Chaosball Cohort

12693.description: Owners of these clever kittens must keep a close eye on them, especially in snowy environments. Their soft steps and white fur allow them to easily disappear in such places. However, most prefer the warmth of their companions to frosty dens.
12693.name: Snowclaw Senche-Serval Kitten

12706.description: Any who possess this tome have, at their fingertips, a comprehensive guide to the art of scribing spells.
12706.name: How to Scribe
12706.hint: Acquired by completing the quest "The Second Era of Scribing."

12712.description: The shards on this wildcat's body are dull and safe to touch. The same can't be said for its fangs and claws, which prick like needles. As it grows in size, those shards become razor-sharp glassâa terrifying defense mechanism.
12712.name: Mirrormoor Shard Wildcat

12713.description: This mudcrab is a frisky little crustacean pal who's at home in the water or out of it. Gilded and gussied up as a 10-year tribute.
12713.name: 10-Year Anniversary Mudcrab

12714.description: This pangrit's unassuming colors serve as combat camouflage. They can traverse coastal environments and rocky shorelines nearly unnoticedâa boon to riders looking to avoid attention.
12714.name: Striped War Pangrit

12715.description: "This one holds no love for Colovians, you see. But they did bring one good thing to Arenthia: their horses. Fine steeds, truly. And such fetching colors, no?"âTrader Zetisha
12715.name: Arenthian Skewbald Horse

12725.description: Celebrate the 10-Year Anniversary by dancing in the golden light of this summoned wisp.
12725.name: 10-Year Anniversary Golden Wisp

12728.description: "The Lady of Infinite Energies lent me a steed to hasten my way to Garlas Malatar. A creature of golden light, gleaming barding, a symphony of blades, and an aura reminiscent of the Colored Room, the charger tested my endurance."âKing Narilmor's Journal
12728.name: Symphony of Dawn Charger

12729.description: This well-dressed monkey is lively and cheerful, even in the grimmest of dungeons. Gilded and gussied up as a 10-Year tribute.
12729.name: 10-Year Anniversary Monkey

12730.description: "Feed the stone with blood and wine. Feel the magic binds entwine. The Prince of Revels loves to take. The Prince of Revels bids you wake."âStone Waking Sacrament of Sanguine, fragment
12730.name: Sanguine Gargoyle

12734.description: It's no surprise that this unique bear has found a home for itself in the peaceful, rolling hills of Wind Keep. With few natural predators, the beasts are quite docile, and riders appreciate the animal's agreeable nature.
12734.name: Wind Keep Bear

12735.description: "Keep it well-fed and you'll be fine. It's a smart beast, it won't scratch or run off if it knows you'll give it an easy meal. Just watch your rations on the mountains, though. They're practically invisible in the snow."âStablehand Skagurn
12735.name: Frostbreak Tiger-Lynx

12736.description: War and bloodshed have only made this wolf stronger. The creature wears its history proudly, draped in the banners of fallen foes and noble allies alike. Any potential challenger should think twice before approaching the rider of this beast.
12736.name: Three Banners Veteran Wolf

12737.description: "Covered in a thicker coat of fur than most bristlebacks, they are. Just as ornery as the regular ones. If not more so! I hear forsworn wrestle em' for a challenge. Supposed to make them look tough. More like mad!"âMiet, Breeder
12737.name: Karth River Bristleback

12738.description: This bear is fiercely loyal to its rider, and it snaps and growls at anyone else who gets too close. It has a gentle disposition with its bonded rider and often snuffles around in search of treats in their pack.
12738.name: Anniversary Fellowship Bear

12739.description: "My village was pillaged. We were made to live as outcasts. And yet this animal refuses to leave my side for a better life. So I will continue to fight. For them."âMugrog, Covenant Soldier
12739.name: Orsinium Tiger-Lynx

12740.description: "This little bird's stalking me. Ever since I shooed it off from its dip in the fountain by the Manor. It's waddled after me, everywhere! It's even got family by the port. They're plotting something!"âEdre Maric, House Dorell Guard
12740.name: Northpoint Chub Loon

12742.description: Tales from the hinterlands say these rare white echalettes were cursed. But these beasts are friendly, kind, and fierce protectors once fed. Perhaps this one's next home is with you?
12742.name: Snowglint Echalette

12743.description: Beware the beaches of Amenos, where these durzogs learned to hide beneath the sand and ambush their prey. Local Dreadsails and other outlaws prize them as mounts for their powerful claws and easy gait on the sand.
12743.name: Skulltooth Coastal Durzog

12744.description: "I couldn't let him go. Not after how he led those goblins away. No one would do that for me. So, if people fear me, let them. This terrier's life is worth more than their approval."âVyctor Aurell, Necromancer
12744.name: Ghostly Breton Terrier

12745.description: "If you want a companion who looks after itself and hides when things get rough, find and train one of these striped nymphlings. These dear hearts love to curl up next to you under blankets while you sleep!"âSaissula, Stablemaster
12745.name: Striped Pangrit Nymphling

12746.description: A reliable companion on the roads of Reaper's March. Especially popular amongst skooma smugglers that require work out of the caves along the River Strid.
12746.name: Arenthian Skewbald Pony

12747.description: One of the many uncharted mysteries off Tamriel's southern coast. This distant relative of the Bog Dog prefers to roll over warm sands and seaweed instead of Blackwood's murky swamps. Like all families, they have their differences.
12747.name: Saltwater Bog Dog

12748.description: Named for the small Auridon town where they were first bred, many needed homes after a Veiled Heritance attack. Some are still looking for a new place (and person) to plant their claws.
12748.name: Silsailen Tortie-Calico Cat

12749.description: "Conservator Vinelore was unimpressed by my fellrunner experiments. Perhaps this pink variant will impress her! It has a most peculiar diet that I think should prove quite interesting!"âOdd Researcher
12749.name: Russafeld Fellrunner

12750.description: "Debassi is enamored by this critter's festive coat! Reds brighter than the blood splats on Black Heights' roads! But Debassi is sure this is not blood. He's seen enough robberies to know!"âDebassi, Traveling Merchant
12750.name: Black Heights Squirrel

12751.description: Before they soar, every gryphon must first learn to ground themselves. It's said that Kynareth sent these fledglings to Nirn to find companions that could help them value both land and sky equally.
12751.name: Kynareth's Fledgling Gryphon

12773.description: A miniature statue of Daedric Prince Sanguine, hoisting a tankard during a revelry.
12773.name: Statuette: Sanguine

12774.description: A miniature statue of a Tojay Khajiit, dancing in celebration.
12774.name: Statuette: Dancing Tojay

12775.description: A painting of Oathsworn Pit, where followers of Malacath train in three different forms of combat.
12775.name: Painting: Oathsworn Pit

12777.description: Born and bred in remote reaches of Tamriel, these guar are the bestial stars of any Carnaval parade. Breeders of this variety feed them a rich diet to enhance their vibrant plumage before the festival.
12777.name: Carnaval Feathered Guar

12778.description: "This quasigriff may look fearsome, but she's been touched by Kynareth herself. While astride, you'll never feel the sun's brutal burn, and all wind will be at your back. The skies be blessed."âPriestess Belklina
12778.name: Kynareth's Quasigriff
